   1. If P is an [array index property name](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name), return false.
   2. Return ? [OrdinaryDefineOwnProperty](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydefineownproperty)(W, P, Desc).

      > [!note]
      > This is a [willful violation](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-compliance-with-other-specifications) of the JavaScript specification's [invariants of the essential internal methods](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods) to maintain compatibility with existing web content. See [tc39/ecma262 issue #672](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/issues/672) for more information. [\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#references)

3. Throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

##### 7.2.3.7 \[\[Get\]\] ( P, Receiver )
1. Let W be the value of the [\[\[Window\]\]](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) internal slot of **this**.
2. [Check if an access between two browsing contexts should be reported](#7133-reporting), given the [current global object](#81333-current)'s [browsing context](#722-the-window-object), W's [browsing context](#722-the-window-object), P, and the [current settings object](#81333-current).
3. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(W) is true, then return ? [OrdinaryGet](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryget)(**this**, P, Receiver).
4. Return ? [CrossOriginGet](#72135-crossoriginget--o-p-receiver-)(**this**, P, Receiver).

> [!note]
> **this** is passed rather than W as [OrdinaryGet](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryget) and [CrossOriginGet](#72135-crossoriginget--o-p-receiver-) will invoke the [\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#7235-getownproperty--p-) internal method.

##### 7.2.3.8 \[\[Set\]\] ( P, V, Receiver )
1. Let W be the value of the [\[\[Window\]\]](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) internal slot of **this**.
2. [Check if an access between two browsing contexts should be reported](#7133-reporting), given the [current global object](#81333-current)'s [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts), W's [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts), P, and the [current settings object](#81333-current).
3. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(W) is true:
   1. If P is an [array index property name](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name), then return false.
   2. Return ? [OrdinarySet](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryset)(W, P, V, Receiver).
4. Return ? [CrossOriginSet](#72136-crossoriginset--o-p-v-receiver-)(**this**, P, V, Receiver).

   > [!note]
   > **this** is passed rather than W as [CrossOriginSet](#72136-crossoriginset--o-p-v-receiver-) will invoke the [\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#7235-getownproperty--p-) internal method.

##### 7.2.3.9 \[\[Delete\]\] ( P )
1. Let W be the value of the [\[\[Window\]\]](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) internal slot of **this**.
2. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(W) is true:
   1. If P is an [array index property name](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name):
      1. Let desc be ! **this**.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](P).
      2. If desc is undefined, then return true.
      3. Return false.
   2. Return ? [OrdinaryDelete](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydelete)(W, P).
3. Throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

##### 7.2.3.10 \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] ( )
1. Let W be the value of the [\[\[Window\]\]](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) internal slot of **this**.
2. Let maxProperties be W's [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object)'s [document-tree child navigables](#7315-related-navigable-collections)'s [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
3. Let keys be [the range](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) 0 to maxProperties, exclusive.
4. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(W) is true, then return the concatenation of keys and [OrdinaryOwnPropertyKeys](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryownpropertykeys)(W).
5. Return the concatenation of keys and ! [CrossOriginOwnPropertyKeys](#72137-crossoriginownpropertykeys--o-)(W).

#### 7.2.4 The [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) interface

Each [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object is associated with a unique instance of a [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object, allocated when the [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object is created.

> [!warning]
> The [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) exotic object is defined through a mishmash of IDL, invocation of JavaScript internal methods post-creation, and overridden JavaScript internal methods. Coupled with its scary security policy, please take extra care while implementing this excrescence.

To create a [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object, run these steps:
1. Let location be a new [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) [platform object](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-platform-object).
2. Let valueOf be location's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[[%Object.prototype.valueOf%](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object.prototype.valueof)\]\].
3. Perform ! location.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]("`valueOf`", { \[\[Value\]\]: valueOf, \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: false }).
4. Perform ! location.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]([%Symbol.toPrimitive%](#219-dependencies), { \[\[Value\]\]: undefined, \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: false }).
5. Set the value of the [\[\[DefaultProperties\]\]](#724-the-location-interface) internal slot of location to location.\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]().
6. Return location.

> [!note]
> The addition of `valueOf` and [%Symbol.toPrimitive%](#219-dependencies) own data properties, as well as the fact that all of [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface)'s IDL attributes are marked `[LegacyUnforgeable]`, is required by legacy code that consulted the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) interface, or stringified it, to determine the [document URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), and then used it in a security-sensitive way. In particular, the `valueOf`, [%Symbol.toPrimitive%](#219-dependencies), and `[LegacyUnforgeable]` stringifier mitigations ensure that code such as `foo[location] = bar` or `location + ""` cannot be misdirected.

`document.location [ = value ]`

`window.location [ = value ]`

Returns a [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object with the current page's location.

Can be set, to navigate to another page.

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) object's `location` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object, if [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), and null otherwise.

The [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object's `location` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object.

[`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) objects provide a representation of the [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) of their associated [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), as well as methods for [navigating](#7422-beginning-navigation) and [reloading](#743-reloading-and-traversing) the associated [navigable](#731-navigables).

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Location { // but see also additional creation steps and overridden internal methods
  [LegacyUnforgeable] stringifier attribute USVString href;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute USVString origin;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString protocol;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString host;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString hostname;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString port;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString pathname;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString search;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString hash;

  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined assign(USVString url);
  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined replace(USVString url);
  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined reload();

  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute DOMStringList ancestorOrigins;
};
```

`location.toString()`

`location.href`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL.

Can be set, to navigate to the given URL.

`location.origin`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's origin.

`location.protocol`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's scheme.

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed scheme.

`location.host`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's host and port (if different from the default port for the scheme).

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed host and port.

`location.hostname`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's host.

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed host.

`location.port`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's port.

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed port.

`location.pathname`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's path.

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed path.

`location.search`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's query (includes leading "`?`" if non-empty).

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed query (ignores leading "`?`").

`location.hash`

Returns the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's URL's fragment (includes leading "`#`" if non-empty).

Can be set, to navigate to the same URL with a changed fragment (ignores leading "`#`").

`location.assign(url)`

Navigates to the given URL.

`location.replace(url)`

Removes the current page from the session history and navigates to the given URL.

`location.reload()`

Reloads the current page.

`location.ancestorOrigins`

Returns a [`DOMStringList`](#265-the-domstringlist-interface) object listing the origins of the [ancestor navigables](#7315-related-navigable-collections)' [active documents](#731-navigables).

A [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object has an associated relevant `Document`, which is its [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [browsing context](#722-the-window-object)'s [active document](#732-browsing-contexts), if this [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [browsing context](#722-the-window-object) is non-null, and null otherwise.

A [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object has an associated url, which is this [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), if this [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null, and [`about:blank`](#219-dependencies) otherwise.

To `Location`-object navigate a [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object location to a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) url, optionally given a [`NavigationHistoryBehavior`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) historyHandling (default "[`auto`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"):
1. Let navigable be location's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object).
2. Let sourceDocument be the [incumbent global object](#81332-incumbent)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
3. If location's [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is not yet [completely loaded](#758-finishing-the-loading-process), and the [incumbent global object](#81332-incumbent) does not have [transient activation](#641-data-model), then set historyHandling to "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
4. [Navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) navigable to url using sourceDocument, with *[exceptionsEnabled](#7422-beginning-navigation)* set to true and *[historyHandling](#7422-beginning-navigation)* set to historyHandling.

The `href` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer).

The [`href`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. Let url be the result of [encoding-parsing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given the given value, relative to the [entry settings object](#81331-entry).
3. If url is failure, then throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to url.

> [!note]
> The [`href`](#724-the-location-interface) setter intentionally has no security check.

The `origin` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return the [serialization](#711-origins) of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin).

The `protocol` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme), followed by "`:`".

The [`protocol`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. Let possibleFailure be the result of [basic URL parsing](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) the given value, followed by "`:`", with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [scheme start state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#scheme-start-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).

   > [!note]
   > Because the URL parser ignores multiple consecutive colons, providing a value of "`https:`" (or even "`https::::`") is the same as providing a value of "`https`".

5. If possibleFailure is failure, then throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
6. If copyURL's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is not an [HTTP(S) scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme), then terminate these steps.
7. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `host` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Let url be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
3. If url's [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host) is null, return the empty string.
4. If url's [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port) is null, return url's [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-host-serializer).
5. Return url's [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-host-serializer), followed by "`:`" and url's [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#serialize-an-integer).

The [`host`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. If copyURL has an [opaque path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-opaque-path), then return.
5. [Basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) the given value, with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [host state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#host-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
6. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `hostname` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host) is null, return the empty string.
3. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-host-serializer).

The [`hostname`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. If copyURL has an [opaque path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-opaque-path), then return.
5. [Basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) the given value, with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [hostname state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#hostname-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
6. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `port` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port) is null, return the empty string.
3. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#serialize-an-integer).

The [`port`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. If copyURL [cannot have a username/password/port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#cannot-have-a-username-password-port), then return.
5. If the given value is the empty string, then set copyURL's [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port) to null.
6. Otherwise, [basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) the given value, with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [port state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#port-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
7. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `pathname` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return the result of [URL path serializing](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-path-serializer) this [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object's [url](#724-the-location-interface).

The [`pathname`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. If copyURL has an [opaque path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-opaque-path), then return.
5. Set copyURL's [path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) to the empty list.
6. [Basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) the given value, with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [path start state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#path-start-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
7. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `search` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) is either null or the empty string, return the empty string.
3. Return "`?`", followed by [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query).

The [`search`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. If the given value is the empty string, set copyURL's [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) to null.
5. Otherwise, run these substeps:
   1. Let input be the given value with a single leading "`?`" removed, if any.
   2. Set copyURL's [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) to the empty string.
   3. [Basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) input, with null, the [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [document's character encoding](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url), and [query state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#query-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
6. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

The `hash` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is non-null and its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) is either null or the empty string, return the empty string.
3. Return "`#`", followed by [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface)'s [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment).

The [`hash`](#724-the-location-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let copyURL be a copy of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [url](#724-the-location-interface).
4. Let thisURLFragment be copyURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) if it is non-null; otherwise the empty string.
5. Let input be the given value with a single leading "`#`" removed, if any.
6. Set copyURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) to the empty string.
7. [Basic URL parse](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) input, with copyURL as [*url*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url) and [fragment state](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#fragment-state) as [*state override*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override).
8. If copyURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) is thisURLFragment, then return.

   > [!note]
   > This bailout is necessary for compatibility with deployed content, which [redundantly sets `location.hash` on scroll](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1733797#c2). It does not apply to other mechanisms of fragment navigation, such as the [`location.href`](#724-the-location-interface) setter or [`location.assign()`](#724-the-location-interface).

9. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to copyURL.

> [!note]
> Unlike the equivalent API for the [`a`](#451-the-a-element) and [`area`](#4813-the-area-element) elements, the [`hash`](#724-the-location-interface) setter does not special case the empty string, to remain compatible with deployed scripts.

---

The `assign(url)` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let urlRecord be the result of [encoding-parsing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given url, relative to the [entry settings object](#81331-entry).
4. If urlRecord is failure, then throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
5. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to urlRecord.

The `replace(url)` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return.
2. Let urlRecord be the result of [encoding-parsing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given url, relative to the [entry settings object](#81331-entry).
3. If urlRecord is failure, then throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. [`Location`-object navigate](#724-the-location-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to urlRecord given "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".

> [!note]
> The [`replace()`](#724-the-location-interface) method intentionally has no security check.

The `reload()` method steps are:
1. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface).
2. If document is null, then return.
3. If document's [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. [Reload](#743-reloading-and-traversing) document's [node navigable](#731-navigables).

---

A [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object has an associated empty `DOMStringList` which is a [`DOMStringList`](#265-the-domstringlist-interface) object whose associated list is an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).

> [!note]
> This object cannot carry state across navigations because it is only returned when there is no [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface), in which case it's not possible to navigate, and it's not possible to return to a non-null [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface).

The `ancestorOrigins` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface) is null, then return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [empty `DOMStringList`](#724-the-location-interface).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the [entry settings object](#81331-entry)'s [origin](#8132-environment-settings-objects), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [ancestor origins list](#313-ancestor-origins) is not null.
4. Otherwise, return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant `Document`](#724-the-location-interface)'s [ancestor origins list](#313-ancestor-origins).

---

As explained earlier, the [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) exotic object requires additional logic beyond IDL for security purposes. The [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object must use the ordinary internal methods except where it is explicitly specified otherwise below.

Also, every [`Location`](#724-the-location-interface) object has a \[\[DefaultProperties\]\] internal slot representing its own properties at time of its creation.

##### 7.2.4.1 \[\[GetPrototypeOf\]\] ( )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true, then return ! [OrdinaryGetPrototypeOf](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarygetprototypeof)(**this**).
2. Return null.

##### 7.2.4.2 \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] ( V )
1. Return ! [SetImmutablePrototype](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-set-immutable-prototype)(**this**, V).

##### 7.2.4.3 \[\[IsExtensible\]\] ( )
1. Return true.

##### 7.2.4.4 \[\[PreventExtensions\]\] ( )
1. Return false.

##### 7.2.4.5 \[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] ( P )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true:
   1. Let desc be [OrdinaryGetOwnProperty](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarygetownproperty)(**this**, P).
   2. If the value of the [\[\[DefaultProperties\]\]](#724-the-location-interface) internal slot of **this** contains P, then set desc.\[\[Configurable\]\] to true.
   3. Return desc.
2. Let property be [CrossOriginGetOwnPropertyHelper](#72134-crossorigingetownpropertyhelper--o-p-)(**this**, P).
3. If property is not undefined, then return property.
4. Return ? [CrossOriginPropertyFallback](#72132-crossoriginpropertyfallback--p-)(P).

##### 7.2.4.6 \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] ( P, Desc )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true:
   1. If the value of the [\[\[DefaultProperties\]\]](#724-the-location-interface) internal slot of **this** contains P, then return false.
   2. Return ? [OrdinaryDefineOwnProperty](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydefineownproperty)(**this**, P, Desc).
2. Throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

##### 7.2.4.7 \[\[Get\]\] ( P, Receiver )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true, then return ? [OrdinaryGet](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryget)(**this**, P, Receiver).
2. Return ? [CrossOriginGet](#72135-crossoriginget--o-p-receiver-)(**this**, P, Receiver).

##### 7.2.4.8 \[\[Set\]\] ( P, V, Receiver )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true, then return ? [OrdinarySet](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryset)(**this**, P, V, Receiver).
2. Return ? [CrossOriginSet](#72136-crossoriginset--o-p-v-receiver-)(**this**, P, V, Receiver).

##### 7.2.4.9 \[\[Delete\]\] ( P )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true, then return ? [OrdinaryDelete](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydelete)(**this**, P).
2. Throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

##### 7.2.4.10 \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] ( )
1. If [IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin](#72133-isplatformobjectsameorigin--o-)(**this**) is true, then return [OrdinaryOwnPropertyKeys](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryownpropertykeys)(**this**).
2. Return [CrossOriginOwnPropertyKeys](#72137-crossoriginownpropertykeys--o-)(**this**).

#### 7.2.5 The [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) interface

```webidl
enum ScrollRestoration { "auto", "manual" };

[Exposed=Window]
interface History {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  attribute ScrollRestoration scrollRestoration;
  readonly attribute any state;
  undefined go(optional long delta = 0);
  undefined back();
  undefined forward();
  undefined pushState(any data, DOMString unused, optional USVString? url = null);
  undefined replaceState(any data, DOMString unused, optional USVString? url = null);
};
```

`history.length`

Returns the number of overall [session history entries](#7311-traversable-navigables) for the current [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).

`history.scrollRestoration`

Returns the [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [active session history entry](#731-navigables).

`history.scrollRestoration = value`

Set the [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [active session history entry](#731-navigables) to value.

`history.state`

Returns the [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [active session history entry](#731-navigables), deserialized into a JavaScript value.

`history.go()`

Reloads the current page.

`history.go(delta)`

Goes back or forward the specified number of steps in the overall [session history entries](#7311-traversable-navigables) list for the current [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).

A zero delta will reload the current page.

If the delta is out of range, does nothing.

`history.back()`

Goes back one step in the overall [session history entries](#7311-traversable-navigables) list for the current [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).

If there is no previous page, does nothing.

`history.forward()`

Goes forward one step in the overall [session history entries](#7311-traversable-navigables) list for the current [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).

If there is no next page, does nothing.

`history.pushState(data, "")`

Adds a new entry into session history with its [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) set to a serialization of data. The [active history entry](#731-navigables)'s [URL](#7411-session-history-entries) will be copied over and used for the new entry's URL.

(The second parameter exists for historical reasons, and cannot be omitted; passing the empty string is traditional.)

`history.pushState(data, "", url)`

Adds a new entry into session history with its [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) set to a serialization of data, and with its [URL](#7411-session-history-entries) set to url.

If the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [cannot have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to url, a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) will be thrown.

(The second parameter exists for historical reasons, and cannot be omitted; passing the empty string is traditional.)

`history.replaceState(data, "")`

Updates the [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [active session history entry](#731-navigables) to a structured clone of data.

(The second parameter exists for historical reasons, and cannot be omitted; passing the empty string is traditional.)

`history.replaceState(data, "", url)`

Updates the [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [active session history entry](#731-navigables) to a structured clone of data, and its [URL](#7411-session-history-entries) to url.

If the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [cannot have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to url, a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) will be thrown.

(The second parameter exists for historical reasons, and cannot be omitted; passing the empty string is traditional.)

A [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) has a history object, a [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) object.

The `history` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object)'s [history object](#725-the-history-interface).

---

Each [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) object has state, initially null.

Each [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) object has a length, a non-negative integer, initially 0.

Each [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) object has an index, a non-negative integer, initially 0.

> [!note]
> Although the [index](#725-the-history-interface) is not directly exposed, it can be inferred from changes to the [length](#725-the-history-interface) during synchronous navigations. In fact, that is what it's used for.

The `length` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [length](#725-the-history-interface).

The `scrollRestoration` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object)'s [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries).

The [`scrollRestoration`](#725-the-history-interface) setter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object)'s [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries) to the given value.

The `state` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [state](#725-the-history-interface).

The `go(delta)` method steps are to [delta traverse](#725-the-history-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given delta.

The `back()` method steps are to [delta traverse](#725-the-history-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given −1.

The `forward()` method steps are to [delta traverse](#725-the-history-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given +1.

To delta traverse a [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) object history given an integer delta:
1. Let document be history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. If history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object)'s [allowed to perform a navigation or history update](#731-navigables) returns [blocked](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-singletons), then return.
4. If delta is 0, then [reload](#743-reloading-and-traversing) document's [node navigable](#731-navigables), and return.
5. [Traverse the history by a delta](#743-reloading-and-traversing) given document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables), delta, and with *[sourceDocument](#743-reloading-and-traversing)* set to document.

The `pushState(data,
  unused, url)` method steps are to run the [shared history push/replace state steps](#725-the-history-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), data, url, and "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".

The `replaceState(data, unused,
  url)` method steps are to run the [shared history push/replace state steps](#725-the-history-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), data, url, and "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".

The shared history push/replace state steps, given a [`History`](#725-the-history-interface) history, a value data, a [scalar value string](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings)-or-null url, and a [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) historyHandling, are:
1. Let document be history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let serializedData be [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(data). Rethrow any exceptions.
4. Let newURL be document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
5. If url is not null or the empty string:
   1. Set newURL to the result of [encoding-parsing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given url, relative to the [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant) of history.
   2. If newURL is failure, then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
   3. If document [cannot have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to newURL, then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

   > [!note]
   > The special case for the empty string here is historical, and leads to different resulting URLs when comparing code such as `location.href = ""` (which performs URL parsing on the empty string) versus `history.pushState(null, "", "")` (which bypasses it).

6. If history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object)'s [allowed to perform a navigation or history update](#731-navigables) returns [blocked](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-singletons), then return.
7. Let navigation be history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
8. Let continue be the result of [firing a push/replace/reload `navigate` event](#726104-firing-the-event) at navigation with *[navigationType](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to historyHandling, *[isSameDocument](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to true, *[destinationURL](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to newURL, and *[classicHistoryAPIState](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to serializedData.
9. If continue is false, then return.
10. Run the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations) given document and newURL, with *[serializedData](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations)* set to serializedData and *[historyHandling](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations)* set to historyHandling.

User agents may limit the number of state objects added to the session history per page. If a page hits the [implementation-defined](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#23-terminology) limit, user agents must remove the entry immediately after the first entry for that [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) object in the session history after having added the new entry. (Thus the state history acts as a FIFO buffer for eviction, but as a LIFO buffer for navigation.)

A [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document can have its URL rewritten to a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) targetURL if the following algorithm returns true:
1. Let documentURL be document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
2. If targetURL and documentURL differ in their [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme), [username](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-username), [password](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-password), [host](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host), or [port](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port) components, then return false.
3. If targetURL's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is an [HTTP(S) scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme), then return true.

   > [!note]
   > Differences in [path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path), [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query), and [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) are allowed for [`http:`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7230.html#http.uri) and [`https:`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7230.html#https.uri) URLs.

4. If targetURL's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is "`file`":
   1. If targetURL and documentURL differ in their [path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) component, then return false.
   2. Return true.

   > [!note]
   > Differences in [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) and [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) are allowed for `file:` URLs.

5. If targetURL and documentURL differ in their [path](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path) component or [query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) components, then return false.

   > [!note]
   > Only differences in [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) are allowed for other types of URLs.

6. Return true.

> [!example]
> | document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) | targetURL | [can have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) |
> | --- | --- | --- |
> | `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/home#about` | ✅ |
> | `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/home?page=shop` | ✅ |
> | `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/shop` | ✅ |
> | `https://example.com/home` | `https://user:pass@example.com/home` | ❌ |
> | `https://example.com/home` | `http://example.com/home` | ❌ |
> | `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/x#hash` | ✅ |
> | `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/x?search` | ✅ |
> | `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/y` | ❌ |
> | `about:blank` | `about:blank#hash` | ✅ |
> | `about:blank` | `about:blank?search` | ❌ |
> | `about:blank` | `about:srcdoc` | ❌ |
> | `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,foo#hash` | ✅ |
> | `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,foo?search` | ❌ |
> | `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,bar` | ❌ |
> | `data:text/html,foo` | `data:bar` | ❌ |
> | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43#hash` | ✅ |
> | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43?search` | ❌ |
> | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/anything` | ❌ |
> | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:path` | ❌ |
> 
> Note how only the [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) of the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) matters, and not its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document). They can mismatch in cases like [`about:blank`](#219-dependencies) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)s with inherited origins, in sandboxed [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element)s, or when the [`document.domain`](#7112-relaxing-the-same-origin-restriction) setter has been used.

> [!example]
> Consider a game where the user can navigate along a line, such that the user is always at some coordinate, and such that the user can bookmark the page corresponding to a particular coordinate, to return to it later.
> 
> A static page implementing the x=5 position in such a game could look like the following:
> 
> ```html
> <!DOCTYPE HTML>
> <!-- this is https://example.com/line?x=5 -->
> <html lang="en">
> <title>Line Game - 5</title>
> <p>You are at coordinate 5 on the line.</p>
> <p>
>  <a href="?x=6">Advance to 6</a> or
>  <a href="?x=4">retreat to 4</a>?
> </p>
> ```
> 
> The problem with such a system is that each time the user clicks, the whole page has to be reloaded. Here instead is another way of doing it, using script:
> 
> ```html
> <!DOCTYPE HTML>
> <!-- this starts off as https://example.com/line?x=5 -->
> <html lang="en">
> <title>Line Game - 5</title>
> <p>You are at coordinate <span id="coord">5</span> on the line.</p>
> <p>
>  <a href="?x=6" onclick="go(1); return false;">Advance to 6</a> or
>  <a href="?x=4" onclick="go(-1); return false;">retreat to 4</a>?
> </p>
> <script>
>  var currentPage = 5; // prefilled by server
>  function go(d) {
>    setupPage(currentPage + d);
>    history.pushState(currentPage, "", '?x=' + currentPage);
>  }
>  onpopstate = function(event) {
>    setupPage(event.state);
>  }
>  function setupPage(page) {
>    currentPage = page;
>    document.title = 'Line Game - ' + currentPage;
>    document.getElementById('coord').textContent = currentPage;
>    document.links[0].href = '?x=' + (currentPage+1);
>    document.links[0].textContent = 'Advance to ' + (currentPage+1);
>    document.links[1].href = '?x=' + (currentPage-1);
>    document.links[1].textContent = 'retreat to ' + (currentPage-1);
>  }
> </script>
> ```
> 
> In systems without script, this still works like the previous example. However, users that *do* have script support can now navigate much faster, since there is no network access for the same experience. Furthermore, contrary to the experience the user would have with just a naïve script-based approach, bookmarking and navigating the session history still work.
> 
> In the example above, the data argument to the [`pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) method is the same information as would be sent to the server, but in a more convenient form, so that the script doesn't have to parse the URL each time the user navigates.

> [!example]
> Most applications want to use the same [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries) value for all of their history entries. To achieve this they can set the [`scrollRestoration`](#725-the-history-interface) attribute as soon as possible (e.g., in the first [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) element in the document's [`head`](#421-the-head-element) element) to ensure that any entry added to the history session gets the desired scroll restoration mode.
> 
> ```html
> <head>
>   <script>
>        if ('scrollRestoration' in history)
>             history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
>   </script>
> </head>
>    
> ```

#### 7.2.6 The navigation API

##### 7.2.6.1 Introduction

*This section is non-normative.*

The navigation API, provided by the global [`navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) property, provides a modern and web application-focused way of managing navigations and history entries. It is a successor to the classic [`location`](#724-the-location-interface) and [`history`](#725-the-history-interface) APIs.

One ability the API provides is inspecting [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries). For example, the following will display the entries' URLs in an ordered list:

```javascript
const ol = document.createElement("ol");
ol.start = 0; // so that the list items' ordinal values match up with the entry indices

for (const entry of navigation.entries()) {
  const li = document.createElement("li");

  if (entry.index < navigation.currentEntry.index) {
    li.className = "backward";
  } else if (entry.index > navigation.currentEntry.index) {
    li.className = "forward";
  } else {
    li.className = "current";
  }

  li.textContent = entry.url;
  ol.append(li);
}
```

The [`navigation.entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) array contains [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) instances, which have other useful properties in addition to the [`url`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) and [`index`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) properties shown here. Note that the array only contains [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) objects that represent the current [navigable](#731-navigables), and thus its contents are not impacted by navigations inside [navigable containers](#7313-child-navigables) such as [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element)s, or by navigations of the [parent navigable](#731-navigables) in cases where the navigation API is itself being used inside an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element). Additionally, it only contains [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) objects representing same-[origin](#711-origins) [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries), meaning that if the user has visited other origins before or after the current one, there will not be corresponding [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)s.

---

The navigation API can also be used to navigate, reload, or traverse through the history:

```html
<button onclick="navigation.reload()">Reload</button>

<input type="url" id="navigationURL">
<button onclick="navigation.navigate(navigationURL.value)">Navigate</button>

<button id="backButton" onclick="navigation.back()">Back</button>
<button id="forwardButton" onclick="navigation.forward()">Forward</button>

<select id="traversalDestinations"></select>
<button id="goButton" onclick="navigation.traverseTo(traversalDestinations.value)">Traverse To</button>

<script>
backButton.disabled = !navigation.canGoBack;
forwardButton.disabled = !navigation.canGoForward;

for (const entry of navigation.entries()) {
  traversalDestinations.append(new Option(entry.url, entry.key));
}
</script>
```

Note that traversals are again limited to same-[origin](#711-origins) destinations, meaning that, for example, [`navigation.canGoBack`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) will be false if the previous [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) is for a page from another origin.

---

The most powerful part of the navigation API is the [`navigate`](#events) event, which fires whenever almost any navigation or traversal occurs in the current [navigable](#731-navigables):

```javascript
navigation.onnavigate = event => {
  console.log(event.navigationType); // "push", "replace", "reload", or "traverse"
  console.log(event.destination.url);
  console.log(event.userInitiated);
  // ... and other useful properties
};
```

(The event will not fire for [location bar-initiated navigations](#79-browser-user-interface-considerations), or navigations initiated from other windows, when the destination of the navigation is a new document.)

Much of the time, the event's [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) property will be true, meaning this event can be canceled using [`preventDefault()`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event):

```javascript
navigation.onnavigate = event => {
  if (event.cancelable && isDisallowedURL(event.destination.url)) {
    alert(`Please don't go to ${event.destination.url}!`);
    event.preventDefault();
  }
};

```

The [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) property will be false for some "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, such as those taking place inside [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables), those crossing to new origins, or when the user attempts to traverse again shortly after a previous call to [`preventDefault()`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) prevented them from doing so.

The [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method allows intercepting a navigation and converting it into a same-document navigation:

```javascript
navigation.addEventListener("navigate", e => {
  // Some navigations, e.g. cross-origin navigations, we cannot intercept.
  // Let the browser handle those normally.
  if (!e.canIntercept) {
    return;
  }

  // Similarly, don't intercept fragment navigations or downloads.
  if (e.hashChange || e.downloadRequest !== null) {
    return;
  }

  const url = new URL(event.destination.url);

  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/articles/")) {
    e.intercept({
      async handler() {
        // The URL has already changed, so show a placeholder while
        // fetching the new content, such as a spinner or loading page.
        renderArticlePagePlaceholder();

        // Fetch the new content and display when ready.
        const articleContent = await getArticleContent(url.pathname, { signal: e.signal });
        renderArticlePage(articleContent);
      }
    });
  }
});
```

Note that the [`handler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) function can return a promise to represent the asynchronous progress, and success or failure, of the navigation. While the promise is still pending, browser UI can treat the navigation as ongoing (e.g., by presenting a loading spinner). Other parts of the navigation API are also sensitive to these promises, such as the return value of [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations):

```javascript
const { committed, finished } = await navigation.navigate("/articles/the-navigation-api-is-cool");

// The committed promise will fulfill once the URL has changed, which happens
// immediately (as long as the NavigateEvent wasn't canceled).
await committed;

// The finished promise will fulfill once the Promise returned by handler() has
// fulfilled, which happens once the article is downloaded and rendered. (Or,
// it will reject, if handler() fails along the way).
await finished;
```

##### 7.2.6.2 The [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Navigation : EventTarget {
  sequence<NavigationHistoryEntry> entries();
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry? currentEntry;
  undefined updateCurrentEntry(NavigationUpdateCurrentEntryOptions options);
  readonly attribute NavigationTransition? transition;
  readonly attribute NavigationActivation? activation;

  readonly attribute boolean canGoBack;
  readonly attribute boolean canGoForward;

  NavigationResult navigate(USVString url, optional NavigationNavigateOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult reload(optional NavigationReloadOptions options = {});

  NavigationResult traverseTo(DOMString key, optional NavigationOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult back(optional NavigationOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult forward(optional NavigationOptions options = {});

  attribute EventHandler onnavigate;
  attribute EventHandler onnavigatesuccess;
  attribute EventHandler onnavigateerror;
  attribute EventHandler oncurrententrychange;
};

dictionary NavigationUpdateCurrentEntryOptions {
  required any state;
};

dictionary NavigationOptions {
  any info;
};

dictionary NavigationNavigateOptions : NavigationOptions {
  any state;
  NavigationHistoryBehavior history = "auto";
};

dictionary NavigationReloadOptions : NavigationOptions {
  any state;
};

dictionary NavigationResult {
  Promise<NavigationHistoryEntry> committed;
  Promise<NavigationHistoryEntry> finished;
};

enum NavigationHistoryBehavior {
  "auto",
  "push",
  "replace"
};
```

Each [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) has an associated navigation API, which is a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) object. Upon creation of the [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object, its [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface) must be set to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) object created in the [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).

The `navigation` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).

The following are the [event handlers](#8181-event-handlers) (and their corresponding [event handler event types](#8181-event-handlers)) that must be supported, as [event handler IDL attributes](#8181-event-handlers), by all objects implementing the [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) interface:

| [Event handler](#8181-event-handlers) | [Event handler event type](#8181-event-handlers) |
| --- | --- |
| `onnavigate` | [`navigate`](#events) |
| `onnavigatesuccess` | [`navigatesuccess`](#events) |
| `onnavigateerror` | [`navigateerror`](#events) |
| `oncurrententrychange` | [`currententrychange`](#events) |

##### 7.2.6.3 Core infrastructure

Each [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) has an associated entry list, a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) objects, initially empty.

Each [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) has an associated current entry index, an integer, initially −1.

The current entry of a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation is the result of running the following steps:
1. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return null.
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is not −1.
3. Return navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure)\].

A [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation has entries and events disabled if the following steps return true:
1. Let document be navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return true.
3. If document's [is initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) is true, then return true.
4. If document's [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is [opaque](#711-origins), then return true.
5. Return false.

To get the navigation API entry index of a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) she within a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation:
1. Let index be 0.
2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) nhe of navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure):
   1. If nhe's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is equal to she, then return index.
   2. Increment index by 1.
3. Return −1.

---

A key type used throughout the navigation API is the [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) enumeration:

```webidl
enum NavigationType {
 "push",
 "replace",
 "reload",
 "traverse"
};
```

This captures the main web developer-visible types of "navigations", which (as [noted elsewhere](#742-navigation)) do not exactly correspond to this standard's singular [navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) algorithm. The meaning of each value is the following:

"`push`"

Corresponds to calls to [navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) where the [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) ends up as "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", or to [`history.pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface).

"`replace`"

Corresponds to calls to [navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) where the [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) ends up as "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", or to [`history.replaceState()`](#725-the-history-interface).

"`reload`"

Corresponds to calls to [reload](#743-reloading-and-traversing).

"`traverse`"

Corresponds to calls to [traverse the history by a delta](#743-reloading-and-traversing).

> [!note]
> The value space of the [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) enumeration is a superset of the value space of the specification-internal [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) type. Several parts of this standard make use of this overlap, by passing in a [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) to an algorithm that expects a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure).

##### 7.2.6.4 Initializing and updating the entry list

To initialize the navigation API entries for a new document given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) newSHEs, and a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) initialSHE:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure) [is empty](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is −1.
3. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return.
4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) newSHE of newSHEs:
   1. Let newNHE be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) created in the [relevant realm](#81334-relevant) of navigation.
   2. Set newNHE's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) to newSHE.
   3. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) newNHE to navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure).

   > [!note]
   > newSHEs will have originally come from [getting session history entries for the navigation API](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history), and thus each newSHE will be contiguous [same](#711-origins) [origin](#7412-document-state) with initialSHE.

5. Set navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) to the result of [getting the navigation API entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) of initialSHE within navigation.

To update the navigation API entries for reactivation given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) newSHEs, and a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) reactivatedSHE:
1. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return.
2. Let newNHEs be a new empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
3. Let oldNHEs be a [clone](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure).
4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) newSHE of newSHEs:
   1. Let newNHE be null.
   2. If oldNHEs [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) matchingOldNHE whose [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is newSHE:
      1. Set newNHE to matchingOldNHE.
      2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) matchingOldNHE from oldNHEs.
   3. Otherwise:
      1. Set newNHE to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) created in the [relevant realm](#81334-relevant) of navigation.
      2. Set newNHE's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) to newSHE.
   4. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) newNHE to newNHEs.

   > [!note]
   > newSHEs will have originally come from [getting session history entries for the navigation API](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history), and thus each newSHE will be contiguous [same](#711-origins) [origin](#7412-document-state) with reactivatedSHE.

   > [!note]
   > By the end of this loop, all [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)s that remain in oldNHEs represent [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) which have been disposed while the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was in [bfcache](#7412-document-state).

5. Set navigation's [entry list](#410224-constructing-the-entry-list) to newNHEs.
6. Set navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) to the result of [getting the navigation API entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) of reactivatedSHE within navigation.
7. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to run the following steps:
   1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) disposedNHE of oldNHEs:
      1. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`dispose`](#events) at disposedNHE.

   > [!note]
   > We delay these steps by a task to ensure that [`dispose`](#events) events will fire after the [`pageshow`](#events) event. This ensures that [`pageshow`](#events) is the first event a page receives upon [reactivation](#7462-updating-the-document).
   > 
   > (However, the rest of this algorithm runs before the [`pageshow`](#events) event fires. This ensures that [`navigation.entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) and [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) will have correctly-updated values during any [`pageshow`](#events) event handlers.)

To update the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) destinationSHE, and a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) navigationType:
1. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return.
2. Let oldCurrentNHE be the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation.
3. Let disposedNHEs be a new empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
4. If navigationType is "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)":
   1. Set navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) to the result of [getting the navigation API entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) of destinationSHE within navigation.
   2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is not −1.

   > [!note]
   > This algorithm is only called for same-document traversals. Cross-document traversals will instead call either [initialize the navigation API entries for a new document](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) or [update the navigation API entries for reactivation](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list).

5. Otherwise, if navigationType is "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)":
   1. Set navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) to navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) + 1.
   2. Let i be navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure).
   3. [While](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration) i < navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)'s [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists):
      1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[i\] to disposedNHEs.
      2. Set i to i + 1.
   4. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) all items in disposedNHEs from navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure).
6. Otherwise, if navigationType is "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)":
   1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) oldCurrentNHE to disposedNHEs.
7. If navigationType is "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)":
   1. Let newNHE be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) created in the [relevant realm](#81334-relevant) of navigation.
   2. Set newNHE's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) to destinationSHE.
   3. Set navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[navigation's [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure)\] to newNHE.
8. If navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is non-null, then [notify about the committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) given navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) and the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation.

   > [!note]
