   > It is important to do this before firing the [`dispose`](#events) or [`currententrychange`](#events) events, since event handlers could start another navigation, or otherwise change the value of navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

9. Let navigateEvent be navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
10. Let apiMethodTracker be navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
11. [Prepare to run script](#8144-calling-scripts) given navigation's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).

    > [!note]
    > See [the discussion for other navigation API events](#726104-firing-the-event) to understand why we do this.

12. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`currententrychange`](#events) at navigation using [`NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface), with its [`navigationType`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) attribute initialized to navigationType and its [`from`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) initialized to oldCurrentNHE.
13. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) disposedNHE of disposedNHEs:
    1. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`dispose`](#events) at disposedNHE.
14. Run the [navigate event intercept commit handler steps](#726104-firing-the-event) given navigation, navigateEvent, and apiMethodTracker.
15. [Clean up after running script](#8144-calling-scripts) given navigation's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).

> [!warning]
> In implementations, same-document navigations can cause [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) to be disposed by falling off the back of the session history entry list. This is not yet handled by the above algorithm (or by any other part of this standard). See [issue #8620](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8620) to track progress on defining the correct behavior in such cases.

##### 7.2.6.5 The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationHistoryEntry : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute USVString? url;
  readonly attribute DOMString key;
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute long long index;
  readonly attribute boolean sameDocument;

  any getState();

  attribute EventHandler ondispose;
};
```

`entry.url`

The URL of this navigation history entry.

This can return null if the entry corresponds to a different [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) than the current one (i.e., if [`sameDocument`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is false), and that [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was fetched with a [referrer policy](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy) of "`no-referrer`" or "`origin`", since that indicates the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) in question is hiding its URL even from other same-origin pages.

`entry.key`

A user agent-generated random UUID string representing this navigation history entry's place in the navigation history list. This value will be reused by other [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) instances that replace this one due to "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, and will survive reloads and session restores.

This is useful for navigating back to this entry in the navigation history list, using [`navigation.traverseTo(key)`](#7267-initiating-navigations).

`entry.id`

A user agent-generated random UUID string representing this specific navigation history entry. This value will *not* be reused by other [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) instances. This value will survive reloads and session restores.

This is useful for associating data with this navigation history entry using other storage APIs.

`entry.index`

The index of this [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) within [`navigation.entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list), or −1 if the entry is not in the navigation history entry list.

`entry.sameDocument`

Indicates whether or not this navigation history entry is for the same [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) as the current one, or not. This will be true, for example, when the entry represents a fragment navigation or single-page app navigation.

`entry.getState()`

Returns the [deserialization](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--) of the state stored in this entry, which was added to the entry using [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) or [`navigation.updateCurrentEntry()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list). This state survives reloads and session restores.

Note that in general, unless the state value is a primitive, `entry.getState() !== entry.getState()`, since a fresh deserialization is returned each time.

This state is unrelated to the classic history API's [`history.state`](#725-the-history-interface).

Each [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) has an associated session history entry, which is a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries).

The key of a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) nhe is given by the return value of the following algorithm:
1. If nhe's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return the empty string.
2. Return nhe's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries).

The ID of a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) nhe is given by the return value of the following algorithm:
1. If nhe's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return the empty string.
2. Return nhe's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API ID](#7411-session-history-entries).

The index of a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) nhe is given by the return value of the following algorithm:
1. If nhe's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return −1.
2. Return the result of [getting the navigation API entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) within [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).

The `url` getter steps are:
1. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return the empty string.
3. Let she be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).
4. If she's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) does not equal document, and she's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [request referrer policy](#7412-document-state) is "`no-referrer`" or "`origin`", then return null.
5. Return she's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer).

The `key` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [key](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `id` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [ID](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `index` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [index](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `sameDocument` getter steps are:
1. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return false.
3. Return true if [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [document](#7411-session-history-entries) equals document, and false otherwise.

The `getState()` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return undefined.
2. Return [StructuredDeserialize](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--)([this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries)). Rethrow any exceptions.

   > [!note]
   > This can in theory throw an exception, if attempting to deserialize a large [`ArrayBuffer`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-ArrayBuffer) when not enough memory is available.

The following are the [event handlers](#8181-event-handlers) (and their corresponding [event handler event types](#8181-event-handlers)) that must be supported, as [event handler IDL attributes](#8181-event-handlers), by all objects implementing the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) interface:

| [Event handler](#8181-event-handlers) | [Event handler event type](#8181-event-handlers) |
| --- | --- |
| `ondispose` | [`dispose`](#events) |

##### 7.2.6.6 The history entry list

`entries = navigation.entries()`

Returns an array of [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) instances represent the current navigation history entry list, i.e., all [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) for this [navigable](#731-navigables) that are [same origin](#711-origins) and contiguous to the [current session history entry](#731-navigables).

`navigation.currentEntry`

Returns the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) corresponding to the [current session history entry](#731-navigables).

`navigation.updateCurrentEntry({ state })`

Updates the [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [current session history entry](#731-navigables), without performing a navigation like [`navigation.reload()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) would do.

This method is best used to capture updates to the page that have already happened, and need to be reflected into the navigation API state. For cases where the state update is meant to drive a page update, instead use [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) or [`navigation.reload()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), which will trigger a [`navigate`](#events) event.

`navigation.canGoBack`

Returns true if the current [current session history entry](#731-navigables) (i.e., [`currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list)) is not the first one in the navigation history entry list (i.e., in [`entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list)). This means that there is a previous [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) for this [navigable](#731-navigables), and its [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state) is [same origin](#711-origins) with the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).

`navigation.canGoForward`

Returns true if the current [current session history entry](#731-navigables) (i.e., [`currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list)) is not the last one in the navigation history entry list (i.e., in [`entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list)). This means that there is a next [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) for this [navigable](#731-navigables), and its [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state) is [same origin](#711-origins) with the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).

The `entries()` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return the empty list.
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure).

   > [!note]
   > Recall that because of Web IDL's sequence type conversion rules, this will create a new JavaScript array object on each call. That is, `navigation.entries() !== navigation.entries()`.

The `currentEntry` getter steps are to return the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).

The `updateCurrentEntry(options)` method steps are:
1. Let current be the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).
2. If current is null, then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Let serializedState be [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\]), rethrowing any exceptions.
4. Set current's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries) to serializedState.
5. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`currententrychange`](#events) at [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) using [`NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface), with its [`navigationType`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) attribute initialized to null and its [`from`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) initialized to current.

The `canGoBack` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return false.
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is not −1.
3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is 0, then return false.
4. Return true.

The `canGoForward` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then return false.
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is not −1.
3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is equal to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)'s [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) − 1, then return false.
4. Return true.

##### 7.2.6.7 Initiating navigations

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.navigate(url)`

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.navigate(url, options)`

[Navigates](#7422-beginning-navigation) the current page to the given url. options can contain the following values:
- [`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)" to replace the current session history entry, instead of pushing a new one.
- [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to any value; it will populate the [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) property of the corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
- [`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to any [serializable](#271-serializable-objects) value; it will populate the state retrieved by [`navigation.currentEntry.getState()`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) once the navigation completes, for same-document navigations. (It will be ignored for navigations that end up cross-document.)

By default this will perform a full navigation (i.e., a cross-document navigation, unless the given URL differs only in a [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) from the current one). The [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method can be used to convert it into a same-document navigation.

The returned promises will behave as follows:
- For navigations that get aborted, both promises will reject with an ["`AbortError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
- For same-document navigations created by using the [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method, [`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill after the navigation commits, and [`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill or reject according to any promsies returned by handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
- For other same-document navigations (e.g., non-intercepted [fragment navigations](#74233-fragment-navigations)), both promises will fulfill immediately.
- For cross-document navigations, or navigations that result in 204 or 205 [statuses](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) or \`[`Content-Disposition: attachment`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html)\` header fields from the server (and thus do not actually navigate), both promises will never settle.

In all cases, when the returned promises fulfill, it will be with the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) that was navigated to.

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.reload(options)`

[Reloads](#743-reloading-and-traversing) the current page. options can contain [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) and [`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface), which behave as described above.

The default behavior of performing a from-network-or-cache reload of the current page can be overriden by the using the [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method. Doing so will mean this call only updates state or passes along the appropriate [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface), plus performing whater actions the [`navigate`](#events) event handlers see fit to carry out.

The returned promises will behave as follows:
- If the reload is intercepted by using the [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method, [`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill after the navigation commits, and [`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill or reject according to any promsies returned by handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
- Otherwise, both promises will never settle.

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.traverseTo(key)`

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.traverseTo(key, { info })`

[Traverses](#7461-updating-the-traversable) to the closest [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that matches the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) with the given key. [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to any value; it will populate the [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) property of the corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

If a traversal to that [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) is already in progress, then this will return the promises for that original traversal, and [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) will be ignored.

The returned promises will behave as follows:
- If there is no [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) in [`navigation.entries()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) whose [`key`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) matches key, both promises will reject with an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
- For same-document traversals intercepted by the [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method, [`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill as soon as the traversal is processed and [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) is updated, and [`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) will fulfill or reject according to any promsies returned by the handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
- For non-intercepted same-document travesals, both promises will fulfill as soon as the traversal is processed and [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) is updated.
- For cross-document traversals, including attempted cross-document traversals that end up resulting in a 204 or 205 [statuses](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) or \`[`Content-Disposition: attachment`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html)\` header fields from the server (and thus do not actually traverse), both promises will never settle.

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.back(key)`

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.back(key, { info })`

Traverses to the closest previous [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) which results in this [navigable](#731-navigables) traversing, i.e., which corresponds to a different [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) and thus will cause [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) to change. [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to any value; it will populate the [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) property of the corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

If a traversal to that [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) is already in progress, then this will return the promises for that original traversal, and [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) will be ignored.

The returned promises behave equivalently to those returned by [`traverseTo()`](#7267-initiating-navigations).

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.forward(key)`

`{ committed, finished } = navigation.forward(key, { info })`

Traverses to the closest forward [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) which results in this [navigable](#731-navigables) traversing, i.e., which corresponds to a different [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) and thus will cause [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) to change. [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) can be set to any value; it will populate the [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) property of the corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

If a traversal to that [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) is already in progress, then this will return the promises for that original traversal, and [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) will be ignored.

The returned promises behave equivalently to those returned by [`traverseTo()`](#7267-initiating-navigations).

The `navigate(url, options)` method steps are:
1. Let urlRecord be the result of [parsing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given url, relative to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).
2. If urlRecord is failure, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. If urlRecord's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is "[`javascript`](#74232-the-javascript-url-special-case)", then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for a ["`NotSupportedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
5. If options\["[`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\] is "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", and [the navigation must be a replace](#7421-supporting-concepts) given urlRecord and document, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for a ["`NotSupportedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
6. Let state be options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\], if it [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps); otherwise, undefined.
7. Let serializedState be [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(state). If this throws an exception, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for that exception.

   > [!note]
   > It is important to perform this step early, since serialization can invoke web developer code, which in turn might change various things we check in later steps.

8. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
9. If document's [unload counter](#759-unloading-documents) is greater than 0, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
10. Let info be options\["[`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\], if it [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps); otherwise, undefined.
11. Let apiMethodTracker be the result of [setting up a navigate/reload API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given info and serializedState.
12. [Navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) document's [node navigable](#731-navigables) to urlRecord using document, with *[historyHandling](#7422-beginning-navigation)* set to options\["[`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\], *[navigationAPIState](#7422-beginning-navigation)* set to serializedState, and *[apiMethodTracker](#7422-beginning-navigation)* set to apiMethodTracker.

    > [!note]
    > Unlike [`location.assign()`](#724-the-location-interface) and friends, which are exposed across [origin-domain](#711-origins) boundaries, [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) can only be accessed by code with direct synchronous access to the [`window.navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) property. Thus, we avoid the complications about attributing the source document of the navigation, and we don't need to deal with the [allowed by sandboxing to navigate](#7424-preventing-navigation) check and its acccompanying *[exceptionsEnabled](#7422-beginning-navigation)* flag. We just treat all navigations as if they come from the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) corresponding to this [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) object itself (i.e., document).

13. Return a [navigation API method tracker-derived result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for apiMethodTracker.

The `reload(options)` method steps are:
1. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. Let serializedState be [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(undefined).
3. If options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set serializedState to [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\]). If this throws an exception, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for that exception.

   > [!note]
   > It is important to perform this step early, since serialization can invoke web developer code, which in turn might change various things we check in later steps.

4. Otherwise:
   1. Let current be the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).
   2. If current is not null, then set serializedState to current's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries).
5. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
6. If document's [unload counter](#759-unloading-documents) is greater than 0, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
7. Let info be options\["[`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\], if it [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps); otherwise, undefined.
8. Let apiMethodTracker be the result of [setting up a navigate/reload API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given info and serializedState.
9. [Reload](#743-reloading-and-traversing) document's [node navigable](#731-navigables) with *[navigationAPIState](#743-reloading-and-traversing)* set to serializedState and *[apiMethodTracker](#743-reloading-and-traversing)* set to apiMethodTracker.
10. Return a [navigation API method tracker-derived result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for apiMethodTracker.

The `traverseTo(key, options)` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is −1, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure) does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) whose [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries) equals key, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. Return the result of [performing a navigation API traversal](#7267-initiating-navigations) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), key, and options.

The `back(options)` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is −1 or 0, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Let key be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) − 1\]'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries).
3. Return the result of [performing a navigation API traversal](#7267-initiating-navigations) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), key, and options.

The `forward(options)` method steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) is −1 or is equal to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)'s [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) − 1, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Let key be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [current entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) + 1\]'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries).
3. Return the result of [performing a navigation API traversal](#7267-initiating-navigations) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this), key, and options.

To perform a navigation API traversal given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a string key, and a [`NavigationOptions`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) options:
1. Let document be navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. If document's [unload counter](#759-unloading-documents) is greater than 0, then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. Let current be the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation.
5. If key equals current's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries), then return «\[ "[`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → [a promise resolved with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-resolved-with) current, "[`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → [a promise resolved with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-resolved-with) current \]».
6. If navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[key\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then return a [navigation API method tracker-derived result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[key\].
7. Let info be options\["[`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\], if it [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps); otherwise, undefined.
8. Let apiMethodTracker be the result of [adding an upcoming traverse API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for navigation given key and info.
9. Let navigable be document's [node navigable](#731-navigables).
10. Let traversable be navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).
11. Let sourceSnapshotParams be the result of [snapshotting source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) given document.
12. [Append the following session history traversal steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) to traversable:
    1. Let navigableSHEs be the result of [getting session history entries](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) given navigable.
    2. Let targetSHE be the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) in navigableSHEs whose [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries) is key. If no such entry exists:
       1. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
       2. Abort these steps.

       > [!note]
       > This path is taken if navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure) was outdated compared to navigableSHEs, which can occur for brief periods while all the relevant threads and processes are being synchronized in reaction to a history change.

    3. If targetSHE is navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables):
       1. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
       2. Abort these steps.

       > [!note]
       > This can occur if a previously [queued](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) traversal already took us to this [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries).

    4. Let result be the result of [applying the traverse history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given by targetSHE's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) to traversable, given sourceSnapshotParams, navigable, and "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
    5. If result is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", then [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with a new ["`AbortError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
    6. If result is "`initiator-disallowed`", then [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with a new ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).

       > [!note]
       > When result is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`" or "`initiator-disallowed`", the [`navigate`](#events) event was never fired, [aborting the ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) would not be correct; it would result in a [`navigateerror`](#events) event without a preceding [`navigate`](#events) event.
       > 
       > In the "`canceled-by-navigate`" case, [`navigate`](#events) *is* fired, but the [inner `navigate` event firing algorithm](#726104-firing-the-event) will take care of [aborting the ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

13. Return a [navigation API method tracker-derived result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for apiMethodTracker.

An early error result for an exception e is a [`NavigationResult`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) dictionary instance given by «\[ "[`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → [a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) e, "[`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → [a promise rejected with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with) e \]».

To compute the navigation API method tracker-derived result for a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)-or-null apiMethodTracker:
1. If apiMethodTracker is [pending](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking), then return an [early error result](#7267-initiating-navigations) for an ["`AbortError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. Return a [`NavigationResult`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) dictionary instance given by «\[ "[`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → apiMethodTracker's [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking), "[`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)" → apiMethodTracker's [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) \]».

##### 7.2.6.8 Ongoing navigation tracking

During any given navigation (in the [broad sense of the word](#7263-core-infrastructure)), the [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) object needs to keep track of the following:

For all navigations

| State | Duration | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) | For the duration of event firing | So that if the navigation is canceled while the event is firing, we can [cancel](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) the event |
| The event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) have settled | So that if the navigation is canceled, we can [signal abort](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) |
| Whether a new element was [focused](#664-processing-model) | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) have settled | So that if one was, focus is not [reset](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) |
| The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) being navigated to | From when it is determined, until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) have settled | So that we know what to resolve any [`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) and [`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) promises with |
| Any [`finished`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) promise that was returned | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) have settled | So that we can resolve or reject it appropriately |

For non-"[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations

| State | Duration | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Any [`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) | For the duration of event firing | So that we can update the current entry's [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries) if the event finishes firing without being [canceled](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) |

For "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations

| State | Duration | Explanation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Any [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) | Until the task is queued to fire the [`navigate`](#events) event | So that we can use it to fire the [`navigate`](#events) after the trip through the [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables). |
| Any [`committed`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) promise that was returned | Until the session history is updated (inside that same task) | So that we can resolve or reject it appropriately |
| Whether [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) was called | Until the session history is updated (inside that same task) | So that we can suppress the normal scroll restoration logic in favor of the behavior given by the [`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option |

We also cannot assume there is only a single navigation requested at any given time, due to web developer code such as:

```javascript
const p1 = navigation.navigate(url1).finished;
const p2 = navigation.navigate(url2).finished;
```

That is, in this scenario, we need to ensure that while navigating to `url2`, we still have the promise `p1` around so that we can reject it. We can't just get rid of any ongoing navigation promises the moment the second call to [`navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) happens.

We end up accomplishing all this by associating the following with each [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface):
- Ongoing `navigate` event, a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) or null, initially null.
- Focus changed during ongoing navigation, a boolean, initially false.
- Suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation, a boolean, initially false.
- Ongoing API method tracker, a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) or null, initially null.
- Upcoming traverse API method trackers, an [ordered map](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) from strings to [navigation API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking), initially empty.

> [!note]
> The state here that is not stored in [navigation API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is state which needs to be tracked even for navigations that are not initiated via navigation API methods.

A navigation API method tracker is a [struct](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs) with the following [items](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs):
- A navigation object, a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)
- A key, a string or null
- An info, a JavaScript value
- A serialized state, a [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries) or null
- A committed-to entry, a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) or null
- A committed promise, a promise
- A finished promise, a promise
- A pending, a boolean.

All this state is then managed via the following algorithms.

To set up a navigate/reload API method tracker given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a JavaScript value info, and a [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries)-or-null serializedState:
1. Let committedPromise and finishedPromise be new promises created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
2. [Mark as handled](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled) finishedPromise.

   > [!note]
   > The web developer doesn’t necessarily care about finishedPromise being rejected:
   > - They might only care about committedPromise.
   > - They could be doing multiple synchronous navigations within the same task, in which case all but the last will be aborted (causing their finishedPromise to reject). This could be an application bug, but also could just be an emergent feature of disparate parts of the application overriding each others' actions.
   > - They might prefer to listen to other transition-failure signals instead of finishedPromise, e.g., the [`navigateerror`](#events) event, or the [`navigation.transition.finished`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) promise.
   > 
   > As such, we mark it as handled to ensure that it never triggers [`unhandledrejection`](#events) events.

3. Return a new [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with:

   [navigation object](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   navigation

   [key](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   null

   [info](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   info

   [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   serializedState

   [committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   null

   [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   committedPromise

   [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   finishedPromise

   [pending](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   false if navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure); otherwise true

To add an upcoming traverse API method tracker given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a string destinationKey, and a JavaScript value info:
1. Let committedPromise and finishedPromise be new promises created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
2. [Mark as handled](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled) finishedPromise.

   > [!note]
   > See the [previous discussion](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) about why this is done.

3. Let apiMethodTracker be a new [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with:

   [navigation object](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   navigation

   [key](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   destinationKey

   [info](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   info

   [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   null

   [committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   null

   [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   committedPromise

   [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   finishedPromise

   [pending](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

   false

4. Set navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[destinationKey\] to apiMethodTracker.
5. Return apiMethodTracker.

To clean up a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker:
1. Let navigation be apiMethodTracker's [navigation object](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
2. If navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is apiMethodTracker, then set navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.
3. Otherwise:
   1. Let key be apiMethodTracker's [key](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
   2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): key is not null.
   3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[key\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
   4. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[key\].

To notify about the committed-to entry given a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker and a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) nhe:
1. Set apiMethodTracker's [committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to nhe.
2. If apiMethodTracker's [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is not null, then set nhe's [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries) to apiMethodTracker's [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

   > [!note]
   > If it's null, then we're traversing to nhe via [`navigation.traverseTo()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), which does not allow changing the state.

   > [!note]
   > At this point, apiMethodTracker's [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is no longer needed. Implementations might want to clear it out to avoid keeping it alive for the lifetime of the [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

3. Resolve apiMethodTracker's [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with nhe.

   > [!note]
   > At this point, apiMethodTracker's [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is only needed in cases where it has not yet been returned to author code. Implementations might want to clear it out to avoid keeping it alive for the lifetime of the [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

To resolve the finished promise for a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): apiMethodTracker's [committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is not null.
2. Resolve apiMethodTracker's [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with its [committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
3. [Clean up](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker.

To reject the finished promise for a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker with a JavaScript value exception:
1. Reject apiMethodTracker's [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with exception.

   > [!note]
   > This will do nothing if apiMethodTracker's [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) was previously resolved via [notify about the committed-to entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

2. Reject apiMethodTracker's [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with exception.
3. [Clean up](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker.

To abort the ongoing navigation given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation and an optional [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) error:
1. Let event be navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event is not null.
3. Set navigation's [focus changed during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
4. Set navigation's [suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
5. If error was not given, then let error be a new ["`AbortError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
6. If event's [dispatch flag](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) is set, then set event's [canceled flag](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) to true.
7. [Abort](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) event given error.

To abort a `NavigateEvent` event given reason:
1. Let navigation be event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
2. Set navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.
3. [Signal abort](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) on event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) given reason.
4. Let errorInfo be the result of [extracting error information](#8146-runtime-script-errors) from reason.

   > [!note]
   > For example, if this algorithm is reached because of a call to [`window.stop()`](#7221-opening-and-closing-windows), these properties would probably end up initialized based on the line of script that called [`window.stop()`](#7221-opening-and-closing-windows). But if it's because the user clicked the stop button, these properties would probably end up with default values like the empty string or 0.

5. If navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is non-null, then [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with reason.
6. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`navigateerror`](#events) at navigation using [`ErrorEvent`](#8146-runtime-script-errors), with additional attributes initialized according to errorInfo.
7. If navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is null, then return.
8. Reject navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with reason.
9. Reject navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with reason.
10. Set navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.

To inform the navigation API about aborting navigation in a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable:
1. If this algorithm is running on navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [relevant agent](#8121-integration-with-the-javascript-agent-formalism)'s [event loop](#8171-definitions), then continue on to the following steps. Otherwise, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run the following steps.
2. Let navigation be navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
3. [While](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration) navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is not null:
   1. [Abort the ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) given navigation.

   > [!note]
   > If there is an ongoing cross-document navigation, this means it will be signaled to the navigation API as aborted, e.g., by firing [`navigateerror`](#events) events. This is somewhat accurate, since the next navigation the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) experiences will be this same-document navigation, so a developer which was expecting the next navigation completion to be that of the cross-document navigation gets a useful signal that this did not happen. However, it is also somewhat inaccurate, as the browser will continue to process the ongoing cross-document navigation (applying it after this same-document one synchronously finishes).
   > 
   > Ultimately, the navigation API gets a bit messy with overlapping cross- and same-document navigations, as the [ongoing navigation tracking](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) machinery and APIs are built to expose only a single ongoing navigation. Web developers will be best-served if they do not create such overlapping situations, e.g., by `await`ing promises returned from [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) before starting new navigations.

   > [!note]
   > This is a loop, since [abort the ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) can run JavaScript (e.g., via the [`navigateerror`](#events) event), which might start a new navigation. Since such a newly-started navigation will be superseded by the completion of this navigation, it gets signaled to the navigation API as aborted.

To inform the navigation API about child navigable destruction given a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable:
1. [Inform the navigation API about aborting navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) in navigable.
2. Let navigation be navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
3. Let traversalAPIMethodTrackers be a [clone](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) apiMethodTracker of traversalAPIMethodTrackers: [reject the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker with a new ["`AbortError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).

---

The ongoing navigation concept is most-directly exposed to web developers through the [`navigation.transition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) property, which is an instance of the [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) interface:

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationTransition {
  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry from;
  readonly attribute NavigationDestination to;
  readonly attribute Promise<undefined> committed;
  readonly attribute Promise<undefined> finished;
};
```

`navigation.transition`

A [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) representing any ongoing navigation that hasn't yet reached the [`navigatesuccess`](#events) or [`navigateerror`](#events) stage, if one exists; or null, if there is no such transition ongoing.

Since [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) (and other properties like [`location.href`](#724-the-location-interface)) are updated immediately upon navigation, this [`navigation.transition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) property is useful for determining when such navigations are not yet fully settled, according to any handlers passed to [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

`navigation.transition.navigationType`

One of "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", indicating what type of navigation this transition is for.

`navigation.transition.from`

The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) from which the transition is coming. This can be useful to compare against [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list).

`navigation.transition.to`

The [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) of the transition. This can be useful as a way to reflect a current navigation's destination's [`url`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) without having to listen to the [`navigate`](#events) event.

`navigation.transition.committed`

A promise which fulfills once the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) and [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) change. This occurs after all of its [precommit handlers](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) are fulfilled. The promise rejects if one or more of the [precommit handlers](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) rejects.

`navigation.transition.finished`

A promise which fulfills at the same time as the [`navigatesuccess`](#events) fires, or rejects at the same time the [`navigateerror`](#events) event fires.

Each [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) has a transition, which is a [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) or null, initially null.

The `transition` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) has an associated navigation type, which is a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) has an associated from entry, which is a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) has an associated destination, which is a [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) has an associated committed promise, which is a promise.

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) has an associated finished promise, which is a promise.

The `navigationType` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [navigation type](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

The `from` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [from entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

The `to` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [destination](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

The `committed` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

The `finished` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

##### 7.2.6.9 The [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationActivation {
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry? from;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry entry;
  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
};
```

`navigation.activation`

A [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) containing information about the most recent cross-document navigation, the navigation that "activated" this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

While [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) and the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) can be updated regularly due to same-document navigations, [`navigation.activation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) stays constant, and its properties are only updated if the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) is [reactivated](#7462-updating-the-document) from history.

`navigation.activation.entry`

A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), equivalent to the value of the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) property at the moment the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was activated.

`navigation.activation.from`

A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), representing the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) that was active right before the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object). This will have a value null in case the previous [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was not [same origin](#711-origins) with this one or if it was the [initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

There are some cases in which either the [`from`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) or [`entry`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) objects would not be viable targets for the [`traverseTo()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) method, as they might not be retained in history. For example, the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) can be activated using [`location.replace()`](#724-the-location-interface) or its initial entry could be replaced by [`history.replaceState()`](#725-the-history-interface). However, those entries' [`url`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) property and [`getState()`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) method are still accessible.

`navigation.activation.navigationType`

One of "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", indicating what type of navigation activated this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

Each [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) has an associated activation, which is null or a [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) object, initially null.

Each [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) has:
- old entry, null or a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).
- new entry, null or a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).
- navigation type, a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure).

The `activation` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [activation](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface).

The `from` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [old entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface).

The `entry` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [new entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface).

The `navigationType` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [navigation type](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface).

##### 7.2.6.10 The [`navigate`](#events) event

A major feature of the navigation API is the [`navigate`](#events) event. This event is fired on any navigation (in the [broad sense of the word](#7263-core-infrastructure)), allowing web developers to monitor such outgoing navigations. In many cases, the event is [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event), which allows preventing the navigation from happening. And in others, the navigation can be intercepted and replaced with a same-document navigation by using the [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method of the [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) class.

###### 7.2.6.10.1 The [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigateEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, NavigateEventInit eventInitDict);

  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationDestination destination;
  readonly attribute boolean canIntercept;
  readonly attribute boolean userInitiated;
  readonly attribute boolean hashChange;
  readonly attribute AbortSignal signal;
  readonly attribute FormData? formData;
  readonly attribute DOMString? downloadRequest;
  readonly attribute any info;
  readonly attribute boolean hasUAVisualTransition;
  readonly attribute Element? sourceElement;

  undefined intercept(optional NavigationInterceptOptions options = {});
  undefined scroll();
};

dictionary NavigateEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationType navigationType = "push";
  required NavigationDestination destination;
  boolean canIntercept = false;
  boolean userInitiated = false;
  boolean hashChange = false;
  required AbortSignal signal;
  FormData? formData = null;
  DOMString? downloadRequest = null;
  any info;
  boolean hasUAVisualTransition = false;
  Element? sourceElement = null;
};

dictionary NavigationInterceptOptions {
  NavigationPrecommitHandler precommitHandler;
  NavigationInterceptHandler handler;
  NavigationFocusReset focusReset;
  NavigationScrollBehavior scroll;
};

enum NavigationFocusReset {
  "after-transition",
  "manual"
};

enum NavigationScrollBehavior {
  "after-transition",
  "manual"
};

callback NavigationInterceptHandler = Promise<undefined> ();
```

`event.navigationType`

One of "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", indicating what type of navigation this is.

`event.destination`

A [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) representing the destination of the navigation.

`event.canIntercept`

True if [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) can be called to intercept this navigation and convert it into a same-document navigation, replacing its usual behavior; false otherwise.

Generally speaking, this will be true whenever the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [can have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to the destination URL, except for in the case of cross-document "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, where it will always be false.

`event.userInitiated`

True if this navigation was due to a user clicking on an [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element, submitting a [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element, or using the [browser UI](#79-browser-user-interface-considerations) to navigate; false otherwise.

`event.hashChange`

True for a [fragment navigation](#74233-fragment-navigations); false otherwise.

`event.signal`

An [`AbortSignal`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#32-interface-abortsignal) which will become aborted if the navigation gets canceled, e.g., by the user pressing their browser's "Stop" button, or by another navigation interrupting this one.

The expected pattern is for developers to pass this along to any async operations, such as [`fetch()`](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-global-fetch), which they perform as part of handling this navigation.

`event.formData`

The [`FormData`](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata) representing the submitted form entries for this navigation, if this navigation is a "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigation representing a POST [form submission](#410223-form-submission-algorithm); null otherwise.

(Notably, this will be null even for "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations that are revisiting a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that was originally created from a form submission.)

`event.downloadRequest`

Represents whether or not this navigation was requested to be a download, by using an [`a`](#451-the-a-element) or [`area`](#4813-the-area-element) element's [`download`](#462-links-created-by-a-and-area-elements) attribute:
- If a download was not requested, then this property is null.
- If a download was requested, returns the filename that was supplied as the [`download`](#462-links-created-by-a-and-area-elements) attribute's value. (This could be the empty string.)

Note that a download being requested does not always mean that a download will happen: for example, a download might be blocked by browser security policies, or end up being treated as a "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)" navigation for [unspecified reasons](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7718).

Similarly, a navigation might end up being a download even if it was not requested to be one, due to the destination server responding with a \`[`Content-Disposition: attachment`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html)\` header.

Finally, note that the [`navigate`](#events) event will not fire at all for downloads initiated using browser UI affordances, e.g., those created by right-clicking and choosing to save the target of a link.

`event.info`

An arbitrary JavaScript value passed via one of the [navigation API methods](#7267-initiating-navigations) which initiated this navigation, or undefined if the navigation was initiated by the user or by a different API.

`event.hasUAVisualTransition`

Returns true if the user agent performed a visual transition for this navigation before dispatching this event. If true, the best user experience will be given if the author synchronously updates the DOM to the post-navigation state.

`event.sourceElement`

Returns the [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) responsible for this navigation. This can be an [`a`](#451-the-a-element)or [`area`](#4813-the-area-element) element, a [submit button](#4102-categories), or a submitted [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element.

`event.intercept({ precommitHandler, handler, focusReset, scroll })`

Intercepts this navigation, preventing its normal handling and instead converting it into a same-document navigation of the same type to the destination URL.

The [`precommitHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option can be a function that accepts a [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) and returns a promise. The precommit handler function will run after the [`navigate`](#events) event has finished firing, but before the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) property has been updated. Returning a rejected promise will abort the navigation and its effect, such as updating the URL and session history. After all the precommit handlers are fulfilled, the navigation can proceed to commit and call the rest of the handlers. The [`precommitHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option can only be passed when the event is [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event): trying to pass a [`precommitHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to a non-cancelable [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) will throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

The [`handler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option can be a function that returns a promise. The handler function will run after the [`navigate`](#events) event has finished firing and the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) property has been updated. This returned promise is used to signal the duration, and success or failure, of the navigation. After it settles, the browser signals to the user (e.g., via a loading spinner UI, or assistive technology) that the navigation is finished. Additionally, it fires [`navigatesuccess`](#events) or [`navigateerror`](#events) events as appropriate, which other parts of the web application can respond to.

By default, using this method will cause focus to reset when any handlers' returned promises settle. Focus will be reset to the first element with the [`autofocus`](#667-the-autofocus-attribute) attribute set, or [the body element](#317-dom-tree-accessors) if the attribute isn't present. The [`focusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option can be set to "[`manual`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)" to avoid this behavior.

By default, using this method will delay the browser's scroll restoration logic for "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, or its scroll-reset/scroll-to-a-fragment logic for "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, until any handlers' returned promises settle. The [`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option can be set to "[`manual`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)" to turn off any browser-driven scroll behavior entirely for this navigation, or [`scroll()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) can be called before the promise settles to trigger this behavior early.

This method will throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if [`canIntercept`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is false, or if [`isTrusted`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) is false. It will throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if not called synchronously, during event dispatch.

`event.scroll()`

For "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, restores the scroll position using the browser's usual scroll restoration logic.

For "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, either resets the scroll position to the top of the document or scrolls to the [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) specified by [`destination.url`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) if there is one.

If called more than once, or called after automatic post-transition scroll processing has happened due to the [`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option being left as "[`after-transition`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", or called before the navigation has committed, this method will throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has an interception state, which is either "`none`", "`intercepted`", "`committed`", "`scrolled`", or "`finished`", initially "`none`".

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has a navigation precommit handler list, a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [`NavigationPrecommitHandler`](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) callbacks, initially empty.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has a navigation handler list, a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [`NavigationInterceptHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) callbacks, initially empty.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has a focus reset behavior, a [`NavigationFocusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)-or-null, initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has a scroll behavior, a [`NavigationScrollBehavior`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)-or-null, initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has an abort controller, an [`AbortController`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller)-or-null, initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) has a classic history API state, a [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries) or null.
