It is only used in some cases where the event's [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", and is set appropriately when the event is [fired](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events).

The `navigationType`, `destination`, `canIntercept`, `userInitiated`, `hashChange`, `signal`, `formData`, `downloadRequest`, `info`, `hasUAVisualTransition`, and `sourceElement` attributes must return the values they are initialized to.

The `intercept(options)` method steps are:
1. [Perform shared checks](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [`canIntercept`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) attribute was initialized to false, then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [dispatch flag](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) is unset, then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. If options\["[`precommitHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) attribute is initialized to false, then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
   2. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) options\["[`precommitHandler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\] to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [navigation precommit handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
5. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is either "`none`" or "`intercepted`".
6. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to "`intercepted`".
7. If options\["[`handler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) it to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [navigation handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).
8. If options\["[`focusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [focus reset behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not null, and it is not equal to options\["[`focusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\], then the user agent may [report a warning to the console](https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console) indicating that the [`focusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option for a previous call to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) was overridden by this new value, and the previous value will be ignored.
   2. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [focus reset behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to options\["[`focusReset`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\].
9. If options\["[`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [scroll behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not null, and it is not equal to options\["[`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\], then the user agent may [report a warning to the console](https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console) indicating that the [`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) option for a previous call to [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) was overridden by this new value, and the previous value will be ignored.
   2. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [scroll behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to options\["[`scroll`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)"\].

The `scroll()` method steps are:
1. [Perform shared checks](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).
2. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`committed`", then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. [Process scroll behavior](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).

To perform shared checks for a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event:
1. If event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
2. If event's [`isTrusted`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) attribute was initialized to false, then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
3. If event's [canceled flag](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) is set, then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

###### 7.2.6.10.2 The [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
  interface NavigationPrecommitController {
    undefined redirect(USVString url, optional NavigationNavigateOptions options = {});
    undefined addHandler(NavigationInterceptHandler handler);
  };

  callback NavigationPrecommitHandler = Promise<undefined> (NavigationPrecommitController controller);
```

`precommitController.redirect(USVString url, NavigationNavigateOptions options)`

For "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, sets the [`destination.url`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to url.

If options is given, also sets the [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) and the resulting [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to options's [`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) and [`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface), if they are present. The [`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) option can also switch between "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations types.

For "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) will be thrown.

If the current [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [cannot have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to url, a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) will be thrown.

`precommitController.addHandler(NavigationInterceptHandler handler)`

Adds a [NavigationInterceptHandler](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) callback that would be called once the navigation is committed, as if this method was passed to the [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method as a [`handler`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

Each [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) has a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event.

The `redirect(url,
  options)` method steps are:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`none`".
2. [Perform shared checks](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface).
3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`intercepted`", then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is neither "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" nor "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
5. Let document be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
6. Let destinationURL be the result of [parsing](#242-parsing-urls) url given document.
7. If destinationURL is failure, then throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
8. If document [cannot have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to destinationURL, then throw a ["`SecurityError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
9. If options\["[`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\] is "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)" or "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", then set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to options\["[`history`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\].
10. If options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
    1. Let serializedState be the result of calling [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(options\["[`state`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\]). This may throw an exception.
    2. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to serializedState.
    3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [target](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event)'s [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is non-null, then set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [target](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event)'s [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [serialized state](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to serializedState.
11. Set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationURL.
12. If options\["[`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to options\["[`info`](#7262-the-navigation-interface)"\].

The `addHandler(handler,)` method steps are:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`none`".
2. [Perform shared checks](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface).
3. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`intercepted`", then throw an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
4. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) handler to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface)'s [navigation handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

###### 7.2.6.10.3 The [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationDestination {
  readonly attribute USVString url;
  readonly attribute DOMString key;
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute long long index;
  readonly attribute boolean sameDocument;

  any getState();
};
```

`event.destination.url`

The URL being navigated to.

`event.destination.key`

The value of the [`key`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) property of the destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), if this is a "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigation, or the empty string otherwise.

`event.destination.id`

The value of the [`id`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) property of the destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), if this is a "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigation, or the empty string otherwise.

`event.destination.index`

The value of the [`index`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) property of the destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), if this is a "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigation, or −1 otherwise.

`event.destination.sameDocument`

Indicates whether or not this navigation is to the same [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) as the current one, or not. This will be true, for example, in the case of fragment navigations or [`history.pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) navigations.

Note that this property indicates the original nature of the navigation. If a cross-document navigation is converted into a same-document navigation using [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), that will not change the value of this property.

`event.destination.getState()`

For "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, returns the [deserialization](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--) of the state stored in the destination [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries).

For "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, returns the [deserialization](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--) of the state passed to [`navigation.navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), if the navigation was initiated by that method, or undefined it if it wasn't.

For "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigations, returns the [deserialization](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--) of the state passed to [`navigation.reload()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), if the reload was initiated by that method, or undefined it if it wasn't.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) has a URL, which is a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url).

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) has an entry, which is a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) or null.

> [!note]
> It will be non-null if and only if the [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) corresponds to a "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" navigation.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) has a state, which is a [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries).

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) has an is same document, which is a boolean.

---

The `url` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface), [serialized](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer).

The `key` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is null, then return the empty string.
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [key](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `id` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is null, then return the empty string.
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [ID](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `index` getter steps are:
1. If [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is null, then return −1.
2. Return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [index](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).

The `sameDocument` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface).

The `getState()` method steps are to return [StructuredDeserialize](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--)([this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)).

###### 7.2.6.10.4 Firing the event

Other parts of the standard fire the [`navigate`](#events) event, through a series of wrapper algorithms given in this section.

To fire a traverse `navigate` event at a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation given a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) destinationSHE and an optional [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement (default "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"):
1. Let event be the result of [creating an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#25-constructing-events) given [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
2. Set event's [classic history API state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to null.
3. Let destination be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
4. Set destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationSHE's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries).
5. Let destinationNHE be the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) in navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure) whose [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is destinationSHE, or null if no such [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) exists.
6. If destinationNHE is non-null:
   1. Set destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationNHE.
   2. Set destination's [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationSHE's [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries).
7. Otherwise,
   1. Set destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to null.
   2. Set destination's [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(null).
8. Set destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to true if destinationSHE's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is equal to navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object); otherwise false.
9. Return the result of performing the [inner `navigate` event firing algorithm](#726104-firing-the-event) given navigation, "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", event, destination, userInvolvement, null, null, and null.

To fire a push/replace/reload `navigate` event at a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation given a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) navigationType, a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) destinationURL, a boolean isSameDocument, an optional [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement (default "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"), an optional [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)-or-null sourceElement (default null), an optional [entry list](#410224-constructing-the-entry-list)-or-null formDataEntryList (default null), an optional [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries) navigationAPIState (default [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(null)), an optional [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries)-or-null classicHistoryAPIState (default null), and an optional [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)-or-null apiMethodTracker:
1. Let document be navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
2. [Inform the navigation API about aborting navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) in document's [node navigable](#731-navigables).
3. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), and apiMethodTracker is not null:
   1. Set apiMethodTracker's [pending](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
   2. Set apiMethodTracker to null.

   > [!note]
   > If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure), then [`navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) and [`reload()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) calls return promises that will never fulfill. We never create a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) object for such [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)s, there is no [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) to apply serializedState to, and there is no [`navigate`](#events) event to include info with. So, we don't need to track this API method call after all. We need to check this after aborting previous navigations, in case the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) has became non-[fully active](#733-fully-active-documents) as a result of a [`navigateerror`](#events) event.

4. If document is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return false.
5. Let event be the result of [creating an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#25-constructing-events) given [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
6. Set event's [classic history API state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to classicHistoryAPIState.
7. Let destination be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
8. Set destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationURL.
9. Set destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to null.
10. Set destination's [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to navigationAPIState.
11. Set destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to isSameDocument.
12. Return the result of performing the [inner `navigate` event firing algorithm](#726104-firing-the-event) given navigation, navigationType, event, destination, userInvolvement, sourceElement, formDataEntryList, null, and apiMethodTracker.

To fire a download request `navigate` event at a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation given a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) destinationURL, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, an [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)-or-null sourceElement, and a string filename:
1. Let event be the result of [creating an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#25-constructing-events) given [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
2. Set event's [classic history API state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to null.
3. Let destination be a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
4. Set destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to destinationURL.
5. Set destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to null.
6. Set destination's [state](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(null).
7. Set destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) to false.
8. Return the result of performing the [inner `navigate` event firing algorithm](#726104-firing-the-event) given navigation, "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", event, destination, userInvolvement, sourceElement, null, and filename.

The inner `navigate` event firing algorithm consists of the following steps, given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) navigationType, a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event, a [`NavigationDestination`](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) destination, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, an [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)-or-null sourceElement, an [entry list](#410224-constructing-the-entry-list)-or-null formDataEntryList, a string-or-null downloadRequestFilename, and an optional [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)-or-null apiMethodTracker (default null):
1. If navigation [has entries and events disabled](#7263-core-infrastructure):
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is null.
   2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) [is empty](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
   3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): apiMethodTracker is null.
   4. Return true.

   > [!note]
   > These assertions holds because [`traverseTo()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), [`back()`](#7267-initiating-navigations), and [`forward()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) will immediately fail when entries and events are disabled (since there are no entries to traverse to).

2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is null.
3. If destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is non-null:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): apiMethodTracker is null.

      > [!note]
      > apiMethodTracker is passed as an argument only for [`navigate()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) and [`reload()`](#7267-initiating-navigations) calls.

   2. Let destinationKey be destination's [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [key](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface).
   3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): destinationKey is not the empty string.
   4. If navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[destinationKey\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. Set apiMethodTracker to navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[destinationKey\].
      2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) navigation's [upcoming traverse API method trackers](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)\[destinationKey\].

4. If apiMethodTracker is not null:
   1. Set navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to apiMethodTracker.
   2. Set apiMethodTracker's [pending](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
5. Let navigable be navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object).
6. Let document be navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
7. If document [can have its URL rewritten](#725-the-history-interface) to destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface), and either destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is true or navigationType is not "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", then initialize event's [`canIntercept`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.
8. Let traverseCanBeCanceled be true if all of the following are true:
   - navigable is a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables);
   - destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is true; and
   - either userInvolvement is not "[`browser
          UI`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", or navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) has [history-action activation](#641-data-model).

   Otherwise, let it be false.

9. If either:
   - navigationType is not "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"; or
   - traverseCanBeCanceled is true,

   then initialize event's [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) to true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.

10. Initialize event's [`type`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) to "[`navigate`](#events)".
11. Initialize event's [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to navigationType.
12. Initialize event's [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to destination.
13. Initialize event's [`downloadRequest`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to downloadRequestFilename.
14. If apiMethodTracker is not null, then initialize event's [`info`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to apiMethodTracker's [info](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking). Otherwise, initialize it to undefined.

    > [!note]
    > At this point apiMethodTracker's [info](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is no longer needed and can be nulled out instead of keeping it alive for the lifetime of the [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

15. Initialize event's [`hasUAVisualTransition`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to true if a visual transition, to display a cached rendered state of the document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state), was done by the user agent. Otherwise, initialize it to false.
16. Initialize event's [`sourceElement`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to sourceElement.
17. Set event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`AbortController`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
18. Initialize event's [`signal`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [signal](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller).
19. Let currentURL be document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
20. If all of the following are true:
    - event's [classic history API state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is null;
    - destination's [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is true;
    - destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) [equals](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals) currentURL with [*exclude fragments*](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments) set to true; and
    - destination's [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) is not [identical to](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) currentURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment),

    then initialize event's [`hashChange`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.

    > [!note]
    > The first condition here means that [`hashChange`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) will be true for [fragment navigations](#74233-fragment-navigations), but false for cases like `history.pushState(undefined, "", "#fragment")`.

21. If userInvolvement is not "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", then initialize event's [`userInitiated`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.
22. If formDataEntryList is not null, then initialize event's [`formData`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`FormData`](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant), associated to formDataEntryList. Otherwise, initialize it to null.
23. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is null.
24. Set navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to event.
25. Set navigation's [focus changed during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
26. Set navigation's [suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
27. Let dispatchResult be the result of [dispatching](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#29-dispatching-events) event at navigation.
28. If dispatchResult is false:
    1. If navigationType is "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", then [consume history-action user activation](#642-processing-model) given navigation's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant).
    2. If event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [signal](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) is not [aborted](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#32-interface-abortsignal), then [abort the ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) given navigation.
    3. Return false.
29. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`none`":
    1. Let fromNHE be the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation.
    2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): fromNHE is not null.
    3. Set navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationTransition`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant), with

       [navigation type](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

       navigationType

       [from entry](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

       fromNHE

       [destination](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

       event's [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)

       [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

       a new promise created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant)

       [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)

       a new promise created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant)

    4. [Mark as handled](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled) navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

       > [!note]
       > See the [discussion about other finished promises](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to understand why this is done.

    5. [Mark as handled](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled) navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).

30. If event's [navigation precommit handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) [is empty](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) then [commit](#726104-firing-the-event) event given apiMethodTracker.
31. Otherwise:
    1. Let precommitController be a new [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) created in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant), whose [event](#726102-the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface) is event.
    2. Let precommitPromisesList be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
    3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) handler of event's [navigation precommit handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface):
       1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [invoking](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function) handler with « precommitController » to precommitPromisesList.
    4. [Wait for all](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all) precommitPromisesList with the following success steps: [commit](#726104-firing-the-event) event given apiMethodTracker, and the following failure step given reason: [process navigate event handler failure](#726104-firing-the-event) given event and reason.
32. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`none`", then return true.
33. Return false.

The navigate event intercept commit handler steps, given a [`Navigation`](#7262-the-navigation-interface) navigation, a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) object event, and a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker are as follows:
1. Let promisesList be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) handler of event's [navigation handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface):
   1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [invoking](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function) handler with an empty arguments list to promisesList.
3. If promisesList's [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) is 0, then set promisesList to « [a promise resolved with](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-resolved-with) undefined ».

   > [!note]
   > There is a subtle timing difference between how [waiting for all](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all) schedules its success and failure steps when given zero promises versus ≥1 promises. For most uses of [waiting for all](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all), this does not matter. However, with this API, there are so many events and promise handlers which could fire around the same time that the difference is pretty easily observable: it can cause the event/promise handler sequence to vary. (Some of the events and promises involved include: [`navigatesuccess`](#events) / [`navigateerror`](#events), [`currententrychange`](#events), [`dispose`](#events), apiMethodTracker's promises, and the [`navigation.transition.finished`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) promise.)

4. [Wait for all](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all) of promisesList, with the following success steps:
   1. If event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then abort these steps.
   2. If event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [signal](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) is [aborted](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#32-interface-abortsignal), then abort these steps.
   3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event equals navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
   4. Set navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.
   5. [Finish](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) event given true.
   6. If apiMethodTracker is non-null, then [resolve the finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) for apiMethodTracker.
   7. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`navigatesuccess`](#events) at navigation.
   8. If navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is not null, then resolve navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [finished promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with undefined.
   9. Set navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.

   and the following failure step given reason: [process navigate event handler failure](#726104-firing-the-event) given event and reason.

To commit a navigate event given a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) object event and a [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker:
1. Let navigation be event's [target](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event).
2. Let navigable be event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object).
3. If event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return.
4. If event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [signal](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) is [aborted](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#32-interface-abortsignal), then return.
5. Let endResultIsSameDocument be true if event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`none`" or event's [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [is same document](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface) is true.
6. [Prepare to run script](#8144-calling-scripts) given navigation's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).

   > [!note]
   > This is done to avoid the [JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack) becoming empty right after any [`currententrychange`](#events) event handlers run as a result of the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations) that could soon happen. If the stack were to become empty at that time, then it would immediately [perform a microtask checkpoint](#8173-processing-model), causing various promise fulfillment handlers to run interleaved with the event handlers and before any handlers passed to [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface). This is undesirable since it means promise handler ordering vs. [`currententrychange`](#events) event handler ordering vs. [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) handler ordering would be dependent on whether the navigation is happening with an empty [JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack) (e.g., because the navigation was user-initiated) or with a nonempty one (e.g., because the navigation was caused by a JavaScript API call).
   > 
   > By inserting an otherwise-unnecessary [JavaScript execution context](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-execution-contexts) onto the stack in this step, we essentially suppress the [perform a microtask checkpoint](#8173-processing-model) algorithm until later, thus ensuring that the sequence is always: [`currententrychange`](#events) event handlers, then [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) handlers, then promise handlers.

7. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`none`":
   1. Set event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to "`committed`".
   2. Switch on event's [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface):

      "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      Run the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations) given event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) and event's [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [URL](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface), with *[serializedData](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations)* set to event's [classic history API state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) and *[historyHandling](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations)* set to event's [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface).

      "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      [Update the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) given navigation, navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables), and "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)".

      "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"
      1. Set navigation's [suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to true.

         > [!note]
         > If event's [scroll behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) was set to "[`after-transition`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", then scroll restoration will happen as part of [finishing](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) the relevant [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface). Otherwise, there will be no scroll restoration. That is, no navigation which is intercepted by [`intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) goes through the normal scroll restoration process; scroll restoration for such navigations is either done manually, by the web developer, or is done after the transition.

      2. Let userInvolvement be "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
      3. If event's [`userInitiated`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is true, then set userInvolvement to "[`activation`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".

         > [!note]
         > At this point after interception, it is not consequential whether the activation was a result of browser UI.

      4. [Append the following session history traversal steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) to navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables):
         1. [Resume applying the traverse history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given event's [`destination`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [entry](#726103-the-navigationdestination-interface)'s [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface)'s [step](#7411-session-history-entries), navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables), and userInvolvement.

8. If navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is not null, then resolve navigation's [transition](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)'s [committed promise](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) with undefined.
9. If endResultIsSameDocument is false and apiMethodTracker is non-null, then [clean up](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) apiMethodTracker.
10. [Clean up after running script](#8144-calling-scripts) given navigation's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).

    > [!note]
    > Per the [previous note](#726104-firing-the-event), this stops suppressing any potential promise handler microtasks, causing them to run at this point or later.

To process navigate event handler failure given a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) object event and a reason:
1. If event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) is not [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents), then return.
2. If event's [abort controller](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)'s [signal](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#31-interface-abortcontroller) is [aborted](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#32-interface-abortsignal), then return.
3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event is event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface)'s [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
4. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`intercepted`", then [finish](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) event given false.
5. [Abort](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) event given reason.

###### 7.2.6.10.5 Scroll and focus behavior

By calling [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), web developers can suppress the normal scroll and focus behavior for same-document navigations, instead invoking cross-document navigation-like behavior at a later time. The algorithms in this section are called at those appropriate later points.

To finish a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event, given a boolean didFulfill:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is not "`finished`".
2. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`intercepted`":
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): didFulfill is false.
   2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event's [navigation precommit handler list](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) [is not empty](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).

      > [!note]
      > Only precommit handlers can cancel a navigation before it is committed.

   3. Set event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to "`finished`".
   4. Return.

3. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`none`", then return.
4. [Potentially reset the focus](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) given event.
5. If didFulfill is true, then [potentially process scroll behavior](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) given event.
6. Set event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to "`finished`".

To potentially reset the focus given a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`committed`" or "`scrolled`".
2. Let navigation be event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
3. Let focusChanged be navigation's [focus changed during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking).
4. Set navigation's [focus changed during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to false.
5. If focusChanged is true, then return.
6. If event's [focus reset behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "[`manual`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", then return.

   > [!note]
   > If it was left as null, then we treat that as "[`after-transition`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", and continue onward.

7. Let document be event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
8. Let focusTarget be the [autofocus delegate](#664-processing-model) for document.
9. If focusTarget is null, then set focusTarget to document's [body element](#317-dom-tree-accessors).
10. If focusTarget is null, then set focusTarget to document's [document element](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#421-document-tree).
11. Run the [focusing steps](#664-processing-model) for focusTarget, with document's [viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport) as the *fallback target*.
12. Move the [sequential focus navigation starting point](#665-sequential-focus-navigation) to focusTarget.

To potentially process scroll behavior given a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`committed`" or "`scrolled`".
2. If event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`scrolled`", then return.
3. If event's [scroll behavior](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "[`manual`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", then return.

   > [!note]
   > If it was left as null, then we treat that as "[`after-transition`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface)", and continue onward.

4. [Process scroll behavior](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) given event.

To process scroll behavior given a [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) event:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) is "`committed`".
2. Set event's [interception state](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) to "`scrolled`".
3. If event's [`navigationType`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) was initialized to "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", then [restore scroll position data](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) given event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigable](#722-the-window-object)'s [active session history entry](#731-navigables).
4. Otherwise:
   1. Let document be event's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object).
   2. If document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is null, then [scroll to the beginning of the document](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document) given document. [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#references)
   3. Otherwise, [scroll to the fragment](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) given document.

#### 7.2.7 Event interfaces

> [!note]
> The [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) interface has [its own dedicated section](#72610-the-navigate-event), due to its complexity.

##### 7.2.7.1 The [`NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEventInit eventInitDict);

  readonly attribute NavigationType? navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry from;
};

dictionary NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationType? navigationType = null;
  required NavigationHistoryEntry from;
};
```

`event.navigationType`

Returns the type of navigation which caused the current entry to change, or null if the change is due to [`navigation.updateCurrentEntry()`](#7266-the-history-entry-list).

`event.from`

Returns the previous value of [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list), before the current entry changed.

If [`navigationType`](#7271-the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface) is null or "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", then this value will be the same as [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list). In that case, the event signifies that the contents of the entry changed, even if we did not move to a new entry or replace the current one.

The `navigationType` and `from` attributes must return the values they were initialized to.

##### 7.2.7.2 The [`PopStateEvent`](#7272-the-popstateevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface PopStateEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional PopStateEventInit eventInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute any state;
  readonly attribute boolean hasUAVisualTransition;
};

dictionary PopStateEventInit : EventInit {
  any state = null;
  boolean hasUAVisualTransition = false;
};
```

`event.state`

Returns a copy of the information that was provided to [`pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) or [`replaceState()`](#725-the-history-interface).

`event.hasUAVisualTransition`

Returns true if the user agent performed a visual transition for this navigation before dispatching this event. If true, the best user experience will be given if the author synchronously updates the DOM to the post-navigation state.

The `state` attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents the context information for the event, or null, if the state represented is the initial state of the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

The `
  hasUAVisualTransition` attribute must return the value it was initialized to.

##### 7.2.7.3 The [`HashChangeEvent`](#7273-the-hashchangeevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface HashChangeEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional HashChangeEventInit eventInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute USVString oldURL;
  readonly attribute USVString newURL;
};

dictionary HashChangeEventInit : EventInit {
  USVString oldURL = "";
  USVString newURL = "";
};
```

`event.oldURL`

Returns the [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that was previously current.

`event.newURL`

Returns the [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) of the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that is now current.

The `oldURL` attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents context information for the event, specifically the URL of the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that was traversed from.

The `newURL` attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents context information for the event, specifically the URL of the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) that was traversed to.

##### 7.2.7.4 The [`PageSwapEvent`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface PageSwapEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional PageSwapEventInit eventInitDict = {});
  readonly attribute NavigationActivation? activation;
  readonly attribute ViewTransition? viewTransition;
};

dictionary PageSwapEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationActivation? activation = null;
  ViewTransition? viewTransition = null;
};
```

`event.activation`

A [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) object representing the destination and type of the cross-document navigation. This would be null for cross-origin navigations.

`event.activation.entry`

A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), representing the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) that is about to become active.

`event.activation.from`

A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface), equivalent to the value of the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#7266-the-history-entry-list) property at the moment the event is fired.

`event.activation.navigationType`

One of "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", or "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", indicating what type of navigation that is about to result in a page swap.

`event.viewTransition`

Returns the [`ViewTransition`](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#viewtransition) object that represents an outbound cross-document view transition, if such transition is active when the event is fired. Otherwise, returns null.

The `activation` and `viewTransition` attributes must return the values they were initialized to.

##### 7.2.7.5 The [`PageRevealEvent`](#7275-the-pagerevealevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface PageRevealEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional PageRevealEventInit eventInitDict = {});
  readonly attribute ViewTransition? viewTransition;
};

dictionary PageRevealEventInit : EventInit {
  ViewTransition? viewTransition = null;
};
```

`event.viewTransition`

Returns the [`ViewTransition`](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#viewtransition) object that represents an inbound cross-document view transition, if such transition is active when the event is fired. Otherwise, returns null.

The `viewTransition` attribute must return the value it was initialized to.

##### 7.2.7.6 The [`PageTransitionEvent`](#7276-the-pagetransitionevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface PageTransitionEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional PageTransitionEventInit eventInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute boolean persisted;
};

dictionary PageTransitionEventInit : EventInit {
  boolean persisted = false;
};
```

`event.persisted`

For the [`pageshow`](#events) event, returns false if the page is newly being loaded (and the [`load`](#events) event will fire). Otherwise, returns true.

For the [`pagehide`](#events) event, returns false if the page is going away for the last time. Otherwise, returns true, meaning that the page might be reused if the user navigates back to this page (if the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s *[salvageable](#759-unloading-documents)* state stays true).

Things that can cause the page to be unsalvageable include:
- The user agent decided to not keep the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) alive in a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) after [unload](#759-unloading-documents)
- Having [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element)s that are not *[salvageable](#759-unloading-documents)*
- Active [`WebSocket`](https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket) objects
- [Aborting a `Document`](#7511-aborting-a-document-load)

The `persisted` attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents the context information for the event.

To fire a page transition event named eventName at a [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) window with a boolean persisted, [fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named eventName at window, using [`PageTransitionEvent`](#7276-the-pagetransitionevent-interface), with the [`persisted`](#7276-the-pagetransitionevent-interface) attribute initialized to persisted, the [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) attribute initialized to true, the [`bubbles`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) attribute initialized to true, and *legacy target override flag* set.

> [!note]
> The values for [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) and [`bubbles`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) don't make any sense, since canceling the event does nothing and it's not possible to bubble past the [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object. They are set to true for historical reasons.

##### 7.2.7.7 The [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface BeforeUnloadEvent : Event {
  attribute DOMString returnValue;
};
```

> [!note]
> There are no [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface)-specific initialization methods.

The [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface) interface is a legacy interface which allows [checking if unloading is canceled](#7424-preventing-navigation) to be controlled not only by canceling the event, but by setting the [`returnValue`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface) attribute to a value besides the empty string. Authors should use the [`preventDefault()`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) method, or other means of canceling events, instead of using [`returnValue`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface).

The `returnValue` attribute controls the process of [checking if unloading is canceled](#7424-preventing-navigation). When the event is created, the attribute must be set to the empty string. On getting, it must return the last value it was set to. On setting, the attribute must be set to the new value.

> [!note]
> This attribute is a `DOMString` only for historical reasons. Any value besides the empty string will be treated as a request to ask the user for confirmation.

#### 7.2.8 The [`NotRestoredReasons`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NotRestoredReasonDetails {
  readonly attribute DOMString reason;
  [Default] object toJSON();
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface NotRestoredReasons {
  readonly attribute USVString? src;
  readonly attribute DOMString? id;
  readonly attribute DOMString? name;
  readonly attribute USVString? url;
  readonly attribute FrozenArray<NotRestoredReasonDetails>? reasons;
  readonly attribute FrozenArray<NotRestoredReasons>? children;
  [Default] object toJSON();
};
```

`notRestoredReasonDetails.reason`

Returns a string that explains the reason that prevented the document from [being served from back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). See the definition of [bfcache blocking details](#311-the-document-object) for the possible string values.

`notRestoredReasons.src`

Returns the [`src`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute of the document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [container](#7313-child-navigables) if it is an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if not set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons.id`

Returns the [`id`](#326-global-attributes) attribute of the document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [container](#7313-child-navigables) if it is an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if not set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons.name`

Returns the [`name`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute of the document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [container](#7313-child-navigables) if it is an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if not set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons.url`

Returns the document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), or null if the document is in a cross-origin [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element). This is reported in addition to [`src`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) because it is possible [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) navigated since the original [`src`](#485-the-iframe-element) was set.

`notRestoredReasons.reasons`

Returns an array of [`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) for the document. This is null if the document is in a cross-origin [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element).

`notRestoredReasons.children`

Returns an array of [`NotRestoredReasons`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) that are for the document’s children. This is null if the document is in a cross-origin [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element).

A [`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) object has a backing struct, a [not restored reason details](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) or null, initially null.

The `reason` getter steps are to return [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [backing struct](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface)'s [reason](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface).

To create a `NotRestoredReasonDetails` object given a [not restored reason details](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) backingStruct and a [realm](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-code-realms) realm:
1. Let notRestoredReasonDetails be a new [`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) object created in realm.
2. Set notRestoredReasonDetails's [backing struct](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to backingStruct.
3. Return notRestoredReasonDetails.

A not restored reason details is a [struct](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs) with the following [items](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs):
- reason, a string, initially empty.

The [reason](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) is a string that represents the reason that prevented the page from being restored from the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). The string is one of the following:

"`fetch`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), a fetch initiated by this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was still ongoing and was canceled, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state).

"`navigation-failure`"

The original navigation that created this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) errored, so storing the resulting error document in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state) was prevented.

"`parser-aborted`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) never finished its initial HTML parsing, so storing the unfinished document in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state) was prevented.

"`websocket`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), an open [`WebSocket`](https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket) connection was shut down, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[WEBSOCKETS\]](#references)

"`lock`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), held [locks](https://w3c.github.io/web-locks/#lock-concept) and [lock requests](https://w3c.github.io/web-locks/#lock-request) were terminated, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[WEBLOCKS\]](#references)

"`masked`"

This [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) has children that are in a cross-origin [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element), and they prevented [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state); or this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) could not be [back/forward cached](#7412-document-state) for user agent-specific reasons, and the user agent has chosen not to use one of the more specific reasons from the list of [user-agent specific blocking reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface).

In addition to the list above, a user agent might choose to expose a reason that prevented the page from being restored from [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state) for user-agent specific blocking reasons. These are one of the following strings:

"`audio-capture`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) requested audio capture permission by using Media Capture and Streams's [`getUserMedia()`](https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#dom-mediadevices-getusermedia) with audio. [\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#references)

"`background-work`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) requested background work by calling [`SyncManager`](https://wicg.github.io/background-sync/spec/#syncmanager)'s [`register()`](https://wicg.github.io/background-sync/spec/#dom-syncmanager-register) method, [`PeriodicSyncManager`](https://wicg.github.io/periodic-background-sync/#periodicsyncmanager)'s [`register()`](https://wicg.github.io/periodic-background-sync/#dom-periodicsyncmanager-register) method, or [`BackgroundFetchManager`](https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#backgroundfetchmanager)'s [`fetch()`](https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#dom-backgroundfetchmanager-fetch) method.

"`broadcastchannel-message`"

While the page was stored in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state), a [`BroadcastChannel`](#95-broadcasting-to-other-browsing-contexts) connection on the page received a message and [`message`](#events) event was fired.

"`idbversionchangeevent`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had a pending [`IDBVersionChangeEvent`](https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbversionchangeevent) while [unloading](#759-unloading-documents). [\[INDEXEDDB\]](#references)

"`idledetector`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had an active [`IdleDetector`](https://wicg.github.io/idle-detection/#idledetector) while [unloading](#759-unloading-documents).

"`keyboardlock`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), keyboard lock was still active because [`Keyboard`](https://wicg.github.io/keyboard-lock/#keyboard)'s [`lock()`](https://wicg.github.io/keyboard-lock/#dom-keyboard-lock) method was called.

"`mediastream`"

A [`MediaStreamTrack`](https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#mediastreamtrack) was in the [live state](https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#idl-def-MediaStreamTrackState.live) upon [unloading](#759-unloading-documents). [\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#references)

"`midi`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) requested a MIDI permission by calling [`navigator.requestMIDIAccess()`](https://webaudio.github.io/web-midi-api/#dom-navigator-requestmidiaccess).

"`modals`"

[User prompts](#89-user-prompts) were shown while [unloading](#759-unloading-documents).

"`navigating`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), loading was still ongoing, and so the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was not in a state that could be stored in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state).

"`navigation-canceled`"

The navigation request was canceled by calling [`window.stop()`](#7221-opening-and-closing-windows) and the page was not in a state to be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state).

"`non-trivial-browsing-context-group`"

The [browsing context group](#7323-groupings-of-browsing-contexts) of this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had more than one [top-level browsing context](#7322-related-browsing-contexts).

"`otpcredential`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) created an [`OTPCredential`](https://wicg.github.io/web-otp/#otpcredential).

"`outstanding-network-request`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had outstanding network requests and was not in a state that could be stored in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state).

"`paymentrequest`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had an active [`PaymentRequest`](https://w3c.github.io/payment-request/#dom-paymentrequest) while [unloading](#759-unloading-documents). [\[PAYMENTREQUEST\]](#references)

"`pictureinpicturewindow`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) had an active [`PictureInPictureWindow`](https://w3c.github.io/picture-in-picture/#pictureinpicturewindow) while [unloading](#759-unloading-documents). [\[PICTUREINPICTURE\]](#references)

"`plugins`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) contained [plugins](#216-plugins).

"`request-method-not-get`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP request whose [method](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-method) was not \``GET`\`. [\[FETCH\]](#references)

"`response-auth-required`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response that required HTTP authentication.

"`response-cache-control-no-store`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response whose \`[`Cache-Control`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control)\` header included the "`no-store`" token. [\[HTTP\]](#references)

"`response-cache-control-no-cache`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response whose \`[`Cache-Control`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control)\` header included the "`no-cache`" token. [\[HTTP\]](#references)

"`response-keep-alive`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response that contained a \``Keep-Alive`\` header.

"`response-scheme-not-http-or-https`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from a response whose [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url)'s [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) was not an [HTTP(S) scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme). [\[FETCH\]](#references)

"`response-status-not-ok`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response whose [status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) was not an [ok status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status). [\[FETCH\]](#references)

"`rtc`"

While [unloading](#759-unloading-documents), a [`RTCPeerConnection`](https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcpeerconnection) or [`RTCDataChannel`](https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcdatachannel) was shut down, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[WEBRTC\]](#references)

"`rtc-used-with-cache-control-no-store`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was created from an HTTP response whose \`[`Cache-Control`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control)\` header included the "`no-store`" token, and it has created a [`RTCPeerConnection`](https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcpeerconnection) or [`RTCDataChannel`](https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcdatachannel) which might be used to receive sensitive information, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[HTTP\]](#references) [\[WEBRTC\]](#references)

"`sensors`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [requested sensor access](https://w3c.github.io/sensors/#request-sensor-access).

"`serviceworker-added`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client) started to be [controlled](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#dfn-control) by a [`ServiceWorker`](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworker) while the page was in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[SW\]](#references)

"`serviceworker-claimed`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client)'s [active service worker](#8131-environments) was claimed while the page was in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[SW\]](#references)

"`serviceworker-postmessage`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client)'s [active service worker](#8131-environments) received a message while the page was in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[SW\]](#references)

"`serviceworker-version-activated`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client)'s [active service worker](#8131-environments)'s version was activated while the page was in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[SW\]](#references)

"`serviceworker-unregistered`"

The [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [service worker client](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client)'s [active service worker](#8131-environments)'s [service worker registration](https://w3c.github.io/service-workers/#dfn-service-worker-registration) was [unregistered](https://w3c.github.io/service-workers/#navigator-service-worker-unregister) while the page was in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state). [\[SW\]](#references)

"`sharedworker`"

This [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was in the [owner set](#10211-the-workerglobalscope-common-interface) of a [`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#10213-shared-workers-and-the-sharedworkerglobalscope-interface).

> [!note]
> User agents that support the [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state) for documents using shared workers can use more specific reasons such as [`"sharedworker-message"`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) or [`"sharedworker-with-no-active-client"`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) instead of this general reason, since the usage of shared workers itself is supported outside of the cases described in those reasons.

"`sharedworker-message`"

While the page was stored in [back/forward cache](#7412-document-state), a message was received from a [`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#10213-shared-workers-and-the-sharedworkerglobalscope-interface) whose [owner set](#10211-the-workerglobalscope-common-interface) [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) this [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

"`sharedworker-with-no-active-client`"

This [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) was in the [owner set](#10211-the-workerglobalscope-common-interface) of a [`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#10213-shared-workers-and-the-sharedworkerglobalscope-interface) that is not [actively needed](#1023-the-workers-lifetime).

"`smartcardconnection`"
