    > If the scrolling fails because the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) is new and the relevant [ID](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) has not yet been parsed, then the second asynchronous call to [update document for history step application](#7462-updating-the-document) will take care of scrolling.

17. Let traversable be navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).
18. [Append the following session history synchronous navigation steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) involving navigable to traversable:
    1. [Finalize a same-document navigation](#74233-fragment-navigations) given traversable, navigable, historyEntry, entryToReplace, historyHandling, and userInvolvement.
    2. Invoke [WebDriver BiDi fragment navigated](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-fragment-navigated) with navigable and a new [WebDriver BiDi navigation status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status) whose [id](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id) is navigationId, [url](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url) is url, and [status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status) is "[`complete`](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-complete)".

To finalize a same-document navigation given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, a [navigable](#731-navigables) targetNavigable, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) targetEntry, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries)-or-null entryToReplace, a [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) historyHandling, and a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement:

> [!note]
> This is used by both [fragment navigations](#74233-fragment-navigations) and by the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations), which are the only synchronous updates to session history. By virtue of being synchronous, those algorithms are performed outside of the [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables)'s [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables). This puts them out of sync with the [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables)'s [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables), so this algorithm is used to resolve conflicts due to race conditions.
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): this is running on traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables).
2. If targetNavigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables) is not targetEntry, then return.
3. Let targetStep be null.
4. Let targetEntries be the result of [getting session history entries](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) for targetNavigable.
5. If entryToReplace is null:
   1. [Clear the forward session history](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) of traversable.
   2. Set targetStep to traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) + 1.
   3. Set targetEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) to targetStep.
   4. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) targetEntry to targetEntries.

   Otherwise:
   1. [Replace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) entryToReplace with targetEntry in targetEntries.
   2. Set targetEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) to entryToReplace's [step](#7411-session-history-entries).
   3. Set targetStep to traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables).

6. [Apply the push/replace history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) targetStep to traversable given historyHandling and userInvolvement.

   > [!note]
   > This is done even for "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)" navigations, as it resolves race conditions across multiple synchronous navigations.

###### 7.4.2.3.4 Non-fetch schemes and external software

The input to [attempt to create a non-fetch scheme document](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) is the non-fetch scheme navigation params [struct](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs). It is a lightweight version of [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts) which only carries parameters relevant to the non-[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) navigation case. It has the following [items](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs):

id

null or a [navigation ID](#7421-supporting-concepts)

navigable

the [navigable](#731-navigables) experiencing the navigation

URL

a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)

target snapshot sandboxing flags

the [target snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts) present during navigation

source snapshot has transient activation

a copy of the [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts) boolean present during activation

initiator origin

an [origin](#711-origins) possibly for use in a user-facing prompt to confirm the invocation of an external software package

> [!note]
> This differs slightly from a [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state) in that a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)'s [initiator origin](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) follows redirects up to the last [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) URL in a redirect chain that ends in a non-[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) URL.

navigation timing type

a [`NavigationTimingType`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype) used for [creating the navigation timing entry](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dfn-create-the-navigation-timing-entry) for the new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) (if one is created)

user involvement

a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) used when [obtaining a browsing context](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy) for the new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) (if one is created)

To attempt to create a non-fetch scheme document, given a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) navigationParams:
1. Let url be navigationParams's [URL](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).
2. Let navigable be navigationParams's [navigable](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).
3. If url is to be handled using a mechanism that does not affect navigable, e.g., because url's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is handled externally:
   1. [Hand-off to external software](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) given url, navigable, navigationParams's [target snapshot sandboxing flags](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), navigationParams's [source snapshot has transient activation](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), and navigationParams's [initiator origin](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).
   2. Return null.
4. Handle url by displaying some sort of inline content, e.g., an error message because the specified scheme is not one of the supported protocols, or an inline prompt to allow the user to select [a registered handler](#81014-custom-scheme-handlers-the-registerprotocolhandler-method) for the given scheme. Return the result of [displaying the inline content](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom) given navigable, navigationParams's [id](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), navigationParams's [navigation timing type](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), and navigationParams's [user involvement](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).

   > [!note]
   > In the case of a registered handler being used, [navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) will be invoked with a new URL.

To hand-off to external software given a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) or [response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) resource, a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable, a [sandboxing flag set](#715-sandboxing) sandboxFlags, a boolean hasTransientActivation, and an [origin](#711-origins) initiatorOrigin, user agents should:
1. If all of the following are true:
   - navigable is not a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables);
   - sandboxFlags has its [sandboxed custom protocols navigation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) set; and
   - sandboxFlags has its [sandboxed top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) set, or hasTransientActivation is false,

   then return without invoking the external software package.

   > [!note]
   > Navigation inside an iframe toward external software can be seen by users as a new popup or a new top-level navigation. That's why its is allowed in sandboxed [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) only when one of [`allow-popups`](#715-sandboxing), [`allow-top-navigation`](#715-sandboxing), [`allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`](#715-sandboxing), or [`allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols`](#715-sandboxing) is specified.

2. Perform the appropriate handoff of resource while attempting to mitigate the risk that this is an attempt to exploit the target software. For example, user agents could prompt the user to confirm that initiatorOrigin is to be allowed to invoke the external software in question. In particular, if hasTransientActivation is false, then the user agent should not invoke the external software package without prior user confirmation.

   > [!example]
   > For example, there could be a vulnerability in the target software's URL handler which a hostile page would attempt to exploit by tricking a user into clicking a link.

##### 7.4.2.4 Preventing navigation

A couple of scenarios can intervene early in the navigation process and put the whole thing to a halt. This can be especially exciting when multiple [navigables](#731-navigables) are navigating at the same time, due to a session history traversal.

A [navigable](#731-navigables) source is allowed by sandboxing to navigate a second [navigable](#731-navigables) target, given a [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) sourceSnapshotParams, if the following steps return true:
1. If source is target, then return true.
2. If source is an ancestor of target, then return true.
3. If target is an ancestor of source:
   1. If target is not a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables), then return true.
   2. If sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts) is true, and sourceSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [sandboxed top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) is set, then return false.
   3. If sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts) is false, and sourceSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [sandboxed top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) is set, then return false.
   4. Return true.
4. If target is a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables):
   1. If source is the [one permitted sandboxed navigator](#715-sandboxing) of target, then return true.
   2. If sourceSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [sandboxed navigation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) is set, then return false.
   3. Return true.
5. If sourceSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [sandboxed navigation browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) is set, then return false.
6. Return true.

To check if unloading is canceled for a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [navigables](#731-navigables) navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload, given an optional [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, an optional integer targetStep, and an optional [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvementForNavigateEvent, run these steps. They return "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", "`canceled-by-navigate`", or "`continue`".
1. Let documentsToFireBeforeunload be the [active document](#731-navigables) of each [item](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload.
2. Let unloadPromptShown be false.
3. Let finalStatus be "`continue`".
4. If traversable was given:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): targetStep and userInvolvementForNavigateEvent were given.
   2. Let targetEntry be the result of [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.
   3. If targetEntry is not traversable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables), and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state) is the [same](#711-origins) as traversable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state):

      > [!note]
      > In this case, we're going to fire the [`navigate`](#events) event for traversable here. Because [under some circumstances](#726104-firing-the-event) it might be canceled, we need to do this separately from [other traversal `navigate` events](#7461-updating-the-traversable), which happen later.
      > 
      > Additionally, because we want [`beforeunload`](#events) events to fire before [`navigate`](#events) events, this means we need to fire [`beforeunload`](#events) for traversable here (if applicable), instead of doing it as part of the below loop over documentsToFireBeforeunload.
      1. Let eventsFired be false.
      2. Let needsBeforeunload be true if navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) traversable; otherwise false.
      3. If needsBeforeunload is true, then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) traversable's [active document](#731-navigables) from documentsToFireBeforeunload.
      4. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given traversable's [active window](#731-navigables) to perform the following steps:
         1. If needsBeforeunload is true:
            1. Let (unloadPromptShownForThisDocument, unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument) be the result of running the [steps to fire `beforeunload`](#7424-preventing-navigation) given traversable's [active document](#731-navigables) and false.
            2. If unloadPromptShownForThisDocument is true, then set unloadPromptShown to true.
            3. If unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument is true, then set finalStatus to "`canceled-by-beforeunload`".
         2. If finalStatus is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", then abort these steps.
         3. Let navigation be traversable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
         4. Let navigateEventResult be the result of [firing a traverse `navigate` event](#726104-firing-the-event) at navigation given targetEntry and userInvolvementForNavigateEvent.
         5. If navigateEventResult is false, then set finalStatus to "`canceled-by-navigate`".
         6. Set eventsFired to true.
      5. Wait until eventsFired is true.
      6. If finalStatus is not "`continue`", then return finalStatus.

5. Let totalTasks be the [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of documentsToFireBeforeunload.
6. Let completedTasks be 0.
7. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) document of documentsToFireBeforeunload, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to run the steps:
   1. Let (unloadPromptShownForThisDocument, unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument) be the result of running the [steps to fire `beforeunload`](#7424-preventing-navigation) given document and unloadPromptShown.
   2. If unloadPromptShownForThisDocument is true, then set unloadPromptShown to true.
   3. If unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument is true, then set finalStatus to "`canceled-by-beforeunload`".
   4. Increment completedTasks.
8. Wait for completedTasks to be totalTasks.
9. Return finalStatus.

The steps to fire `beforeunload` given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document and a boolean unloadPromptShown are:
1. Let unloadPromptCanceled be false.
2. Increase the document's [unload counter](#759-unloading-documents) by 1.
3. Increase document's [relevant agent](#8121-integration-with-the-javascript-agent-formalism)'s [event loop](#8171-definitions)'s [termination nesting level](#759-unloading-documents) by 1.
4. Let eventFiringResult be the result of [firing an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`beforeunload`](#events) at document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), using [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface), with the [`cancelable`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#22-interface-event) attribute initialized to true.
5. Decrease document's [relevant agent](#8121-integration-with-the-javascript-agent-formalism)'s [event loop](#8171-definitions)'s [termination nesting level](#759-unloading-documents) by 1.
6. If all of the following are true:
   - unloadPromptShown is false;
   - document's [active sandboxing flag set](#715-sandboxing) does not have its [sandboxed modals flag](#715-sandboxing) set;
   - document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) has [sticky activation](#641-data-model);
   - eventFiringResult is false, or the [`returnValue`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface) attribute of event is not the empty string; and
   - showing an unload prompt is unlikely to be annoying, deceptive, or pointless,

   then:
   1. Set unloadPromptShown to true.
   2. Let userPromptHandler be the result of [WebDriver BiDi user prompt opened](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-opened) with document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), "`beforeunload`", and "".
   3. If userPromptHandler is "`dismiss`", then set unloadPromptCanceled to true.
   4. If userPromptHandler is "`none`":
      1. Ask the user to confirm that they wish to unload the document, and [pause](#8173-processing-model) while waiting for the user's response.

         > [!note]
         > The message shown to the user is not customizable, but instead determined by the user agent. In particular, the actual value of the [`returnValue`](#7277-the-beforeunloadevent-interface) attribute is ignored.

      2. If the user did not confirm the page navigation, then set unloadPromptCanceled to true.

   5. Invoke [WebDriver BiDi user prompt closed](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-closed) with document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), "`beforeunload`", and true if unloadPromptCanceled is false or false otherwise.

7. Decrease document's [unload counter](#759-unloading-documents) by 1.
8. Return (unloadPromptShown, unloadPromptCanceled).

##### 7.4.2.5 Aborting navigation

Each [navigable](#731-navigables) has an ongoing navigation, which is a [navigation ID](#7421-supporting-concepts), "`traversal`", or null, initially null. It is used to track navigation aborting and to prevent any navigations from taking place during [traversal](#7461-updating-the-traversable).

To set the ongoing navigation for a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable to newValue:
1. If navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) is equal to newValue, then return.
2. [Inform the navigation API about aborting navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) given navigable.
3. Set navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) to newValue.

#### 7.4.3 Reloading and traversing

To reload a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable given an optional [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries)-or-null navigationAPIState (default null), an optional [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement (default "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"), and an optional [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking)-or-null apiMethodTracker (default null):
1. If userInvolvement is not "[`browser UI`](#7421-supporting-concepts)":
   1. Let navigation be navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
   2. Let destinationNavigationAPIState be navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API state](#7411-session-history-entries).
   3. If navigationAPIState is not null, then set destinationNavigationAPIState to navigationAPIState.
   4. Let continue be the result of [firing a push/replace/reload `navigate` event](#726104-firing-the-event) at navigation with *[navigationType](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)", *[isSameDocument](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to false, *[userInvolvement](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to userInvolvement, *[destinationURL](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [URL](#7411-session-history-entries), *[navigationAPIState](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to destinationNavigationAPIState, and *[apiMethodTracker](#726104-firing-the-event)* set to apiMethodTracker.
   5. If continue is false, then return.
2. Set navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) to true.
3. Let traversable be navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).
4. [Append the following session history traversal steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) to traversable:
   1. [Apply the reload history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) to traversable given userInvolvement.

To traverse the history by a delta given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, an integer delta, and an optional [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) sourceDocument:
1. Let sourceSnapshotParams and initiatorToCheck be null.
2. Let userInvolvement be "[`browser
      UI`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
3. If sourceDocument is given:
   1. Set sourceSnapshotParams to the result of [snapshotting source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) given sourceDocument.
   2. Set initiatorToCheck to sourceDocument's [node navigable](#731-navigables).
   3. Set userInvolvement to "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
4. [Append the following session history traversal steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) to traversable:
   1. Let allSteps be the result of [getting all used history steps](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) for traversable.
   2. Let currentStepIndex be the index of traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) within allSteps.
   3. Let targetStepIndex be currentStepIndex plus delta.
   4. If allSteps\[targetStepIndex\] does not [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then abort these steps.
   5. [Apply the traverse history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) allSteps\[targetStepIndex\] to traversable, given sourceSnapshotParams, initiatorToCheck, and userInvolvement.

#### 7.4.4 Non-fragment synchronous "navigations"

Apart from the [navigate](#7422-beginning-navigation) algorithm, [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) can be pushed or replaced via one more mechanism, the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations). The most well-known callers of these steps are the [`history.replaceState()`](#725-the-history-interface) and [`history.pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) APIs, but various other parts of the standard also need to perform updates to the [active history entry](#731-navigables), and they use these steps to do so.

The URL and history update steps, given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document, a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) newURL, an optional [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries)-or-null serializedData (default null), and an optional [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) historyHandling (default "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"), are:
1. Let navigable be document's [node navigable](#731-navigables).
2. Let activeEntry be navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables).
3. Let newEntry be a new [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries), with

   [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)

   newURL

   [serialized state](#7411-session-history-entries)

   if serializedData is not null, serializedData; otherwise activeEntry's [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries)

   [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)

   activeEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)

   [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries)

   activeEntry's [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries)

   [persisted user state](#7411-session-history-entries)

   activeEntry's [persisted user state](#7411-session-history-entries)

4. If document's [is initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) is true, then set historyHandling to "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".

   > [!note]
   > This means that [`pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) on an [initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) behaves as a [`replaceState()`](#725-the-history-interface) call.

5. Let entryToReplace be activeEntry if historyHandling is "[`replace`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", otherwise null.
6. If entryToReplace is non-null, then set newEntry's [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries) to entryToReplace's [navigation API key](#7411-session-history-entries).
7. If historyHandling is "[`push`](#7421-supporting-concepts)":
   1. Increment document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [index](#725-the-history-interface).
   2. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [length](#725-the-history-interface) to its [index](#725-the-history-interface) + 1.

   > [!note]
   > These are temporary best-guess values for immediate synchronous access.

8. If serializedData is not null, then [restore the history object state](#7462-updating-the-document) given document and newEntry.
9. [Set the URL](#243-document-base-urls) given document to newURL.

   > [!note]
   > Since this is neither a [navigation](#7422-beginning-navigation) nor a [history traversal](#743-reloading-and-traversing), it does not cause a [`hashchange`](#events) event to be fired.

10. Set document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state) to newEntry.
11. Set navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables) to newEntry.
12. [Update the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) given document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface), newEntry, and historyHandling.
13. Let traversable be navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables).
14. [Append the following session history synchronous navigation steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) involving navigable to traversable:
    1. [Finalize a same-document navigation](#74233-fragment-navigations) given traversable, navigable, newEntry, entryToReplace, historyHandling, and "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)".
    2. Invoke [WebDriver BiDi history updated](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-history-updated) with navigable.

> [!note]
> Although both [fragment navigation](#74233-fragment-navigations) and the [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations) perform synchronous history updates, only fragment navigation contains a synchronous call to [update document for history step application](#7462-updating-the-document). The [URL and history update steps](#744-non-fragment-synchronous-navigations) instead perform a few select updates inside the above algorithm, omitting others. This is somewhat of an unfortunate historical accident, and generally leads to [web-developer sadness](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5562) about the inconsistency. For example, this means that [`popstate`](#events) events fire for fragment navigations, but not for [`history.pushState()`](#725-the-history-interface) calls.

#### 7.4.5 Populating a session history entry

As explained in [the overview](#74-navigation-and-session-history), both [navigation](#742-navigation) and [traversal](#743-reloading-and-traversing) involve creating a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) and then attempting to populate its [document](#7411-session-history-entries) member, so that it can be presented inside the [navigable](#731-navigables).

This involves either: using [an already-given response](#7422-beginning-navigation); using the [srcdoc resource](#7412-document-state) stored in the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries); or [fetching](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry). The process has several failure modes, which can either result in doing nothing (leaving the [navigable](#731-navigables) on its currently-[active](#731-navigables) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)) or can result in populating the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) with an [error document](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom).

To attempt to populate the history entry's document for a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry, given a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable, a [`NavigationTimingType`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype) navTimingType, a [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) sourceSnapshotParams, a [target snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) targetSnapshotParams, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, an optional [navigation ID](#7421-supporting-concepts)-or-null navigationId (default null), an optional [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts)-or-null navigationParams (default null), an optional string cspNavigationType (default "`other`"), an optional boolean allowPOST (default false), and optional algorithm steps completionSteps (default an empty algorithm):
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): this is running [in parallel](#211-parallelism).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): if navigationParams is non-null, then navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts) is non-null.
3. Let documentResource be entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [resource](#7412-document-state).
4. If navigationParams is null:
   1. If documentResource is a string, then set navigationParams to the result of [creating navigation params from a srcdoc resource](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) given entry, navigable, targetSnapshotParams, userInvolvement, navigationId, and navTimingType.
   2. Otherwise, if all of the following are true:
      - entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is a [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme); and
      - documentResource is null, or allowPOST is true and documentResource's [request body](#7412-document-state) is not failure,

      then set navigationParams to the result of [creating navigation params by fetching](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) given entry, navigable, sourceSnapshotParams, targetSnapshotParams, cspNavigationType, userInvolvement, navigationId, and navTimingType.

   3. Otherwise, if entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is not a [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme), then set navigationParams to a new [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), with

      [id](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      navigationId

      [navigable](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      navigable

      [URL](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)

      [target snapshot sandboxing flags](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      targetSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)

      [source snapshot has transient activation](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts)

      [initiator origin](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state)

      [navigation timing type](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      navTimingType

      [user involvement](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

      userInvolvement

5. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources), given navigable's [active window](#732-browsing-contexts), to run these steps:
   1. If navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) no longer equals navigationId, then run completionSteps and abort these steps.
   2. Let saveExtraDocumentState be true.

      > [!note]
      > Usually, in the cases where we end up populating entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state), we then want to save some of the state from that [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) into entry. This ensures that if there are future traversals to entry where its [document](#7412-document-state) [has been destroyed](#7412-document-state), we can use that state when creating a new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).
      > 
      > However, in some specific cases, saving the state would be unhelpful. For those, we set saveExtraDocumentState to false later in this algorithm.

   3. If navigationParams is a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software):
      1. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) to the result of running [attempt to create a non-fetch scheme document](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) given navigationParams.

         > [!note]
         > This can result in setting entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) to null, e.g., when [handing-off to external software](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).

      2. Set saveExtraDocumentState to false.

   4. Otherwise, if any of the following are true:
      - navigationParams is null;
      - the result of [should navigation response to navigation request of type in target be blocked by Content Security Policy?](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-navigation-response) given navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [CSP list](#717-policy-containers), cspNavigationType, and navigable is "`Blocked`";
      - navigationParams's [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts) is non-null and the result of [checking a navigation response's adherence to its embedder policy](#7142-embedder-policy-checks) given navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigable, and navigationParams's [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [embedder policy](#717-policy-containers) is false; or
      - the result of [checking a navigation response's adherence to \``X-Frame-Options`\`](#77-the-x-frame-options-header) given navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigable, navigationParams's [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [CSP list](#717-policy-containers), and navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts) is false,

      then:
      1. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) to the result of [creating a document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom), given navigable, null, navTimingType, and userInvolvement. The inline content should indicate to the user the sort of error that occurred.
      2. [Make document unsalvageable](#7462-updating-the-document) given entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) and "[`navigation-failure`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface)".
      3. Set saveExtraDocumentState to false.
      4. If navigationParams is not null:
         1. Run the [environment discarding steps](#8131-environments) for navigationParams's [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts).
         2. Invoke [WebDriver BiDi navigation failed](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed) with navigable and a new [WebDriver BiDi navigation status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status) whose [id](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id) is navigationId, [status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status) is "[`canceled`](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled)", and [url](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url) is navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url).

   5. Otherwise, if navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts) has a \`[`Content-Disposition`](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html)\` header specifying the `attachment` disposition type:
      1. Let sourceAllowsDownloading be sourceSnapshotParams's [allows downloading](#7421-supporting-concepts).
      2. Let targetAllowsDownloading be false if navigationParams's [final sandboxing flag set](#7421-supporting-concepts) has the [sandboxed downloads browsing context flag](#715-sandboxing) set; otherwise true.
      3. Let uaAllowsDownloading be true.
      4. Optionally, the user agent may set uaAllowsDownloading to false, if it believes doing so would safeguard the user from a potentially hostile download.
      5. If sourceAllowsDownloading, targetAllowsDownloading, and uaAllowsDownloading are true:
         1. [Handle as a download](#466-downloading-resources) navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts) with navigable and navigationId.

      > [!note]
      > This branch leaves entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) as null.

   6. Otherwise, if navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [status](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status) is not 204 and is not 205, then set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) to the result of [loading a document](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) given navigationParams, sourceSnapshotParams, and entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state).

      > [!note]
      > This can result in setting entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) to null, e.g., when [handing-off to external software](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software).

   7. If entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state) is not null:
      1. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [ever populated](#7412-document-state) to true.
      2. If saveExtraDocumentState is true:
         1. Let document be entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [document](#7412-document-state).
         2. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state) to document's [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
         3. If document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) [requires storing the policy container in history](#717-policy-containers):
            1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigationParams is a [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts) (i.e., neither null nor a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)).
            2. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [history policy container](#7412-document-state) to navigationParams's [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts).
      3. If entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [request referrer](#7412-document-state) is "`client`", and navigationParams is a [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts) (i.e., neither null nor a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)):
         1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts) is not null.
         2. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [request referrer](#7412-document-state) to navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [referrer](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer).
   8. Run completionSteps.

To create navigation params from a srcdoc resource given a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry, a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable, a [target snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) targetSnapshotParams, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, a [navigation ID](#7421-supporting-concepts)-or-null navigationId, and a [`NavigationTimingType`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype) navTimingType:
1. Let documentResource be entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [resource](#7412-document-state).
2. Let response be a new [response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) with

   [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url)

   [`about:srcdoc`](#241-terminology)

   [header list](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list)

   « (\`[`Content-Type`](#252-determining-the-type-of-a-resource)\`, \``text/html`\`) »

   [body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body)

   the [UTF-8 encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-encode) of documentResource, [as a body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body)

3. Let responseOrigin be the result of [determining the origin](#7321-creating-browsing-contexts) given response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url), targetSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts), and entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state).
4. Let coop be a new [opener policy](#713-cross-origin-opener-policies).
5. Let coopEnforcementResult be a new [opener policy enforcement result](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy) with

   [url](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

   response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url)

   [origin](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

   responseOrigin

   [opener policy](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

   coop

6. Let policyContainer be the result of [determining navigation params policy container](#717-policy-containers) given response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url), entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [history policy container](#7412-document-state), null, navigable's [container document](#7313-child-navigables)'s [policy container](#311-the-document-object), and null.
7. Return a new [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts), with

   [id](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   navigationId

   [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   navigable

   [request](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   null

   [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   response

   [fetch controller](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   null

   [commit early hints](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   null

   [COOP enforcement result](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   coopEnforcementResult

   [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   null

   [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   responseOrigin

   [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   policyContainer

   [final sandboxing flag set](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   targetSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [`iframe` element referrer policy](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   targetSnapshotParams's [`iframe` element referrer policy](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [opener policy](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   coop

   [navigation timing type](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   navTimingType

   [about base URL](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [about base URL](#7412-document-state)

   [user involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   userInvolvement

To create navigation params by fetching given a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry, a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable, a [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) sourceSnapshotParams, a [target snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) targetSnapshotParams, a string cspNavigationType, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, a [navigation ID](#7421-supporting-concepts)-or-null navigationId, and a [`NavigationTimingType`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype) navTimingType, perform the following steps. They return a [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts), a [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), or null.

> [!note]
> This algorithm mutates entry.
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): this is running [in parallel](#211-parallelism).
2. Let documentResource be entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [resource](#7412-document-state).
3. Let request be a new [request](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request), with

   [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url)

   entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)

   [client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client)

   sourceSnapshotParams's [fetch client](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination)

   "`document`" The destination is updated below when navigable has a [container](#7313-child-navigables).

   [credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode)

   "`include`"

   [use-URL-credentials flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag)

   set

   [redirect mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-redirect-mode)

   "`manual`"

   [replaces client id](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-replaces-client-id)

   navigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant)'s [id](#8131-environments)

   [mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode)

   "`navigate`"

   [referrer](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer)

   entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [request referrer](#7412-document-state)

   [referrer policy](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy)

   entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [request referrer policy](#7412-document-state)

   [policy container](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-policy-container)

   sourceSnapshotParams's [source policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [traversable for user prompts](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-window)

   navigable's [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables)

4. If navigable is a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables), then set request's [top-level navigation initiator origin](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-top-level-navigation-initiator-origin) to entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state).
5. If request's [client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) is null:

   > [!note]
   > This [only occurs](#7422-beginning-navigation) in the case of a browser UI-initiated navigation.
   1. Set request's [origin](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-origin) to a new [opaque origin](#711-origins).
   2. Set request's [service-workers mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-service-workers-mode) to "`all`".
   3. Set request's [referrer](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer) to "`no-referrer`".

6. If documentResource is a [POST resource](#7412-document-state):
   1. Set request's [method](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-method) to \``POST`\`.
   2. Set request's [body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body) to documentResource's [request body](#7412-document-state).
   3. [Set](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-set) \``Content-Type`\` to documentResource's [request content-type](#7412-document-state) in request's [header list](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-header-list).
7. If entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is true, then set request's [reload-navigation flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reload-navigation-flag).
8. Otherwise, if entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [ever populated](#7412-document-state) is true, then set request's [history-navigation flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-history-navigation-flag).
9. If sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts) is true, then set request's [user-activation](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-user-activation) to true.
10. If navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables) is non-null:
    1. If the navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables) has a [browsing context scope origin](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry), then set request's [origin](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-origin) to that [browsing context scope origin](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry).
    2. Set request's [destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination) to navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables)'s [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element).
    3. If sourceSnapshotParams's [fetch client](#7421-supporting-concepts) is navigable's [container document](#7313-child-navigables)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant), then set request's [initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) to navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables)'s [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element).

       > [!note]
       > This ensure that only container-initiated navigations are reported to resource timing.

11. Let response be null.
12. Let responseOrigin be null.
13. Let fetchController be null.
14. Let coopEnforcementResult be a new [opener policy enforcement result](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy), with

    [url](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

    navigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

    [origin](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

    navigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

    [opener policy](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

    navigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [opener policy](#311-the-document-object)

    [current context is navigation source](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy)

    true if navigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is [same origin](#711-origins) with entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state) otherwise false

15. Let finalSandboxFlags be an empty [sandboxing flag set](#715-sandboxing).
16. Let responsePolicyContainer be null.
17. Let responseCOOP be a new [opener policy](#713-cross-origin-opener-policies).
18. Let locationURL be null.
19. Let currentURL be request's [current URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url).
20. Let commitEarlyHints be null.
21. While true:
    1. If request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client) is not null and currentURL's [origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin) is not the [same](#711-origins) as request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client)'s [creation URL](#8131-environments)'s [origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin):
       1. Run the [environment discarding steps](#8131-environments) for request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client).
       2. Set request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client) to null.
       3. Set commitEarlyHints to null.

          > [!note]
          > Preloaded links from [early hint headers](#4245-early-hints) remain in the preload cache after a [same origin](#711-origins) redirect, but get discarded when the redirect is cross-origin.

    2. If request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client) is null:
       1. Let topLevelCreationURL be currentURL.
       2. Let topLevelOrigin be null.
       3. If navigable is not a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables):
          1. Let parentEnvironment be navigable's [parent](#731-navigables)'s [active document](#731-navigables)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).
          2. Set topLevelCreationURL to parentEnvironment's [top-level creation URL](#8131-environments).
          3. Set topLevelOrigin to parentEnvironment's [top-level origin](#8131-environments).
       4. Set request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client) to a new [environment](#8131-environments) whose [id](#8131-environments) is a unique opaque string, [target browsing context](#8131-environments) is navigable's [active browsing context](#731-navigables), [creation URL](#8131-environments) is currentURL, [top-level creation URL](#8131-environments) is topLevelCreationURL, and [top-level origin](#8131-environments) is topLevelOrigin.

          > [!note]
          > The created environment's [active service worker](#8131-environments) is set in the [Handle Fetch](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#on-fetch-request-algorithm) algorithm during the fetch if the request URL matches a service worker registration. [\[SW\]](#references)

    3. If the result of [should navigation request of type be blocked by Content Security Policy?](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-navigation-request) given request and cspNavigationType is "`Blocked`", then set response to a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error) and [break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration). [\[CSP\]](#references)
    4. Set response to null.
    5. If fetchController is null, then set fetchController to the result of [fetching](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) request, with *[processEarlyHintsResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-processearlyhintsresponse)* set to processEarlyHintsResponse as defined below, *[processResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response)* set to processResponse as defined below, and *[useParallelQueue](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-useparallelqueue)* set to true.

       Let processEarlyHintsResponse be the following algorithm given a [response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) earlyResponse:
       1. If commitEarlyHints is null, then set commitEarlyHints to the result of [processing early hint headers](#4245-early-hints) given earlyResponse and request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client).

       Let processResponse be the following algorithm given a [response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) fetchedResponse:
       1. Set response to fetchedResponse.

    6. Otherwise, [process the next manual redirect](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-process-the-next-manual-redirect) for fetchController.

       > [!note]
       > This will result in calling the *[processResponse](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response)* we supplied above, during our first iteration through the loop, and thus setting response.

       > [!note]
       > Navigation handles redirects manually as navigation is the only place in the web platform that cares for redirects to [`mailto:`](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6068#section-2) URLs and such.

    7. Wait until either response is non-null, or navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) changes to no longer equal navigationId.

       If the latter condition occurs, then [abort](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-abort) fetchController, and return.

       Otherwise, proceed onward.

    8. If request's [body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body) is null, then set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [resource](#7412-document-state) to null.

       > [!note]
       > Fetch unsets the [body](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body) for particular redirects.

    9. Set responsePolicyContainer to the result of [creating a policy container from a fetch response](#717-policy-containers) given response and request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client).
    10. Set finalSandboxFlags to the [union](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of targetSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts) and responsePolicyContainer's [CSP list](#717-policy-containers)'s [CSP-derived sandboxing flags](#715-sandboxing).
    11. Set responseOrigin to the result of [determining the origin](#7321-creating-browsing-contexts) given response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url), finalSandboxFlags, and entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [initiator origin](#7412-document-state).

        > [!note]
        > If response is a redirect, then response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url) will be the URL that led to the redirect to response's [location URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url); it will not be the [location URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url) itself.

    12. If navigable is a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables):
        1. Set responseCOOP to the result of [obtaining an opener policy](#7131-the-headers) given response and request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client).
        2. Set coopEnforcementResult to the result of [enforcing the response's opener policy](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy) given navigable's [active browsing context](#731-navigables), response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url), responseOrigin, responseCOOP, coopEnforcementResult, and request's [referrer](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer).
        3. If finalSandboxFlags is not empty and responseCOOP's [value](#713-cross-origin-opener-policies) is not "[`unsafe-none`](#713-cross-origin-opener-policies)", then set response to an appropriate [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error) and [break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).

           > [!note]
           > This results in a network error as one cannot simultaneously provide a clean slate to a response using opener policy and sandbox the result of navigating to that response.

    13. If response is not a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error), navigable is a [child navigable](#7313-child-navigables), and the result of performing a [cross-origin resource policy check](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-check) with navigable's [container document](#7313-child-navigables)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), navigable's [container document](#7313-child-navigables)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant), request's [destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination), response, and true is **blocked**, then set response to a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error) and [break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).

        > [!note]
        > Here we're running the [cross-origin resource policy check](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-check) against the [parent navigable](#731-navigables) rather than navigable itself. This is because we care about the same-originness of the embedded content against the parent context, not the navigation source.

    14. Set locationURL to response's [location URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url) given currentURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment).
    15. If locationURL is failure or null, then [break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
    16. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): locationURL is a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url).
    17. Set entry's [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) to [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(null).
    18. Let oldDocState be entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries).
    19. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries) to a new [document state](#7412-document-state), with

        [history policy container](#7412-document-state)

        a [clone](#717-policy-containers) of the oldDocState's [history policy container](#7412-document-state) if it is non-null; null otherwise

        [request referrer](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [request referrer](#7412-document-state)

        [request referrer policy](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [request referrer policy](#7412-document-state)

        [initiator origin](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [initiator origin](#7412-document-state)

        [origin](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [origin](#7412-document-state)

        [about base URL](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [about base URL](#7412-document-state)

        [resource](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [resource](#7412-document-state)

        [ever populated](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [ever populated](#7412-document-state)

        [navigable target name](#7412-document-state)

        oldDocState's [navigable target name](#7412-document-state)

        > [!note]
        > For the navigation case, only entry referenced oldDocState, which was created [early in the navigate algorithm](#7422-beginning-navigation). So for navigations, this is functionally just an update to entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries). For the traversal case, it's possible adjacent [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) also reference oldDocState, in which case they will continue doing so even after we've updated entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries).

        > [!note]
        > oldDocState's [history policy container](#7412-document-state) is only ever non-null here in the traversal case, after we've populated it during a navigation to a URL that [requires storing the policy container in history](#717-policy-containers).

        > [!example]
        > The setup is given by the following [Jake diagram](#7314-jake-diagrams):
        > 
        > |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
        > | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
        > | `top` | /a | /a#foo | /a#bar | /b |
        > 
        > Also assume that the [document state](#7411-session-history-entries) shared by the entries in steps 0, 1, and 2 has a null [document](#7412-document-state), i.e., [bfcache](#7412-document-state) is not in play.
        > 
        > Now consider the scenario where we traverse back to step 2, but this time when fetching `/a`, the server responds with a \``Location`\` header pointing to `/c`. That is, locationURL points to `/c` and so we have reached this step instead of [breaking](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration) out of the loop.
        > 
        > In this case, we replace the [document state](#7411-session-history-entries) of the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) occupying step 2, but we do *not* replace the document state of the entries occupying steps 0 and 1. The resulting [Jake diagram](#7314-jake-diagrams) looks like this:
        > 
        > |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
        > | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
        > | `top` | /a | /a#foo | /c#bar | /b |
        > 
        > Note that we perform this replacement even if we end up in a redirect chain back to the original URL, for example if `/c` itself had a \``Location`\` header pointing to `/a`. Such a case would end up like so:
        > 
        > |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
        > | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
        > | `top` | /a | /a#foo | /a#bar | /b |

    20. If locationURL's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is not an [HTTP(S) scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme):
        1. Set entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [resource](#7412-document-state) to null.
        2. [Break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
    21. Set currentURL to locationURL.
    22. Set entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries) to currentURL.

    > [!note]
    > By the end of this loop we will be in one of these scenarios:
    > - locationURL is failure, because of an unparseable \``Location`\` header.
    > - locationURL is null, either because response is a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error) or because we successfully fetched a non-[network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error) HTTP(S) response with no \``Location`\` header.
    > - locationURL is a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) with a non-[HTTP(S)](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme) [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme).

22. If locationURL is a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) whose [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is not a [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme), then return a new [non-fetch scheme navigation params](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software), with

    [id](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    navigationId

    [navigable](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    navigable

    [URL](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    locationURL

    [target snapshot sandboxing flags](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    targetSnapshotParams's [sandboxing flags](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    [source snapshot has transient activation](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    [initiator origin](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    responseOrigin

    [navigation timing type](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    navTimingType

    [user involvement](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software)

    userInvolvement

    > [!note]
    > At this point, request's [current URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url) is the last [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) in the redirect chain with a [fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) before redirecting to a non-[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url). It is this [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url)'s [origin](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin) that will be used as the initiator origin for navigations to non-[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) [URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url).

23. If any of the following are true:
    - response is a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error);
    - locationURL is failure; or
    - locationURL is a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) whose [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is a [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme),

    then return null.

    > [!note]
    > We allow redirects to non-[fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) [URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url), but redirects to [fetch scheme](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme) [URLs](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) that aren't [HTTP(S)](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme) are treated like network errors.

24. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): locationURL is null and response is not a [network error](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error).
25. Let resultPolicyContainer be the result of [determining navigation params policy container](#717-policy-containers) given response's [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url), entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [history policy container](#7412-document-state), sourceSnapshotParams's [source policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts), null, and responsePolicyContainer.
26. If navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables) is an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element), and response's [timing allow passed flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-timing-allow-passed) is set, then set navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables)'s [pending resource-timing start time](#485-the-iframe-element) to null.

    > [!note]
    > If the [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) is allowed to report to resource timing, we don't need to run its fallback steps as the normal reporting would happen.

27. Return a new [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts), with

    [id](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    navigationId

    [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    navigable

    [request](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    request

    [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    response

    [fetch controller](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    fetchController

    [commit early hints](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    commitEarlyHints

    [opener policy](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    responseCOOP

    [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    request's [reserved client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client)

    [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    responseOrigin

    [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    resultPolicyContainer

    [final sandboxing flag set](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    finalSandboxFlags

    [COOP enforcement result](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    coopEnforcementResult

    [navigation timing type](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    navTimingType

    [about base URL](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    entry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [about base URL](#7412-document-state)

    [user involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts)

    userInvolvement

An element has a browsing context scope origin if its [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [node navigable](#731-navigables) is a [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables) or if all of its [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [ancestor navigables](#7315-related-navigable-collections) have [active documents](#731-navigables) whose [origins](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) are the [same origin](#711-origins) as the element's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document). If an element has a [browsing context scope origin](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry), then its value is the [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) of the element's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node).

> [!warning]
> This definition is broken and needs investigation to see what it was intended to express: see [issue #4703](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4703).

To load a document given [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts) navigationParams, [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) sourceSnapshotParams, and [origin](#711-origins) initiatorOrigin, perform the following steps. They return a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) or null.
1. Let type be the [computed type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type) of navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts).
2. If the user agent has been configured to process resources of the given type using some mechanism other than rendering the content in a [navigable](#731-navigables), then skip this step. Otherwise, if the type is one of the following types:

   an [HTML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#html-mime-type)

   Return the result of [loading an HTML document](#752-loading-html-documents), given navigationParams.

   an [XML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type) that is not an [explicitly supported XML MIME type](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry)

   Return the result of [loading an XML document](#753-loading-xml-documents) given navigationParams and type.

   a [JavaScript MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type)

   a [JSON MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type) that is not an [explicitly supported JSON MIME type](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry)

   "[`text/css`](#mime-types)"

   "[`text/plain`](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3)"

   "[`text/vtt`](#mime-types)"

   Return the result of [loading a text document](#754-loading-text-documents) given navigationParams and type.

   "[`multipart/x-mixed-replace`](#172-multipartx-mixed-replace)"

   Return the result of [loading a `multipart/x-mixed-replace` document](#755-loading-multipartx-mixed-replace-documents), given navigationParams, sourceSnapshotParams, and initiatorOrigin.

   a supported image, video, or audio type

   Return the result of [loading a media document](#756-loading-media-documents) given navigationParams and type.

   "`application/pdf`"

   "`text/pdf`"

   If the user agent's [PDF viewer supported](#81016-pdf-viewing-support) is true, return the result of [creating a document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom) given navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [id](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [navigation timing type](#7421-supporting-concepts), and navigationParams's [user involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts).

   Otherwise, proceed onward.

   An explicitly supported XML MIME type is an [XML MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type) for which the user agent is configured to use an external application to render the content, or for which the user agent has dedicated processing rules. For example, a web browser with a built-in Atom feed viewer would be said to explicitly support the [`application/atom+xml`](#mime-types) MIME type.

   An explicitly supported JSON MIME type is a [JSON MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type) for which the user agent is configured to use an external application to render the content, or for which the user agent has dedicated processing rules.

   > [!note]
   > In both cases, the external application or user agent will either [display the content inline](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom) directly in navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts), or [hand it off to external software](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software). Both happen in the steps below.

3. If, given type, the new resource is to be handled by displaying some sort of inline content, e.g., a native rendering of the content or an error message because the specified type is not supported, then return the result of [creating a document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM](#757-loading-a-document-for-inline-content-that-doesnt-have-a-dom) given navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [id](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [navigation timing type](#7421-supporting-concepts), and navigationParams's [user involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts).
4. Otherwise, the document's type is such that the resource will not affect navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts), e.g., because the resource is to be handed to an external application or because it is an unknown type that will be processed by [handle as a download](#466-downloading-resources). [Hand-off to external software](#74234-non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software) given navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts), navigationParams's [final sandboxing flag set](#7421-supporting-concepts), sourceSnapshotParams's [has transient activation](#7421-supporting-concepts), and initiatorOrigin.
5. Return null.

#### 7.4.6 Applying the history step

For both navigation and traversal, once we have an idea of where we want to head to in the session history, much of the work comes about in applying that notion to the [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) and the relevant [`Document`](#311-the-document-object). For navigations, this work generally occurs toward the end of the process; for traversals, it is the beginning.

##### 7.4.6.1 Updating the traversable

Ensuring a [traversable](#7311-traversable-navigables) ends up at the right session history step is particularly complex, as it can involve coordinating across multiple [navigable](#731-navigables) descendants of the traversable, [populating](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) them in parallel, and then synchronizing back up to ensure everyone has the same view of the result. This is further complicated by the existence of synchronous same-document navigations being mixed together with cross-document navigations, and how web pages have come to have certain relative timing expectations.

A changing navigable continuation state is used to store information during the [apply the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) algorithm, allowing parts of the algorithm to continue only after other parts have finished. It is a [struct](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-structs) with:

displayed document

A [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)

target entry

A [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries)

navigable

A [navigable](#731-navigables)

update only

A boolean

---

Although all updates to the [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) end up in the same [apply the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) algorithm, each possible entry point comes along with some minor customizations:
