To update for navigable creation/destruction given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable:
1. Let step be traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables).
2. Return the result of [applying the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) step to traversable given false, null, null, "[`none`](#7421-supporting-concepts)", and null.

To apply the push/replace history step given a non-negative integer step to a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, given a [history handling behavior](#7421-supporting-concepts) historyHandling and a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement:
1. Return the result of [applying the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) step to traversable given false, null, null, userInvolvement, and historyHandling.

> [!note]
> [Apply the push/replace history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) never passes [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) or an initiator [navigable](#731-navigables) to [apply the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable). This is because those checks are done earlier in the [navigation](#7422-beginning-navigation) algorithm.

To apply the reload history step to a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable given [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement:
1. Let step be traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables).
2. Return the result of [applying the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) step to traversable given true, null, null, userInvolvement, and "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)".

> [!note]
> [Apply the reload history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) never passes [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) or an initiator [navigable](#731-navigables) to [apply the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable). This is because reloading is always treated as if it were done by the [navigable](#731-navigables) itself, even in cases like `parent.location.reload()`.

To apply the traverse history step given a non-negative integer step to a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, with [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) sourceSnapshotParams, [navigable](#731-navigables) initiatorToCheck, and [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement:
1. Return the result of [applying the history step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) step to traversable given true, sourceSnapshotParams, initiatorToCheck, userInvolvement, and "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)".

To resume applying the traverse history step given a non-negative integer step, a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, [apply](#7461-updating-the-traversable) step to traversable given false, null, null, userInvolvement, and "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)".

> [!note]
> When resuming a traverse, we are already past the cancelation, initiator, and source snapshot checks, and this traversal has already been determined to be a same-document traversal. Hence, we can pass false and null for those arguments.

---

Now for the algorithm itself.

To apply the history step given a non-negative integer step to a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, with boolean checkForCancelation, [source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts)-or-null sourceSnapshotParams, [navigable](#731-navigables)-or-null initiatorToCheck, [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userInvolvement, and [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure)-or-null navigationType, perform the following steps. They return "`initiator-disallowed`", "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", "`canceled-by-navigate`", or "`applied`".
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): This is running within traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables).
2. Let targetStep be the result of [getting the used step](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and step.
3. If initiatorToCheck is not null:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): sourceSnapshotParams is not null.
   2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of [get all navigables whose current session history entry will change or reload](#7461-updating-the-traversable): if initiatorToCheck is not [allowed by sandboxing to navigate](#7424-preventing-navigation) navigable given sourceSnapshotParams, then return "`initiator-disallowed`".
4. Let navigablesCrossingDocuments be the result of [getting all navigables that might experience a cross-document traversal](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.
5. If checkForCancelation is true, and the result of [checking if unloading is canceled](#7424-preventing-navigation) given navigablesCrossingDocuments, traversable, targetStep, and userInvolvement is not "`continue`", then return that result.
6. Let changingNavigables be the result of [get all navigables whose current session history entry will change or reload](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.
7. Let nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates be the result of [getting all navigables that only need history object length/index update](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.
8. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of changingNavigables:
   1. Let targetEntry be the result of [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given navigable and targetStep.
   2. Set navigable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables) to targetEntry.
   3. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is not navigable's [active document](#731-navigables), then [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) of navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run these steps:
      1. Let navigation be navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
      2. Set navigation's [ongoing `navigate` event](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.
      3. Set navigation's [ongoing API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) to null.

      > [!note]
      > This prevents the [`navigateerror`](#events) event and the corresponding [signal](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) from firing as a result of a successful cross-document navigation.

   4. Set navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) to "`traversal`".

9. Let totalChangeJobs be the [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of changingNavigables.
10. Let completedChangeJobs be 0.
11. Let changingNavigableContinuations be an empty [queue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#512-queues) of [changing navigable continuation states](#7461-updating-the-traversable).

    > [!note]
    > This queue is used to split the operations on changingNavigables into two parts. Specifically, changingNavigableContinuations holds data for the [second part](#7461-updating-the-traversable).

12. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of changingNavigables, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) of navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run the steps:

    > [!note]
    > This set of steps are split into two parts to allow synchronous navigations to be processed before documents unload. State is stored in changingNavigableContinuations for the [second part](#7461-updating-the-traversable).
    1. Let displayedEntry be navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables).
    2. Let targetEntry be navigable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables).
    3. Let changingNavigableContinuation be a [changing navigable continuation state](#7461-updating-the-traversable) with:

       [displayed document](#7461-updating-the-traversable)

       displayedEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)

       [target entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable)

       targetEntry

       [navigable](#7461-updating-the-traversable)

       navigable

       [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable)

       false

    4. If displayedEntry is targetEntry and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is false:
       1. Set changingNavigableContinuation's [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable) to true.
       2. [Enqueue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#512-queues) changingNavigableContinuation on changingNavigableContinuations.
       3. Abort these steps.

       > [!note]
       > This case occurs due to a [synchronous navigation](#74233-fragment-navigations) which already updated the [active session history entry](#731-navigables).

    5. Switch on navigationType:

       "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

       [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is true.

       "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

       [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [ever populated](#7412-document-state) is true.

       "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

       [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): targetEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is displayedEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [ever populated](#7412-document-state) is false.

       "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

       [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): targetEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is displayedEntry's [step](#7411-session-history-entries) + 1 and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [ever populated](#7412-document-state) is false.

    6. Let oldOrigin be targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state).
    7. If all of the following are true:
       - navigationType is "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)";
       - navigable is not traversable;
       - targetEntry is not displayedEntry; and
       - oldOrigin is the [same](#711-origins) as displayedEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state),

       then:
       1. Let navigation be navigable's [active window](#731-navigables)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
       2. [Fire a traverse `navigate` event](#726104-firing-the-event) at navigation given targetEntry and userInvolvement.

    8. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is null, or targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is true:
       1. Let navTimingType be "[`back_forward`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward)" if targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is null; otherwise "[`reload`](https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-reload)".
       2. Let targetSnapshotParams be the result of [snapshotting target snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) given navigable.
       3. Let potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams be sourceSnapshotParams.
       4. If potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams is null, then set it to the result of [snapshotting source snapshot params](#7421-supporting-concepts) given navigable's [active document](#731-navigables).

          > [!note]
          > In this case there is no clear source of the traversal/reload. We treat this situation as if navigable navigated itself, but note that some properties of targetEntry's original initiator are preserved in targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries), such as the [initiator origin](#7412-document-state) and [referrer](#7412-document-state), which will appropriately influence the navigation.

       5. Set targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) to false.
       6. Let allowPOST be targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state).
       7. [In parallel](#211-parallelism), [attempt to populate the history entry's document](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) for targetEntry, given navigable, potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams, targetSnapshotParams, userInvolvement, with *[allowPOST](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry)* set to allowPOST and [*completionSteps*](#745-populating-a-session-history-entry) set to [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run afterDocumentPopulated.

       Otherwise, run afterDocumentPopulated [immediately](#211-parallelism).

       In both cases, let afterDocumentPopulated be the following steps:
       1. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is null, then set changingNavigableContinuation's [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable) to true.

          > [!note]
          > This means we tried to populate the document, but were unable to do so, e.g. because of the server returning a 204.

          > [!note]
          > These kinds of failed navigations or traversals will not be signaled to the [navigation API](#726-the-navigation-api) (e.g., through the promises of any [navigation API method tracker](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking), or the [`navigateerror`](#events) event). Doing so would leak information about the timing of responses from other origins, in the cross-origin case, and providing different results in the cross-origin vs. same-origin cases was deemed too confusing.
          > 
          > However, implementations could use this opportunity to clear any promise handlers for the [`navigation.transition.finished`](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) promise, as they are guaranteed at this point to never run. And, they might wish to [report a warning to the console](https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console) if any part of the navigation API initiated these navigations, to make it clear to the web developer why their promises will never settle and events will never fire.

       2. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin](#711-origins) with oldOrigin, then set targetEntry's [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries) to [StructuredSerializeForStorage](#275-structuredserializeforstorage--value-)(null).

          > [!note]
          > This clears history state when the origin changed vs a previous load of targetEntry without a redirect occuring. This can happen due to a change in CSP sandbox headers.

       3. If all of the following are true:
          - navigable's [parent](#731-navigables) is null;
          - targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts) is not an [auxiliary browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts) whose [opener browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts) is non-null; and
          - targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin](#711-origins) with oldOrigin,

          then set targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [navigable target name](#7412-document-state) to the empty string.

       4. [Enqueue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#512-queues) changingNavigableContinuation on changingNavigableContinuations.

          > [!note]
          > The rest of this job [runs later](#7461-updating-the-traversable) in this algorithm.

13. Let navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation be an empty [set](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets).
14. While completedChangeJobs does not equal totalChangeJobs:
    1. If traversable's [running nested apply history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) is false:
       1. While traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables)'s [algorithm set](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) one or more [synchronous navigation steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) with a [target navigable](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) not [contained](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation:
          1. Let steps be the first [item](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables)'s [algorithm set](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) that is [synchronous navigation steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) with a [target navigable](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) not [contained](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation.
          2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) steps from traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables)'s [algorithm set](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history).
          3. Set traversable's [running nested apply history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) to true.
          4. Run steps.
          5. Set traversable's [running nested apply history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) to false.

          > [!note]
          > Synchronous navigations that are intended to take place before this traversal jump the queue at this point, so they can be added to the correct place in traversable's [session history entries](#7311-traversable-navigables) before this traversal potentially unloads their document. [More details can be found here](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history).

    2. Let changingNavigableContinuation be the result of [dequeuing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#512-queues) from changingNavigableContinuations.
    3. If changingNavigableContinuation is nothing, then [continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
    4. Let displayedDocument be changingNavigableContinuation's [displayed document](#7461-updating-the-traversable).
    5. Let targetEntry be changingNavigableContinuation's [target entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable).
    6. Let navigable be changingNavigableContinuation's [navigable](#7461-updating-the-traversable).
    7. Let (scriptHistoryLength, scriptHistoryIndex) be the result of [getting the history object length and index](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.

       > [!note]
       > These values might have changed since they were last calculated.

    8. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable to navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation.

       > [!note]
       > Once a navigable has reached this point in traversal, additionally queued synchronous navigation steps are likely to be intended to occur after this traversal rather than before it, so they no longer jump the queue. [More details can be found here](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history).

    9. Let entriesForNavigationAPI be the result of [getting session history entries for the navigation API](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) given navigable and targetStep.
    10. If changingNavigableContinuation's [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable) is true, or targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is displayedDocument:

        > [!note]
        > This is a same-document navigation: we proceed without unloading.
        1. Set navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) to null.

           > [!note]
           > This allows new [navigations](#7422-beginning-navigation) of navigable to start, whereas during the traversal they were blocked.

        2. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to perform afterPotentialUnloads.

    11. Otherwise:
        1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigationType is not null.
        2. [Deactivate](#7461-updating-the-traversable) displayedDocument, given userInvolvement, targetEntry, navigationType, and afterPotentialUnloads.
    12. In both cases, let afterPotentialUnloads be the following steps:
        1. Let previousEntry be navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables).
        2. If changingNavigableContinuation's [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable) is false, then [activate history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) targetEntry for navigable.
        3. Let updateDocument be an algorithm step which performs [update document for history step application](#7462-updating-the-document) given targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries), targetEntry, changingNavigableContinuation's [update-only](#7461-updating-the-traversable), scriptHistoryLength, scriptHistoryIndex, navigationType, entriesForNavigationAPI, and previousEntry.
        4. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is equal to displayedDocument, then perform updateDocument.
        5. Otherwise, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to perform updateDocument.
        6. Increment completedChangeJobs.

15. Let totalNonchangingJobs be the [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates.

    > [!note]
    > This step onwards deliberately waits for all the previous operations to complete, as they include [processing synchronous navigations](#7461-updating-the-traversable) which will also post tasks to update history length and index.

16. Let completedNonchangingJobs be 0.
17. Let (scriptHistoryLength, scriptHistoryIndex) be the result of [getting the history object length and index](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given traversable and targetStep.
18. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run the steps:
    1. Let document be navigable's [active document](#731-navigables).
    2. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [index](#725-the-history-interface) to scriptHistoryIndex.
    3. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [length](#725-the-history-interface) to scriptHistoryLength.
    4. Increment completedNonchangingJobs.
19. Wait for completedNonchangingJobs to equal totalNonchangingJobs.
20. Set traversable's [current session history step](#7311-traversable-navigables) to targetStep.
21. Return "`applied`".

To deactivate a document for a cross-document navigation given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) displayedDocument, a [user navigation involvement](#7421-supporting-concepts) userNavigationInvolvement, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) targetEntry, a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) navigationType, and afterPotentialUnloads, which is an algorithm that receives no arguments:
1. Let navigable be displayedDocument's [node navigable](#731-navigables).
2. Let potentiallyTriggerViewTransition be false.
3. Let isBrowserUINavigation be true if userNavigationInvolvement is "[`browser UI`](#7421-supporting-concepts)"; otherwise false.
4. Set potentiallyTriggerViewTransition to the result of calling [can navigation trigger a cross-document view-transition?](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#can-navigation-trigger-a-cross-document-view-transition) given displayedDocument, targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries), navigationType, and isBrowserUINavigation.
5. If potentiallyTriggerViewTransition is false:
   1. Let firePageSwapBeforeUnload be the following step:
      1. [Fire the `pageswap` event](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given displayedDocument, targetEntry, navigationType, and null.
   2. Set navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) to null.

      > [!note]
      > This allows new [navigations](#7422-beginning-navigation) of navigable to start, whereas during the traversal they were blocked.

   3. [Unload a document and its descendants](#759-unloading-documents) given displayedDocument, targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries), afterPotentialUnloads, and firePageSwapBeforeUnload.

6. Otherwise, [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given navigable's [active window](#731-navigables) to run the steps:
   1. Let proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture be the following step:
      1. [Append the following session history traversal steps](#7413-centralized-modifications-of-session-history) to navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables):
         1. Set navigable's [ongoing navigation](#7425-aborting-navigation) to null.

            > [!note]
            > This allows new [navigations](#7422-beginning-navigation) of navigable to start, whereas during the traversal they were blocked.

         2. [Unload a document and its descendants](#759-unloading-documents) given displayedDocument, targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries), and afterPotentialUnloads.

   2. Let viewTransition be the result of [setting up a cross-document view-transition](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#setup-cross-document-view-transition) given displayedDocument, targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries), navigationType, and proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture.
   3. [Fire the `pageswap` event](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given displayedDocument, targetEntry, navigationType, and viewTransition.
   4. If viewTransition is null, then run proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture.

      > [!note]
      > In the case where a view transition started, the view transitions algorithms are responsible for calling proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture.

To fire the `pageswap` event given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) displayedDocument, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) targetEntry, a [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure) navigationType, and a [`ViewTransition`](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#viewtransition)-or-null viewTransition:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): this is running as part of a [task](#8171-definitions) queued on displayedDocument's [relevant agent](#8121-integration-with-the-javascript-agent-formalism)'s [event loop](#8171-definitions).
2. Let navigation be displayedDocument's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
3. Let activation be null.
4. If all of the following are true:
   - targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is [same origin](#711-origins) with displayedDocument's [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document); and
   - targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [was created via cross-origin redirects](#315-reporting-document-loading-status) is false, or targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [latest entry](#7412-document-state) is not null,

   then:
   1. Let destinationEntry be determined by switching on navigationType:

      "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      The [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation

      "[`traverse`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) in navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure) whose [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is targetEntry

      "[`push`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)"

      A new [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) in displayedDocument's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant) with its [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) set to targetEntry

   2. Set activation to a [new](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new) [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) created in displayedDocument's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant), with

      [old entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface)

      the [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure) of navigation

      [new entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface)

      destinationEntry

      [navigation type](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface)

      navigationType

   > [!note]
   > This means that a cross-origin redirect during a navigation would result in a null [`activation`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface) in the old document's [`PageSwapEvent`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface), unless the new document is being restored from [bfcache](#7412-document-state).

5. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`pageswap`](#events) at displayedDocument's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), using [`PageSwapEvent`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface) with its [`activation`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface) set to activation, and its [`viewTransition`](#7274-the-pageswapevent-interface) set to viewTransition.

To activate history entry [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry for [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable:
1. [Save persisted state](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) to the [navigable](#731-navigables)'s [active session history entry](#731-navigables).
2. Let newDocument be entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries).
3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): newDocument's [is initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) is false, i.e., we never traverse back to the [initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) because it always gets [replaced](#7422-beginning-navigation) when we navigate away from it.
4. Set navigable's [active session history entry](#731-navigables) to entry.
5. [Make active](#7462-updating-the-document) newDocument.
6. [Set the initial visibility state](#62-page-visibility) of newDocument to navigable's [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables)'s [system visibility state](#7311-traversable-navigables).

To get the used step given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and a non-negative integer step, perform the following steps. They return a non-negative integer.
1. Let steps be the result of [getting all used history steps](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) within traversable.
2. Return the greatest [item](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in steps that is less than or equal to step.

   > [!note]
   > This caters for situations where there's no [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) with [step](#7411-session-history-entries) step, due to the removal of a [navigable](#731-navigables).

To get the history object length and index given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and a non-negative integer step, perform the following steps. They return a [tuple](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#531-tuples) of two non-negative integers.
1. Let steps be the result of [getting all used history steps](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) within traversable.
2. Let scriptHistoryLength be the [size](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of steps.
3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): steps [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) step.

   > [!note]
   > It is assumed that step has been adjusted by [getting the used step](#7461-updating-the-traversable).

4. Let scriptHistoryIndex be the index of step in steps.
5. Return (scriptHistoryLength, scriptHistoryIndex).

To get all navigables whose current session history entry will change or reload given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and a non-negative integer targetStep, perform the following steps. They return a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [navigables](#731-navigables).
1. Let results be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
2. Let navigablesToCheck be « traversable ».

   > [!note]
   > This list is extended in the loop below.

3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of navigablesToCheck:
   1. Let targetEntry be the result of [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given navigable and targetStep.
   2. If targetEntry is not navigable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables) or targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is true, then [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable to results.
   3. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is navigable's [active document](#731-navigables), and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is false, then [extend](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigablesToCheck with the [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) of navigable.

      > [!note]
      > Adding [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) to navigablesToCheck means those navigables will also be checked by this loop. [Child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) are only checked if the navigable's [active document](#731-navigables) will not change as part of this traversal.

4. Return results.

To get all navigables that only need history object length/index update given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and a non-negative integer targetStep, perform the following steps. They return a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [navigables](#731-navigables).

> [!note]
> Other [navigables](#731-navigables) might not be impacted by the traversal. For example, if the response is a 204, the currently active document will remain. Additionally, going 'back' after a 204 will change the [current session history entry](#731-navigables), but the [active session history entry](#731-navigables) will already be correct.
1. Let results be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
2. Let navigablesToCheck be « traversable ».

   > [!note]
   > This list is extended in the loop below.

3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of navigablesToCheck:
   1. Let targetEntry be the result of [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given navigable and targetStep.
   2. If targetEntry is navigable's [current session history entry](#731-navigables) and targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is false:
      1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable to results.
      2. [Extend](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigablesToCheck with navigable's [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables).

         > [!note]
         > Adding [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) to navigablesToCheck means those navigables will also be checked by this loop. [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) are only checked if the navigable's [active document](#731-navigables) will not change as part of this traversal.

4. Return results.

To get the target history entry given a [navigable](#731-navigables) navigable, and a non-negative integer step, perform the following steps. They return a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries).
1. Let entries be the result of [getting session history entries](#7414-low-level-operations-on-session-history) for navigable.
2. Return the [item](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) in entries that has the greatest [step](#7411-session-history-entries) less than or equal to step.

> [!example]
> To see why [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) returns the entry with the greatest [step](#7411-session-history-entries) less than or equal to the input step, consider the following [Jake diagram](#7314-jake-diagrams):
> 
> |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | `top` | /t | /t#foo |
> | `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |
> 
> For the input step 1, the target history entry for the `top` navigable is the `/t` entry, whose [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is 0, while the target history entry for the `frames[0]` navigable is the `/i-0-b` entry, whose [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is 1:
> 
> |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | `top` | /t | /t#foo |
> | `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |
> 
> Similarly, given the input step 3 we get the `top` entry whose [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is 3, and the `frames[0]` entry whose [step](#7411-session-history-entries) is 1:
> 
> |  | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | `top` | /t | /t#foo |
> | `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |

To get all navigables that might experience a cross-document traversal given a [traversable navigable](#7311-traversable-navigables) traversable, and a non-negative integer targetStep, perform the following steps. They return a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [navigables](#731-navigables).

> [!note]
> From traversable's [session history traversal queue](#7311-traversable-navigables)'s perspective, these documents are candidates for going cross-document during the traversal described by targetStep. They will not experience a cross-document traversal if the status code for their target document is HTTP 204 No Content.
> 
> Note that if a given [navigable](#731-navigables) might experience a cross-document traversal, this algorithm will return [navigable](#731-navigables) but not its [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables). Those would end up [unloaded](#759-unloading-documents), not traversed.
1. Let results be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
2. Let navigablesToCheck be « traversable ».

   > [!note]
   > This list is extended in the loop below.

3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of navigablesToCheck:
   1. Let targetEntry be the result of [getting the target history entry](#7461-updating-the-traversable) given navigable and targetStep.
   2. If targetEntry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is not navigable's [active document](#731-navigables) or targetEntry's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [reload pending](#7412-document-state) is true, then [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable to results.

      > [!note]
      > Although navigable's [active history entry](#731-navigables) can change synchronously, the new entry will always have the same [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), so accessing navigable's [active document](#731-navigables) is reliable.

   3. Otherwise, [extend](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigablesToCheck with navigable's [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables).

      > [!note]
      > Adding [child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) to navigablesToCheck means those navigables will also be checked by this loop. [Child navigables](#7313-child-navigables) are only checked if the navigable's [active document](#731-navigables) will not change as part of this traversal.

4. Return results.

##### 7.4.6.2 Updating the document

To update document for history step application given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document, a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry, a boolean doNotReactivate, integers scriptHistoryLength and scriptHistoryIndex, [`NavigationType`](#7263-core-infrastructure)-or-null navigationType, an optional [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) entriesForNavigationAPI, and an optional [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) previousEntryForActivation:
1. Let documentIsNew be true if document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state) is null; otherwise false.
2. Let documentsEntryChanged be true if document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state) is not entry; otherwise false.
3. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [index](#725-the-history-interface) to scriptHistoryIndex.
4. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [length](#725-the-history-interface) to scriptHistoryLength.
5. Let navigation be history's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface).
6. If documentsEntryChanged is true:
   1. Let oldURL be document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state)'s [URL](#7411-session-history-entries).
   2. Set document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state) to entry.
   3. [Restore the history object state](#7462-updating-the-document) given document and entry.
   4. If documentIsNew is false:
      1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): navigationType is not null.
      2. [Update the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) given navigation, entry, and navigationType.
      3. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`popstate`](#events) at document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), using [`PopStateEvent`](#7272-the-popstateevent-interface), with the [`state`](#7272-the-popstateevent-interface) attribute initialized to document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [state](#725-the-history-interface) and [`hasUAVisualTransition`](#7272-the-popstateevent-interface) initialized to true if a visual transition, to display a cached rendered state of the [latest entry](#7412-document-state), was done by the user agent.
      4. [Restore persisted state](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) given entry.
      5. If oldURL's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) is not equal to entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment), then [queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [DOM manipulation task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to [fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`hashchange`](#events) at document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), using [`HashChangeEvent`](#7273-the-hashchangeevent-interface), with the [`oldURL`](#7273-the-hashchangeevent-interface) attribute initialized to the [serialization](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) of oldURL and the [`newURL`](#7273-the-hashchangeevent-interface) attribute initialized to the [serialization](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) of entry's [URL](#7411-session-history-entries).
   5. Otherwise:
      1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): entriesForNavigationAPI is given.
      2. [Restore persisted state](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) given entry.
      3. [Initialize the navigation API entries for a new document](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) given navigation, entriesForNavigationAPI, and entry.
7. If all the following are true:
   - previousEntryForActivation is given;
   - navigationType is non-null; and
   - navigationType is "[`reload`](#7263-core-infrastructure)" or previousEntryForActivation's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) is not document,

   then:
   1. If navigation's [activation](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) is null, then set navigation's [activation](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) to a new [`NavigationActivation`](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) object in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
   2. Let previousEntryIndex be the result of [getting the navigation API entry index](#7263-core-infrastructure) of previousEntryForActivation within navigation.
   3. If previousEntryIndex is non-negative, then set activation's [old entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) to navigation's [entry list](#7263-core-infrastructure)\[previousEntryIndex\].
   4. Otherwise, if all the following are true:
      - navigationType is "[`replace`](#7263-core-infrastructure)";
      - previousEntryForActivation's [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [origin](#7412-document-state) is [same origin](#711-origins) with document's [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document); and
      - previousEntryForActivation's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [is initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) is false,

      then set activation's [old entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) to a new [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) in navigation's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant), whose [session history entry](#7265-the-navigationhistoryentry-interface) is previousEntryForActivation.

   5. Set activation's [new entry](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) to navigation's [current entry](#7263-core-infrastructure).
   6. Set activation's [navigation type](#7269-the-navigationactivation-interface) to navigationType.

8. If documentIsNew is true:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): document's [during-loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](#311-the-document-object) is not null.
   2. Invoke [WebDriver BiDi navigation committed](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-committed) with navigable and a new [WebDriver BiDi navigation status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status) whose [id](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id) is document's [during-loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](#311-the-document-object), [status](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status) is "[`committed`](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-committed)", and [url](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url) is document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
   3. [Try to scroll to the fragment](#7462-updating-the-document) for document.
   4. At this point scripts may run for the newly-created document document.
9. Otherwise, if documentsEntryChanged is false and doNotReactivate is false:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): entriesForNavigationAPI is given.
   2. [Reactivate](#7462-updating-the-document) document given entry and entriesForNavigationAPI.

   > [!note]
   > documentsEntryChanged can be false for one of two reasons: either we are restoring from [bfcache](#7412-document-state), or we are asynchronously finishing up a synchronous navigation which already synchronously set document's [latest entry](#7412-document-state). The doNotReactivate argument distinguishes between these two cases.

To restore the history object state given [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document and [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry:
1. Let targetRealm be document's [relevant realm](#81334-relevant).
2. Let state be [StructuredDeserialize](#276-structureddeserialize--serialized-targetrealm---memory--)(entry's [classic history API state](#7411-session-history-entries), targetRealm). If this throws an exception, catch it and let state be null.
3. Set document's [history object](#725-the-history-interface)'s [state](#725-the-history-interface) to state.

To make active a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document:
1. Let window be document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant).
2. Set document's [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts)'s [active document](#732-browsing-contexts) to document.
3. Set document's [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts)'s [`WindowProxy`](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object)'s [\[\[Window\]\]](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) internal slot value to window.
4. Set window's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant)'s [execution ready flag](#8131-environments).

To reactivate a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document given a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) reactivatedEntry and a [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of [session history entries](#7411-session-history-entries) entriesForNavigationAPI:

> [!note]
> This algorithm updates document after it has come out of [bfcache](#7412-document-state), i.e., after it has been made [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents) again. Other specifications that want to watch for this change to the [fully active](#733-fully-active-documents) state are encouraged to add steps into this algorithm, so that the ordering of events that happen in effect of the change is clear.
1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) formControl of form controls in document with an [autofill field name](#4101972-processing-model) of "[`off`](#4101971-autofilling-form-controls-the-autocomplete-attribute)", invoke the [reset algorithm](#41023-resetting-a-form) for formControl.
2. If document's [suspended timer handles](#759-unloading-documents) is not [empty](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists):
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): document's [suspension time](#759-unloading-documents) is not zero.
   2. Let suspendDuration be the [current high resolution time](https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time) minus document's [suspension time](#759-unloading-documents).
   3. Let activeTimers be document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [map of active timers](#87-timers).
   4. For each handle in document's [suspended timer handles](#759-unloading-documents), if activeTimers\[handle\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then increase activeTimers\[handle\] by suspendDuration.
3. [Update the navigation API entries for reactivation](#7264-initializing-and-updating-the-entry-list) given document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface), entriesForNavigationAPI, and reactivatedEntry.
4. If document's [current document readiness](#315-reporting-document-loading-status) is "`complete`", and document's [page showing](#759-unloading-documents) is false:
   1. Set document's [page showing](#759-unloading-documents) to true.
   2. Set document's [has been revealed](#7463-revealing-the-document) to false.
   3. [Update the visibility state](#62-page-visibility) of document to "`visible`".
   4. [Fire a page transition event](#7276-the-pagetransitionevent-interface) named [`pageshow`](#events) at document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) with true.

To try to scroll to the fragment for a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document, perform the following steps [in parallel](#211-parallelism):
1. Wait for an [implementation-defined](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#23-terminology) amount of time. (This is intended to allow the user agent to optimize the user experience in the face of performance concerns.)
2. [Queue a global task](#8172-queuing-tasks) on the [navigation and traversal task source](#8174-generic-task-sources) given document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant) to run these steps:
   1. If document has no parser, or its parser has [stopped parsing](#1327-the-end), or the user agent has reason to believe the user is no longer interested in scrolling to the [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment), then abort these steps.
   2. [Scroll to the fragment](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) given document.
   3. If document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is still null, then [try to scroll to the fragment](#7462-updating-the-document) for document.

To make document unsalvageable, given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document and a string reason:
1. Let details be a new [not restored reason details](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) whose [reason](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) is reason.
2. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) details to document's [bfcache blocking details](#311-the-document-object).
3. Set document's *[salvageable](#759-unloading-documents)* state to false.

To build not restored reasons for document state given [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document:
1. Let notRestoredReasonsForDocument be a new [not restored reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface).
2. Set notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [URL](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).
3. Let container be document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [container](#7313-child-navigables).
4. If container is an [`iframe`](#485-the-iframe-element) element:
   1. Let src be the empty string.
   2. If container has a [`src`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute:
      1. Let src be the result of [encoding-parsing-and-serializing a URL](#242-parsing-urls) given container's [`src`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute's value, relative to container's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node).
      2. If src is failure, then set src to container's [`src`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute's value.
   3. Set notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [src](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to src.
   4. Set notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [id](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to container's [`id`](#326-global-attributes) attribute's value, or the empty string if it has no such attribute.
   5. Set notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [name](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to container's [`name`](#485-the-iframe-element) attribute's value, or the empty string if it has no such attribute.
5. Set notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to a [clone](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) of document's [bfcache blocking details](#311-the-document-object).
6. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) navigable of document's [document-tree child navigables](#7315-related-navigable-collections):
   1. Let childDocument be navigable's [active document](#731-navigables).
   2. [Build not restored reasons for document state](#7462-updating-the-document) given childDocument.
   3. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) childDocument's [not restored reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to notRestoredReasonsForDocument's [children](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface).
7. Set document's [node navigable](#731-navigables)'s [active session history entry](#731-navigables)'s [document state](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [not restored reasons](#7412-document-state) to notRestoredReasonsForDocument.

To build not restored reasons for a top-level traversable and its descendants given [top-level traversable](#7312-top-level-traversables) topLevelTraversable:
1. [Build not restored reasons for document state](#7462-updating-the-document) given topLevelTraversable's [active document](#731-navigables).
2. Let crossOriginDescendants be an empty [list](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists).
3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) childNavigable of topLevelTraversable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [descendant navigables](#7315-related-navigable-collections):
   1. If childNavigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is not [same origin](#711-origins) with topLevelTraversable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), then [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) childNavigable to crossOriginDescendants.
4. Let crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache be false.
5. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) crossOriginNavigable of crossOriginDescendants:
   1. Let reasonsForCrossOriginChild be crossOriginNavigable's [active document](#731-navigables)'s [document state](#7412-document-state)'s [not restored reasons](#7412-document-state).
   2. If reasonsForCrossOriginChild's [reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) is not empty, set crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache to true.
   3. Set reasonsForCrossOriginChild's [URL](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to null.
   4. Set reasonsForCrossOriginChild's [reasons](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to null.
   5. Set reasonsForCrossOriginChild's [children](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface) to null.
6. If crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache is true, [make document unsalvageable](#7462-updating-the-document) given topLevelTraversable's [active document](#731-navigables) and "[`masked`](#728-the-notrestoredreasons-interface)".

##### 7.4.6.3 Revealing the document

A [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) has a boolean has been revealed, initially false. It is used to ensure that the [`pagereveal`](#events) event is fired once for each activation of the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) (once when it's rendered initially, and once for each [reactivation](#7462-updating-the-document)).

To reveal a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document:
1. If document's [has been revealed](#7463-revealing-the-document) is true, then return.
2. Set document's [has been revealed](#7463-revealing-the-document) to true.
3. Let transition be the result of [resolving inbound cross-document view-transition](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#resolve-inbound-cross-document-view-transition) for document.
4. [Fire an event](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#210-firing-events) named [`pagereveal`](#events) at document's [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), using [`PageRevealEvent`](#7275-the-pagerevealevent-interface) with its [`viewTransition`](#7275-the-pagerevealevent-interface) set to transition.
5. If transition is not null:
   1. [Prepare to run script](#8144-calling-scripts) given document's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).
   2. [Activate](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#activate-view-transition) transition.
   3. [Clean up after running script](#8144-calling-scripts) given document's [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).

   > [!note]
   > Activating a view transition might resolve/reject promises, so by wrapping the activation with prepare/cleanup we ensure those promises are handled before the next rendering step.

> [!note]
> Though [`pagereveal`](#events) is guaranteed to be fired during the first [update the rendering](#8173-processing-model) step that displays an up-to-date version of the page, user agents are free to display a cached frame of the page before firing it. This prevents the presence of a [`pagereveal`](#events) handler from delaying the presentation of such cached frame.

##### 7.4.6.4 Scrolling to a fragment

To scroll to the fragment given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document:
1. If document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is null, then set document's [target element](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) to null.
2. Otherwise, if document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is [top of the document](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment):
   1. Set document's [target element](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) to null.
   2. [Scroll to the beginning of the document](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document) for document. [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#references)
   3. Return.
3. Otherwise:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is an element.
   2. Let target be document's [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment).
   3. Set document's [target element](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) to target.
   4. Run the [ancestor revealing algorithm](#61-the-hidden-attribute) on target.
   5. [Scroll target into view](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-a-target-into-view), with *behavior* set to "auto", *block* set to "start", and *inline* set to "nearest". [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#references)
   6. Run the [focusing steps](#664-processing-model) for target, with the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport) as the *fallback target*.
   7. Move the [sequential focus navigation starting point](#665-sequential-focus-navigation) to target.

A [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s indicated part is the one that its [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)'s [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) identifies, or null if the fragment does not identify anything. The semantics of the [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) in terms of mapping it to a node is defined by the specification that defines the [MIME type](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type) used by the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) (for example, the processing of [fragments](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment) for [XML MIME types](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type) is the responsibility of RFC7303). [\[RFC7303\]](#references)

There is also a target element for each [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), which is used in defining the [`:target`](#4163-pseudo-classes) pseudo-class and is updated by the above algorithm. It is initially null.

For an [HTML document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) document, its [indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) is the result of [selecting the indicated part](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) given document and document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document).

To select the indicated part given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document and a [URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) url:
1. If document's [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) does not [equal](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals) url with *[exclude fragments](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments)* set to true, then return null.
2. Let fragment be url's [fragment](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment).
3. If fragment is the empty string, then return the special value top of the document.
4. Let potentialIndicatedElement be the result of [finding a potential indicated element](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) given document and fragment.
5. If potentialIndicatedElement is not null, then return potentialIndicatedElement.
6. Let fragmentBytes be the result of [percent-decoding](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-percent-decode) fragment.
7. Let decodedFragment be the result of running [UTF-8 decode without BOM](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode-without-bom) on fragmentBytes.
8. Set potentialIndicatedElement to the result of [finding a potential indicated element](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment) given document and decodedFragment.
9. If potentialIndicatedElement is not null, then return potentialIndicatedElement.
10. If decodedFragment is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string `top`, then return the [top of the document](#7464-scrolling-to-a-fragment).
11. Return null.

To find a potential indicated element given a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document and a string fragment, run these steps:
1. If there is an element [in the document tree](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#421-document-tree) whose [root](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees) is document and that has an [ID](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) equal to fragment, then return the first such element in [tree order](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).
2. If there is an [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element [in the document tree](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#421-document-tree) whose [root](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees) is document that has a [`name`](#162-non-conforming-features) attribute whose value is equal to fragment, then return the first such element in [tree order](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).
3. Return null.

##### 7.4.6.5 Persisted history entry state

To save persisted state to a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry:
1. Set the [scroll position data](#7411-session-history-entries) of entry to contain the scroll positions for all of entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [restorable scrollable regions](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state).
2. Optionally, update entry's [persisted user state](#7411-session-history-entries) to reflect any state that the user agent wishes to persist, such as the values of form fields.

To restore persisted state from a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry:
1. If entry's [scroll restoration mode](#7411-session-history-entries) is "[`auto`](#7411-session-history-entries)", and entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant)'s [navigation API](#7262-the-navigation-interface)'s [suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is false, then [restore scroll position data](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) given entry.

   > [!note]
   > The user agent not restoring scroll positions does not imply that scroll positions will be left at any particular value (e.g., (0,0)). The actual scroll position depends on the navigation type and the user agent's particular caching strategy. So web applications cannot assume any particular scroll position but rather are urged to set it to what they want it to be.

   > [!note]
   > If [suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation](#7268-ongoing-navigation-tracking) is true, then [restoring scroll position data](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) might still happen at a later point, as part of [finishing](#726105-scroll-and-focus-behavior) the relevant [`NavigateEvent`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface), or via a [`navigateEvent.scroll()`](#726101-the-navigateevent-interface) method call.

2. Optionally, update other aspects of entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries) and its rendering, for instance values of form fields, that the user agent had previously recorded in entry's [persisted user state](#7411-session-history-entries).

   > [!note]
   > This can even include updating the [`dir`](#3264-the-dir-attribute) attribute of [`textarea`](#41011-the-textarea-element) elements or [`input`](#4105-the-input-element) elements whose [`type`](#4105-the-input-element) attribute is in the [Text](#410512-text-typetext-state-and-search-state-typesearch), [Search](#410512-text-typetext-state-and-search-state-typesearch), [Telephone](#410513-telephone-state-typetel), [URL](#410514-url-state-typeurl), or [Email](#410515-email-state-typeemail) state, if the persisted state includes the directionality of user input in such controls.

   > [!note]
   > Restoring the value of form controls as part of this process does not fire any [`input`](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input) or [`change`](#events) events, but can trigger the `formStateRestoreCallback` of [form-associated custom elements](#4133-core-concepts).

---

Each [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) has a boolean has been scrolled by the user, initially false. If the user scrolls the document, the user agent must set that document's [has been scrolled by the user](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) to true.

The restorable scrollable regions of a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) document are document's [viewport](https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport), and all of document's scrollable regions excepting any [navigable containers](#7313-child-navigables).

> [!note]
> [Child navigable](#7313-child-navigables) scroll restoration is handled as part of state restoration for the [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) for those [navigables](#731-navigables)' [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)s.

To restore scroll position data given a [session history entry](#7411-session-history-entries) entry:
1. Let document be entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries).
2. If document's [has been scrolled by the user](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) is true, then the user agent should return.
3. The user agent should attempt to use entry's [scroll position data](#7411-session-history-entries) to restore the scroll positions of entry's [document](#7411-session-history-entries)'s [restorable scrollable regions](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state). The user agent may continue to attempt to do so periodically, until document's [has been scrolled by the user](#7465-persisted-history-entry-state) becomes true.

   > [!note]
   > This is formulated as an *attempt*, which is potentially repeated until success or until the user scrolls, due to the fact that relevant content indicated by the [scroll position data](#7411-session-history-entries) might take some time to load from the network.

   > [!note]
   > Scroll restoration might be affected by scroll anchoring. [\[CSSSCROLLANCHORING\]](#references)

### 7.5 Document lifecycle

#### 7.5.1 Shared document creation infrastructure

When loading a document using one of the below algorithms, we use the following steps to create and initialize a `Document` object, given a [type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) type, [content type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) contentType, and [navigation params](#7421-supporting-concepts) navigationParams:

> [!note]
> [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) objects are also created when [creating a new browsing context and document](#7321-creating-browsing-contexts); such [initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) are never created by this algorithm. Also, [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts)-less [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) objects can be created via various APIs, such as [`document.implementation.createHTMLDocument()`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#451-interface-domimplementation).
1. Let browsingContext be the result of [obtaining a browsing context to use for a navigation response](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy) given navigationParams.

   > [!note]
   > This can result in a [browsing context group switch](#7132-browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-opener-policy), in which case browsingContext will be a [newly-created](#7321-creating-browsing-contexts) [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts) instead of being navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [active browsing context](#731-navigables). In such a case, the created [`Window`](#722-the-window-object), [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), and [agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-agents) will not end up being used; because the created [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is [opaque](#711-origins), we will end up creating a new [agent](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-agents) and [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) [later in this algorithm](#751-shared-document-creation-infrastructure) to go along with the new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

2. Let permissionsPolicy be the result of [creating a permissions policy from a response](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#create-from-response) given navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [container](#7313-child-navigables), navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts), and navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts). [\[PERMISSIONSPOLICY\]](#references)

   > [!note]
   > The [creating a permissions policy from a response](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#create-from-response) algorithm makes use of the passed [origin](#711-origins). If [`document.domain`](#7112-relaxing-the-same-origin-restriction) has been used for navigationParams's [navigable](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [container document](#7313-child-navigables), then its [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) cannot be [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with the passed origin, because these steps run before the document is created, so it cannot itself yet have used [`document.domain`](#7112-relaxing-the-same-origin-restriction). Note that this means that Permissions Policy checks are less permissive compared to doing a [same origin](#711-origins) check instead.
   > 
   > See below for some examples of this in action.

3. Let creationURL be navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url).
4. If navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts) is non-null, then set creationURL to navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [current URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url).
5. Let window be null.
6. If browsingContext's [active document](#732-browsing-contexts)'s [is initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) is true, and browsingContext's [active document](#732-browsing-contexts)'s [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document) is [same origin-domain](#711-origins) with navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts), then set window to browsingContext's [active window](#732-browsing-contexts).

   > [!note]
   > This means that both the [initial `about:blank`](#311-the-document-object) [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), and the new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) that is about to be created, will share the same [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object.

7. Otherwise:
   1. Let oacHeader be the result of [getting a structured field value](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-get-structured-header) given \`[`Origin-Agent-Cluster`](#712-origin-keyed-agent-clusters)\` and "`item`" from navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [header list](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list).
   2. Let requestsOAC be true if oacHeader is not null and oacHeader\[0\] is the [boolean](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html#boolean) true; otherwise false.
   3. If navigationParams's [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts) is a [non-secure context](#8135-secure-contexts), then set requestsOAC to false.
   4. Let agent be the result of [obtaining a similar-origin window agent](#8122-integration-with-the-javascript-agent-cluster-formalism) given navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts), browsingContext's [group](#7323-groupings-of-browsing-contexts), and requestsOAC.
   5. Let realmExecutionContext be the result of [creating a new realm](#8133-realms-settings-objects-and-global-objects) given agent and the following customizations:
      - For the global object, create a new [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) object.
      - For the global **this** binding, use browsingContext's [`WindowProxy`](#723-the-windowproxy-exotic-object) object.
   6. Set window to the [global object](#8133-realms-settings-objects-and-global-objects) of realmExecutionContext's Realm component.
   7. Let topLevelCreationURL be creationURL.
   8. Let topLevelOrigin be navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts).
   9. If navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables) is not null:
      1. Let parentEnvironment be navigable's [container](#7313-child-navigables)'s [relevant settings object](#81334-relevant).
      2. Set topLevelCreationURL to parentEnvironment's [top-level creation URL](#8131-environments).
      3. Set topLevelOrigin to parentEnvironment's [top-level origin](#8131-environments).
   10. [Set up a window environment settings object](#7226-script-settings-for-window-objects) with creationURL, realmExecutionContext, navigationParams's [reserved environment](#7421-supporting-concepts), topLevelCreationURL, and topLevelOrigin.

   > [!note]
   > This is the usual case, where the new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) we're about to create gets a new [`Window`](#722-the-window-object) to go along with it.

8. Let loadTimingInfo be a new [document load timing info](#315-reporting-document-loading-status) with its [navigation start time](#315-reporting-document-loading-status) set to navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [timing info](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-timing-info)'s [start time](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-timing-info-start-time).
9. Let document be a new [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), with

   [type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

   type

   [content type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

   contentType

   [origin](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

   navigationParams's [origin](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [browsing context](#732-browsing-contexts)

   browsingContext

   [policy container](#311-the-document-object)

   navigationParams's [policy container](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [permissions policy](#311-the-document-object)

   permissionsPolicy

   [active sandboxing flag set](#715-sandboxing)

   navigationParams's [final sandboxing flag set](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [opener policy](#311-the-document-object)

   navigationParams's [cross-origin opener policy](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [load timing info](#315-reporting-document-loading-status)

   loadTimingInfo

   [was created via cross-origin redirects](#315-reporting-document-loading-status)

   true if navigationParams's [response](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [redirect taint](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#response-redirect-taint) is not "`same-origin`"; otherwise false

   [during-loading navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi](#311-the-document-object)

   navigationParams's [id](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [URL](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

   creationURL

   [current document readiness](#315-reporting-document-loading-status)

   "`loading`"

   [about base URL](#311-the-document-object)

   navigationParams's [about base URL](#7421-supporting-concepts)

   [allow declarative shadow roots](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md)

   true

   [custom element registry](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document)

   a new [`CustomElementRegistry`](#4134-the-customelementregistry-interface) object

10. Set window's [associated `Document`](#722-the-window-object) to document.
11. Set document's [internal ancestor origin objects list](#313-ancestor-origins) to the result of running the [internal ancestor origin objects list creation steps](#313-ancestor-origins) given document and navigationParams's [`iframe` element referrer policy](#7421-supporting-concepts).
12. Set document's [ancestor origins list](#313-ancestor-origins) to the result of running the [ancestor origins list creation steps](#313-ancestor-origins) given document.
13. [Run CSP initialization for a `Document`](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#run-document-csp-initialization) given document. [\[CSP\]](#references)
14. If navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts) is non-null:
    1. Set document's [referrer](#31-documents) to the empty string.
    2. Let referrer be navigationParams's [request](#7421-supporting-concepts)'s [referrer](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer).
    3. If referrer is a [URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url), then set document's [referrer](#31-documents) to the [serialization](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer) of referrer.

       > [!note]
       > Per Fetch, referrer will be either a [URL record](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) or "`no-referrer`" at this point.

15. If navigationParams's [fetch controller](#7421-supporting-concepts) is not null:
