> The [`outerHTML`](#855-the-outerhtml-property) property has a number of outstanding issues in the DOM Parsing and Serialization [issue tracker](https://github.com/w3c/DOM-Parsing/issues), documenting various problems with its specification.

`element.outerHTML`

Returns a fragment of HTML or XML that represents the element and its contents.

In the case of an XML document, throws an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if the element cannot be serialized to XML.

`element.outerHTML = value`

Replaces the element with nodes parsed from the given string.

In the case of an XML document, throws a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if the given string is not well-formed.

Throws a ["`NoModificationAllowedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#nomodificationallowederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if the parent of the element is a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

> [!warning]
> By default, this property's setter performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous elements and attributes like [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) or [event handler content attributes](#8181-event-handlers).

[`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)'s `outerHTML` getter steps are:
1. Let element be a fictional node whose only child is [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).
2. Return the result of running [fragment serializing algorithm steps](#854-the-innerhtml-property) with element and true.

[`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)'s [`outerHTML`](#855-the-outerhtml-property) setter steps are:
1. Let (compliantString, compliantOptions) be the result of invoking the [get trusted type compliant input](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-input) algorithm with [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), the given value, a new [`SetHTMLUnsafeOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) dictionary, "`Element outerHTML`", [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node)'s [type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), and false.
2. Let parent be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [parent](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).
3. If parent is null, return. There would be no way to obtain a reference to the nodes created even if the remaining steps were run.
4. If parent is a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), throw a ["`NoModificationAllowedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#nomodificationallowederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).
5. If parent is a [`DocumentFragment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-interface-documentfragment), set parent to the result of [creating an element](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node), "`body`", and the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces).
6. Let fragment be the result of invoking the [fragment parsing algorithm steps](#854-the-innerhtml-property) given parent, compliantString, compliantOptions, and [Legacy](#854-the-innerhtml-property).
7. [Replace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) with fragment within [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [parent](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).

#### 8.5.6 The [`insertAdjacentHTML()`](#856-the-insertadjacenthtml-method) method

> [!warning]
> The [`insertAdjacentHTML()`](#856-the-insertadjacenthtml-method) method has a number of outstanding issues in the DOM Parsing and Serialization [issue tracker](https://github.com/w3c/DOM-Parsing/issues), documenting various problems with its specification.

`element.insertAdjacentHTML(position, string)`

Parses string as HTML or XML and inserts the resulting nodes into the tree in the position given by the position argument, as follows:

"`beforebegin`"

Before the element itself (i.e., after element's previous sibling)

"`afterbegin`"

Just inside the element, before its first child.

"`beforeend`"

Just inside the element, after its last child.

"`afterend`"

After the element itself (i.e., before element's next sibling)

Throws a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if the arguments have invalid values (e.g., in the case of an [XML document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), if the given string is not well-formed).

Throws a ["`NoModificationAllowedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#nomodificationallowederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if the given position isn't possible (e.g. inserting elements after the root element of a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object)).

> [!warning]
> By default, this method performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous elements and attributes like [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) or [event handler content attributes](#8181-event-handlers).

[`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)'s `insertAdjacentHTML(position,
  string)` method steps are:
1. Let (compliantString, compliantOptions) be the result of invoking the [get trusted type compliant input](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-input) algorithm with [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), string, a new [`SetHTMLUnsafeOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) dictionary, "`Element
      insertAdjacentHTML`", [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node)'s [type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), and false.
2. Let context be null.
3. Use the first matching item from this list:

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`beforebegin`"

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`afterend`"
   1. Set context to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [parent](#7224-accessing-related-windows).
   2. If context is null or a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object), throw a ["`NoModificationAllowedError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#nomodificationallowederror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`afterbegin`"

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`beforeend`"

   Set context to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).

   Otherwise

   Throw a ["`SyntaxError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException).

4. If context is not an [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) or all of the following are true:
   - context's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node) is an HTML document;
   - context's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) is "[`html`](#411-the-html-element)"; and
   - context's [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) is the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces),

   then set context to the result of [creating an element](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) given [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node), "`body`", and the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces).

5. Let fragment be the result of invoking the [fragment parsing algorithm steps](#854-the-innerhtml-property) given context, compliantString, compliantOptions, and [Legacy](#854-the-innerhtml-property).
6. Use the first matching item from this list:

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`beforebegin`"

   [Insert](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) fragment into [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [parent](#7224-accessing-related-windows) before [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`afterbegin`"

   [Insert](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) fragment into [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) before its [first child](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`beforeend`"

   [Append](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) fragment to [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this).

   If position is an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for the string "`afterend`"

   [Insert](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) fragment into [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [parent](#7224-accessing-related-windows) before [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [next sibling](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees).

> [!note]
> As with other direct [`Node`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node)-manipulation APIs (and unlike [`innerHTML`](#854-the-innerhtml-property)), [`insertAdjacentHTML()`](#856-the-insertadjacenthtml-method) does not include any special handling for [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) elements. In most cases you will want to use `templateEl.content.insertAdjacentHTML()` instead of directly manipulating the child nodes of a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element.

#### 8.5.7 The [`createContextualFragment()`](#857-the-createcontextualfragment-method) method

> [!warning]
> The [`createContextualFragment()`](#857-the-createcontextualfragment-method) method has a number of outstanding issues in the DOM Parsing and Serialization [issue tracker](https://github.com/w3c/DOM-Parsing/issues), documenting various problems with its specification.

`docFragment = range.createContextualFragment(string)`

Returns a [`DocumentFragment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-interface-documentfragment) created from the markup string string using range's [start node](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-interface-abstractrange) as the context in which fragment is parsed.

> [!warning]
> By default, this method performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous elements and attributes like [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) or [event handler content attributes](#8181-event-handlers).

```webidl
partial interface Range {
  [CEReactions, NewObject] DocumentFragment createContextualFragment((TrustedHTML or DOMString) string);
};
```

[`Range`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#55-interface-range)'s `createContextualFragment(string)` method steps are:
1. Let node be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [start node](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#53-interface-abstractrange).
2. Let (compliantString, compliantOptions) be the result of invoking the [get trusted type compliant input](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-input) algorithm with [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [relevant global object](#81334-relevant), string, a new [`SetHTMLUnsafeOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) dictionary whose [`runScripts`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) member is set to true and whose other members are set to their default values, "`Range
       createContextualFragment`", node's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node)'s [type](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), and false.

   > [!note]
   > A Trusted Types default policy can override the options, for example by setting [`runScripts`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) to false to prevent scripts from executing when inserting the returned fragment.

3. Let element be null.
4. If node [implements](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements) [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element), set element to node.
5. Otherwise, if node [implements](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements) [`Text`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#411-interface-text) or [`Comment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#414-interface-comment), set element to node's [parent element](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element).
6. If element is null or all of the following are true:
   - element's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node) is an HTML document;
   - element's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) is "[`html`](#411-the-html-element)"; and
   - element's [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) is the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces),

   then set element to the result of [creating an element](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) given node's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node), "`body`", and the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces).

7. Return the result of invoking the [fragment parsing algorithm steps](#854-the-innerhtml-property) given element, compliantString, compliantOptions, and [Legacy](#854-the-innerhtml-property).

#### 8.5.8 The [`XMLSerializer`](#858-the-xmlserializer-interface) interface

> [!warning]
> The [`XMLSerializer`](#858-the-xmlserializer-interface) interface has a number of outstanding issues in the DOM Parsing and Serialization [issue tracker](https://github.com/w3c/DOM-Parsing/issues), documenting various problems with its specification. The remainder of DOM Parsing and Serialization will be gradually upstreamed to this specification.

`xmlSerializer = new XMLSerializer()`

Constructs a new [`XMLSerializer`](#858-the-xmlserializer-interface) object.

`string = xmlSerializer.serializeToString(root)`

Returns the result of serializing root to XML.

Throws an ["`InvalidStateError`"](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) [`DOMException`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException) if root cannot be serialized to XML.

> [!note]
> The design of [`XMLSerializer`](#858-the-xmlserializer-interface), as a class that needs to be constructed and then have its [`serializeToString()`](#858-the-xmlserializer-interface) method called, is an unfortunate historical artifact. If we were designing this functionality today it would be a standalone function.

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface XMLSerializer {
  constructor();

  DOMString serializeToString(Node root);
};
```

The `new XMLSerializer()` constructor steps are to do nothing.

The `serializeToString(root)` method steps are:
1. Return the [XML serialization](https://w3c.github.io/DOM-Parsing/#dfn-xml-serialization) of root given false.

### 8.6 HTML sanitization

#### 8.6.1 Introduction

*This section is non-normative.*

Web applications often need to process untrusted HTML strings, such as when rendering user-generated content or using client-side templates. Safely inserting these strings into the DOM requires careful sanitization to prevent DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

HTML sanitization provides a native mechanism for safely parsing and sanitizing HTML strings. By using the user agent's own HTML parser, they ensure the sanitized output accurately reflects how the browser will render the content, preventing script execution and mitigating advanced attacks such as [script gadgets](https://github.com/google/security-research-pocs/tree/master/script-gadgets).

These APIs offer functionality to parse a string containing HTML into a DOM tree, and to filter the resulting tree according to a user-supplied configuration. The methods come in two main flavors: "safe" and "unsafe".

##### 8.6.1.1 Safe and unsafe

The "safe" methods will not generate any markup that executes script. That is, they are intended to be safe from XSS. The "unsafe" methods will parse and filter based on the provided configuration, but do not have the same safety guarantees by default.

#### 8.6.2 The [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) interface

```webidl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Sanitizer {
  constructor(optional (SanitizerConfig or SanitizerPresets) configuration = "default");

  // Query configuration:
  SanitizerConfig get();

  // Modify a Sanitizer's lists and fields:
  boolean allowElement(SanitizerElementWithAttributes element);
  boolean removeElement(SanitizerElement element);
  boolean replaceElementWithChildren(SanitizerElement element);
  boolean allowProcessingInstruction(SanitizerPI pi);
  boolean removeProcessingInstruction(SanitizerPI pi);
  boolean allowAttribute(SanitizerAttribute attribute);
  boolean removeAttribute(SanitizerAttribute attribute);
  boolean setComments(boolean allow);
  boolean setDataAttributes(boolean allow);
  boolean setJavascriptURLs(boolean allow);

  // Remove markup that executes script.
  boolean removeUnsafe();
};
```

`config = sanitizer.get()`

Returns a copy of the sanitizer's [configuration](#863-sanitizer-configuration).

`sanitizer.allowElement(element)`

Ensures that the sanitizer configuration allows the specified element.

`sanitizer.removeElement(element)`

Ensures that the sanitizer configuration blocks the specified element.

`sanitizer.replaceElementWithChildren(element)`

Configures the sanitizer to remove the specified element but keep its child nodes.

`sanitizer.allowAttribute(attribute)`

Configures the sanitizer to allow the specified attribute globally.

`sanitizer.removeAttribute(attribute)`

Configures the sanitizer to block the specified attribute globally.

`sanitizer.allowProcessingInstruction(pi)`

Configures the sanitizer to allow the specified processing instruction.

`sanitizer.removeProcessingInstruction(pi)`

Configures the sanitizer to block the specified processing instruction.

`sanitizer.setComments(allow)`

Sets whether the sanitizer preserves comments.

`sanitizer.setDataAttributes(allow)`

Sets whether the sanitizer preserves custom data attributes (e.g., [`data-*`](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes)).

`sanitizer.setJavascriptURLs(allow)`

Sets whether the sanitizer preserves attributes containing [`javascript:`](#74232-the-javascript-url-special-case) URLs.

`sanitizer.removeUnsafe()`

Modifies the configuration to automatically remove elements and attributes that are considered unsafe.

A [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) object has an associated configuration, which is a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration).

The `new
  Sanitizer(configuration)` constructor steps are:
1. If configuration is a [SanitizerPresets](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) [string](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings):
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is "[default](#8631-configuration-invariants)".
   2. Set configuration to the [built-in safe default configuration](#865-sanitization-constants).
2. [Configure](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) given configuration and true.

To configure a [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) sanitizer, given a dictionary configuration and a boolean permissiveDefaults:
1. Let freshConfiguration be a [clone](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) of configuration.
2. [Canonicalize the configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) freshConfiguration with permissiveDefaults.
3. If freshConfiguration is not [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms), then throw a [`TypeError`](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror).
4. Set sanitizer's [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) to freshConfiguration.

To canonicalize the configuration [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) configuration with a boolean permissiveDefaults:
1. If neither configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] nor configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to an empty list.
2. If neither configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] nor configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to an empty list.
3. If neither configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] nor configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If permissiveDefaults is true, then set configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to an empty list.
   2. Otherwise, set configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to an empty list.
4. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. Let newElements be « ».
   2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [canonicalizing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) element to newElements.
   3. Set configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to newElements.
5. If configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
6. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
7. If configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
8. If configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
9. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
10. If configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
11. If configuration\["[`comments`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set it to permissiveDefaults.
12. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set it to permissiveDefaults.
13. If configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set it to permissiveDefaults.

To canonicalize a sanitizer list list:
1. Let newList be « ».
2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) item in list, [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) item to newList.
3. Return newList.

To canonicalize a processing instruction list list:
1. Let newList be « ».
2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) item in list, [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) item to newList.
3. Return newList.

To canonicalize a processing instruction given a [`SanitizerPI`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) pi:
1. If pi is a [`DOMString`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString), then return «\[ "[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)" → pi \]».
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): pi is a dictionary and pi\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
3. Return «\[ "[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)" → pi\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] \]».

To canonicalize a sanitizer name given a [`DOMString`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString) or dictionary name, and a default namespace defaultNamespace (default null):
1. If name is a [`DOMString`](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString), then return «\[ "name" → name, "namespace" → defaultNamespace \]».
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): name is a dictionary and both name\["name"\] and name\["namespace"\] [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
3. If name\["namespace"\] is the empty string, then set it to null.
4. Return «\[ "name" → name\["name"\], "namespace" → name\["namespace"\] \]».

To canonicalize a sanitizer element given a [`SanitizerElement`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) element:
1. Return the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element with the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces) as the default namespace.

To canonicalize a sanitizer element list list:
1. Let newList be « ».
2. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) item in list, [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) item to newList.
3. Return newList.

To find the canonicalized intersection of [lists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) A and B:
1. Let setA be « ».
2. Let setB be « ».
3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) entry of A, [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) entry to setA.
4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) entry of B, [append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) entry to setB.
5. Return the [intersection](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of setA and setB.

The `get()` method steps are:

> [!note]
> Outside of the [`get()`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) method, the order of the [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface)'s elements and attributes is unobservable. By explicitly sorting the result of this method, we give implementations the opportunity to optimize by, for example, using unordered sets internally.
1. Let config be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): config is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
      1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
      2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
   2. Set config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
4. Otherwise:
   1. Set config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
5. If config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
6. If config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with piA\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] being [code unit less than](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) piB\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
7. Otherwise:
   1. Set config\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], with piA\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] being [code unit less than](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) piB\["[`target`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
8. If config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] given [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
9. Otherwise:
   1. Set config\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [sorting](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) config\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] given [compare sanitizer items](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
10. Return config.

The `allowElement(element)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. Set element to the result of [canonicalizing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) element.
4. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. Let modified be the result of [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   2. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. Set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [creating a set](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. Set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the [difference](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         3. If configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is true, then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) all items item from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] where item is a [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes).
      2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. Set element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [creating a set](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) from element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. Set element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the [intersection](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) of element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Otherwise:
      1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. Set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [creating a set](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. Set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the [difference](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « ».
         3. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         4. Set element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the [difference](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
      2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. Set element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [creating a set](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) from element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. Set element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the [difference](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) of element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   4. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element:
      1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element to configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
      2. Return true.
   5. Let currentElement be the item in configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] whose [`name`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) member is element's [`name`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) member and whose [`namespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) member is element's [`namespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) member.
   6. If element is equal to currentElement, then return modified.
   7. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   8. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element to configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   9. Return true.
5. Otherwise:
   1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) or element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » is not empty, then return false.
   2. Let modified be the result of [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. If configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element, then return modified.
   4. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   5. Return true.

The `removeElement(element)` method steps are to return the result of [removing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) element from [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).

The `replaceElementWithChildren(element)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. Set element to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element.
4. If the [built-in non-replaceable elements list](#865-sanitization-constants) [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element, then return false.
5. Let modified be the result of [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
6. If [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is true, then set modified to true.
7. If configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element:
   1. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element to configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   2. Return true.
8. Return modified.

The `allowAttribute(attribute)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. Set attribute to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) attribute.
4. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is true and attribute is a [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes), then return false.
   2. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then return false.
   3. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element in configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
         1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   4. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute to configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   5. Return true.
5. Otherwise:
   1. If configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then return false.
   2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Return true.

The `removeAttribute(attribute)` method steps are to return the result of [removing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) attribute from [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).

The `setComments(allow)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. If configuration\["[`comments`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is allow, then return false.
4. Set configuration\["[`comments`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to allow.
5. Return true.

The `setDataAttributes(allow)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [exist](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then return false.
4. If configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and is equal to allow, then return false.
5. If allow is true:
   1. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
         1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) all items item from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] where item is a [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes).
   2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) all items item from configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] where item is a [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes).
6. Set configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to allow.
7. Return true.

The `setJavascriptURLs(allow)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. If configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is allow, then return false.
4. Set configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to allow.
5. Return true.

The `allowProcessingInstruction(pi)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. Set pi to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) pi.
4. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi, then return false.
   2. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi to configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Return true.
5. Otherwise:
   1. If configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi:
      1. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi from configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
      2. Return true.
   2. Return false.

The `removeProcessingInstruction(pi)` method steps are:
1. Let configuration be [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. Set pi to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) pi.
4. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi:
      1. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi from configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
      2. Return true.
   2. Return false.
5. Otherwise:
   1. If configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi, then return false.
   2. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) pi to configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Return true.

The `removeUnsafe()` method steps are to return the result of [removing unsafe](#864-sanitization-algorithms) from [this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).

#### 8.6.3 Sanitizer configuration

```webidl
dictionary SanitizerElementNamespace {
  required DOMString name;
  DOMString? _namespace = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml";
};

// Used by "elements"
dictionary SanitizerElementNamespaceWithAttributes : SanitizerElementNamespace {
  sequence<SanitizerAttribute> attributes;
  sequence<SanitizerAttribute> removeAttributes;
};

dictionary SanitizerAttributeNamespace {
  required DOMString name;
  DOMString? _namespace = null;
};

dictionary SanitizerProcessingInstruction {
  required DOMString target;
};

typedef (DOMString or SanitizerElementNamespace) SanitizerElement;
typedef (DOMString or SanitizerElementNamespaceWithAttributes) SanitizerElementWithAttributes;
typedef (DOMString or SanitizerProcessingInstruction) SanitizerPI;
typedef (DOMString or SanitizerAttributeNamespace) SanitizerAttribute;

dictionary SanitizerConfig {
  sequence<SanitizerElementWithAttributes> elements;
  sequence<SanitizerElement> removeElements;
  sequence<SanitizerElement> replaceWithChildrenElements;

  sequence<SanitizerPI> processingInstructions;
  sequence<SanitizerPI> removeProcessingInstructions;

  sequence<SanitizerAttribute> attributes;
  sequence<SanitizerAttribute> removeAttributes;

  boolean comments;
  boolean dataAttributes;
  boolean javascriptURLs;
};
```

> [!note]
> [`SanitizerElementNamespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), [`SanitizerAttributeNamespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), [`SanitizerElementNamespaceWithAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), and [`SanitizerProcessingInstruction`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) dictionaries are [equal](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#311-identity-and-equality) when they have the same members and those are equal, per the [equality](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#311-identity-and-equality) of [maps](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).

##### 8.6.3.1 Configuration invariants

*This section is non-normative.*

Configurations can and ought to be modified by developers to suit their purposes. Options are to write a new [`SanitizerConfig`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) dictionary from scratch, to modify an existing [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface)'s configuration by using the modifier methods, or to [`get()`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) an existing [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface)'s [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) as a dictionary and modify the dictionary and then create a new [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) with it.

An empty configuration allows everything (when called with the "unsafe" methods like [`setHTMLUnsafe()`](#852-html-parsing-methods)). A configuration "default" contains a [built-in safe default configuration](#865-sanitization-constants). Note that "safe" and "unsafe" sanitizer methods have different defaults.

Not all configuration dictionaries are valid. A valid configuration avoids redundancy (like specifying the same element to be allowed twice) and contradictions (like specifying an element to be both removed and allowed.)

Several conditions need to hold for a configuration to be valid:
- Mixing global allow- and remove-lists:
  - [`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) or [`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) can exist, but not both. If both are missing, this is equivalent to [`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) being an empty list.
  - [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) or [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) can exist, but not both. If both are missing, this is equivalent to [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) being an empty list.
  - [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) is conceptually an extension of the [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow-list. The [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) member is only allowed when an [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) list is used.
- Duplicate entries between different global lists:
  - There are no duplicate entries (i.e., no same elements) between [`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), [`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), or [`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration).
  - There are no duplicate entries (i.e., no same attributes) between [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) or [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration).
- Mixing local allow- and remove-lists on the same element:
  - When an [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) list exists, both, either or none of the [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) and [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) lists are allowed on the same element.
  - When a [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) list exists, either or none of the [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) and [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) lists are allowed on the same element, but not both.
- Duplicate entries on the same element:
  - There are no duplicate entries between [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) and [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) on the same element.
- No element from the [built-in non-replaceable elements list](#865-sanitization-constants) appears in [`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration), since replacing these elements with their children could lead to re-parsing issues or invalid node trees.

The [`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) element allow-list can also specify allowing or removing attributes for a given element. This is meant to mirror this standard's structure, which knows both [global attributes](#326-global-attributes) as well as local attributes that apply to a specific element. Global and local attributes can be mixed, but note that ambiguous configurations where a particular attribute would be allowed by one list and forbidden by another, are generally invalid.

|  | global [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | global [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | An attribute is allowed if it matches either list. No duplicates are allowed. | An attribute is only allowed if it's in the local allow list. No duplicate entries between global remove and local allow lists are allowed. Note that the global remove list has no function for this particular element, but can apply to other elements that do not have a local allow list. |
| local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | An attribute is allowed if it's in the global allow-list, but not in the local remove-list. Local remove has to be a subset of the global allow lists. | An attribute is allowed if it is in neither list. No duplicate entries between global remove and local remove lists are allowed. |

Please note the asymmetry where mostly no duplicates between global and per-element lists are permitted, but in the case of a global allow-list and a per-element remove-list the latter has to be a subset of the former. An excerpt of the table above, only focusing on duplicates, is as follows:

|  | global [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | global [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | No duplicates are allowed. | No duplicates are allowed. |
| local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | Local remove has to be a subset of the global allow lists. | No duplicates are allowed. |

The [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) setting allows [custom data attributes](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes). The rules above easily extends to [custom data attributes](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) if one considers [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) to be an allow-list:

|  | global [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) and [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) set |
| --- | --- |
| local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | All [custom data attributes](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) are allowed. No [custom data attributes](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) can be listed in any allow-list, as that would mean a duplicate entry. |
| local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) | A [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) is allowed, unless it's listed in the local remove-list. No [custom data attribute](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) can be listed in the global allow-list, as that would mean a duplicate entry. |

Putting these rules in words:
- Duplicates and interactions between global and local lists:
  - If a global [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow list exists, then all element's local lists:
    - If a local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow list exists, there can be no duplicate entries between these lists.
    - If a local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) remove list exists, then all its entries also need to be listed in the global [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow list.
    - If [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) is true, then no [custom data attributes](#3266-embedding-custom-non-visible-data-with-the-data--attributes) can be listed in any of the allow-lists.
  - If a global [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) remove list exists:
    - If a local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow list exists, there can be no duplicate entries between these lists.
    - If a local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) remove list exists, there can be no duplicate entries between these lists.
    - Not both a local [`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) allow list and local [`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) remove list exists.
    - [`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration) has to be false.

#### 8.6.4 Sanitization algorithms

To get a sanitizer instance from options given a [`SetHTMLOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis), [`SetHTMLUnsafeOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis), or [`ParseHTMLUnsafeOptions`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) dictionary, or a [`TrustedHTMLParserOptions`](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trusted-html-parser-options) object options, and a boolean safe:
1. Let sanitizerInput be null.
2. If options is a [`TrustedHTMLParserOptions`](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trusted-html-parser-options):
   1. If options's [sanitizer configuration](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtmlparseroptions-sanitizer-configuration) is null:
      1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): safe is false.
      2. Return null.
   2. Set sanitizerInput to options's [sanitizer configuration](https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtmlparseroptions-sanitizer-configuration).
3. Otherwise, if options\["[`sanitizer`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set sanitizerInput to options\["[`sanitizer`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis)"\].
4. Otherwise, if safe is false, then return null.
5. Otherwise, set sanitizerInput to "[`default`](#8631-configuration-invariants)".
6. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): sanitizerInput is either a [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) instance, a [SanitizerPresets](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) member, or a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) dictionary.
7. If sanitizerInput is a string:
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): sanitizerInput is "[`default`](#8631-configuration-invariants)".
   2. Set sanitizerInput to the [built-in safe default configuration](#865-sanitization-constants).
8. If sanitizerInput is a [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface), then set sanitizerInput to sanitizerInput's [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
9. If sanitizerInput is a dictionary:
   1. Let sanitizer be a new [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) object.
   2. Let permissiveDefaults be true if safe is false; false otherwise.
   3. [Configure](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) sanitizer given sanitizerInput and permissiveDefaults.
   4. Set sanitizerInput to sanitizer.
10. Return sanitizerInput.

To sanitize a [`Node`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node) node with a [`Sanitizer`](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) sanitizer and a boolean safe:
1. Let configuration be sanitizer's [configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface).
2. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
3. If safe is true, then [remove unsafe](#864-sanitization-algorithms) from configuration.
4. Run the [inner sanitize steps](#864-sanitization-algorithms) given node and configuration.

To perform the inner sanitize steps given a [`Node`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node) node and a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) configuration:
1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) child of node's [children](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees):
   1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): child is a [`Text`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#411-interface-text), [`Comment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#414-interface-comment), [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element), [`ProcessingInstruction`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#413-interface-processinginstruction), or [`DocumentType`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-interface-documenttype) node.
   2. If child is a [`DocumentType`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-interface-documenttype) or [`Text`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#411-interface-text) node, then [continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
   3. If child is a [`Comment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#414-interface-comment) node:
      1. If configuration\["[`comments`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is not true, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child.
      2. [Continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
   4. If child is a [`ProcessingInstruction`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#413-interface-processinginstruction) node:
      1. Let piTarget be child's [target](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#413-interface-processinginstruction).
      2. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. If configuration\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) piTarget, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child.
      3. Otherwise:
         1. If configuration\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) piTarget, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child.
   5. Otherwise:
      1. Let elementName be a [SanitizerElementNamespace](#863-sanitizer-configuration) with child's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) and [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element).
      2. If configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) elementName:
         1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): node is not a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).
         2. Run the [inner sanitize steps](#864-sanitization-algorithms) given child and configuration.
         3. Let fragment be the result of [creating a document fragment](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-interface-documentfragment) given node's [node document](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#44-interface-node).
         4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) innerChild of child's [children](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees), [append](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) innerChild to fragment.
         5. [Replace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child with fragment within node. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions) that this did not throw.
         6. [Continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
      3. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
         1. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) elementName, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child and [continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
      4. Otherwise:
         1. If configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) elementName, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) child and [continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
      5. If elementName\["[`name`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is "[`template`](#4123-the-template-element)" and elementName\["[`namespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), then run the [inner sanitize steps](#864-sanitization-algorithms) given child's [template contents](#4123-the-template-element) and configuration.
      6. If child is a [shadow host](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element), then run the [inner sanitize steps](#864-sanitization-algorithms) given child's [shadow root](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#48-interface-shadowroot) and configuration.
      7. Let elementWithLocalAttributes be «\[ \]».
      8. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) elementName, then set elementWithLocalAttributes to configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]\[elementName\].
      9. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute in child's [attribute list](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element):
         1. Let attrName be a [SanitizerAttributeNamespace](#863-sanitizer-configuration) with attribute's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) and [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr).
         2. If elementWithLocalAttributes\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and elementWithLocalAttributes\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attrName, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
         3. Otherwise, if configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
            1. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attrName and elementWithLocalAttributes\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attrName, and if "`data-`" is not a [code unit prefix](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) of attribute's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) or attribute's [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) is not null or configuration\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is not true, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
         4. Otherwise:
            1. If elementWithLocalAttributes\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and elementWithLocalAttributes\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] does not [contain](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attrName, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
            2. Otherwise, if configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attrName, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
         5. If configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is not true:
            1. If the pair (elementName, attrName) matches an entry in the [built-in navigating URL attributes list](#865-sanitization-constants), and if attribute [contains a `javascript:` URL](#864-sanitization-algorithms), then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
            2. If child's [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) is the [MathML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), attribute's [local name](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) is "`href`", attribute's [namespace](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) is null or the [XLink namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), and attribute [contains a `javascript:` URL](#864-sanitization-algorithms), then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
            3. If the [built-in animating URL attributes list](#865-sanitization-constants) [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) the pair (elementName, attrName), and attribute's [value](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr) is "`href`" or "`xlink:href`", then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element) attribute.
      10. Run the [inner sanitize steps](#864-sanitization-algorithms) given child and configuration.

To determine whether an attribute attribute contains a `javascript:` URL:
1. Let url be the result of running the [basic URL parser](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser) on attribute's [value](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#492-interface-attr).
2. If url is failure, then return false.
3. Return true if url's [scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) is "`javascript`", and false otherwise.

To remove an element element from a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) configuration:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
2. Set element to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element.
3. Let modified be the result of [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
4. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element:
      1. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element from configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
      2. Return true.
   2. Return modified.
5. Otherwise:
   1. If configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element, then return modified.
   2. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) element to configuration\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Return true.

To remove an attribute attribute from a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) configuration:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
2. Set attribute to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) attribute.
3. If configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. Let modified be the result of [removing](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from configuration\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   2. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
         1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute:
            1. Set modified to true.
            2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute:
            1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): modified is true.
            2. [Remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. Return modified.
4. Otherwise:
   1. If configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then return false.
   2. If configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
      1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element in configuration\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
         1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
         2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [with default](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) « » [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute, then [remove](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute from element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   3. [Append](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#513-sets) attribute to configuration\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   4. Return true.

To remove unsafe from a [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) configuration:
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): configuration is [valid](#864-sanitization-algorithms).
2. Let result be false.
3. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element in [built-in safe baseline configuration](#865-sanitization-constants)\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
   1. If [removing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) element from configuration is true, then set result to true.
4. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute in [built-in safe baseline configuration](#865-sanitization-constants)\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
   1. If [removing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) attribute from configuration is true, then set result to true.
5. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) attribute that is an [event handler content attribute](#8181-event-handlers):
   1. If [removing](#864-sanitization-algorithms) attribute from configuration is true, then set result to true.
6. If configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is true:
   1. Set result to true.
   2. Set configuration\["[`javascriptURLs`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to false.
7. Return result.

To compare sanitizer items itemA and itemB:
1. Let namespaceA be itemA\["[`namespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
2. Let namespaceB be itemB\["[`namespace`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
3. If namespaceA is null:
   1. If namespaceB is not null, then return true.
4. Otherwise:
   1. If namespaceB is null, then return false.
   2. If namespaceA is [code unit less than](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) namespaceB, then return true.
   3. If namespaceA is not namespaceB, then return false.
5. If itemA\["[`name`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is [code unit less than](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) itemB\["[`name`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\], then return true.
6. Return false.

To canonicalize a [SanitizerElementWithAttributes](#863-sanitizer-configuration) element:
1. Let result be the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element.
2. If element is a dictionary:
   1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set result\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
   2. If element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set result\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to the result of [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) element\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\].
3. If neither result\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] nor result\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then set result\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] to an empty list.
4. Return result.

To determine whether a canonical [SanitizerConfig](#863-sanitizer-configuration) config is valid:

> [!note]
> It's expected that the configuration being passed in has previously been run through the [canonicalize the configuration](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) steps. We will simply assert conditions that that algorithm is guaranteed to hold.
1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) or config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
2. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then return false.
3. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): Either config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) or config\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
4. If config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and config\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then return false.
5. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): Either config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) or config\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
6. If config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and config\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps), then return false.
7. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): All [SanitizerElementNamespaceWithAttributes](#863-sanitizer-configuration), [SanitizerElementNamespace](#863-sanitizer-configuration), [SanitizerProcessingInstruction](#863-sanitizer-configuration), and [SanitizerAttributeNamespace](#863-sanitizer-configuration) items in config are canonical, meaning they have been run through [canonicalizing](#862-the-sanitizer-interface), as appropriate.
8. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
   1. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
9. Otherwise:
   1. If config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
10. If config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
11. If config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
    1. If config\["[`processingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
12. Otherwise:
    1. If config\["[`removeProcessingInstructions`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
13. If config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
    1. If config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
14. Otherwise:
    1. If config\["[`removeAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
15. If config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
    1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
       1. If the [built-in non-replaceable elements list](#865-sanitization-constants) [contains](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element, then return false.
    2. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
       1. If the [intersection](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) of config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is not empty, then return false.
    3. Otherwise:
       1. If the [intersection](#862-the-sanitizer-interface) of config\["[`removeElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] and config\["[`replaceWithChildrenElements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] is not empty, then return false.
16. If config\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
    1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): config\["[`dataAttributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps).
    2. If config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps):
       1. [For each](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists) element of config\["[`elements`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\]:
          1. If element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [exists](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#52-maps) and element\["[`attributes`](#863-sanitizer-configuration)"\] [has duplicates](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#51-lists), then return false.
