Formatting

The following HTML elements are those that end up in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements): [`a`](#451-the-a-element), [`b`](#4521-the-b-element), [`big`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`code`](#4515-the-code-element), [`em`](#452-the-em-element), [`font`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`i`](#4520-the-i-element), [`nobr`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`s`](#455-the-s-element), [`small`](#454-the-small-element), [`strike`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`strong`](#453-the-strong-element), [`tt`](#162-non-conforming-features), and [`u`](#4522-the-u-element).

Ordinary

All other elements found while parsing an HTML document.

> [!note]
> Typically, the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) elements have the start and end tag tokens handled specifically, while [ordinary](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) elements' tokens fall into "any other start tag" and "any other end tag" clauses, and some parts of the tree builder check if a particular element in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category. However, some elements (e.g., the [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element) have their start or end tag tokens handled specifically, but are still not in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category, so that they get the [ordinary](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) handling elsewhere.

The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is said to have an element target node in a specific scope consisting of a list of element types list when the following algorithm terminates in a match state:
1. Initialize node to be the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (the bottommost node of the stack).
2. If node is target node, terminate in a match state.
3. Otherwise, if node is one of the element types in list, terminate in a failure state.
4. Otherwise, set node to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and return to step 2. (This will never fail, since the loop will always terminate in the previous step if the top of the stack — an [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element — is reached.)

The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is said to have a particular element in scope when it [has that element in the specific scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) consisting of the following element types:
- [`applet`](#162-non-conforming-features)
- [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element)
- [`html`](#411-the-html-element)
- [`table`](#491-the-table-element)
- [`td`](#499-the-td-element)
- [`th`](#4910-the-th-element)
- [`marquee`](#1631-the-marquee-element)
- [`object`](#487-the-object-element)
- [`select`](#4107-the-select-element)
- [`template`](#4123-the-template-element)
- [MathML `mi`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#the-mi-element)
- [MathML `mo`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#operator-fence-separator-or-accent-mo)
- [MathML `mn`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#number-mn)
- [MathML `ms`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#string-literal-ms)
- [MathML `mtext`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#text-mtext)
- [MathML `annotation-xml`](https://w3c.github.io/mathml-core/#dfn-annotation-xml)
- [SVG `foreignObject`](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/embedded.html#elementdef-foreignObject)
- [SVG `desc`](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-desc)
- [SVG `title`](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/struct.html#elementdef-title)

The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is said to have a particular element in list item scope when it [has that element in the specific scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) consisting of the following element types:
- All the element types listed above for the *[has an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements)* algorithm.
- [`ol`](#445-the-ol-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)
- [`ul`](#446-the-ul-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)

The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is said to have a particular element in button scope when it [has that element in the specific scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) consisting of the following element types:
- All the element types listed above for the *[has an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements)* algorithm.
- [`button`](#4106-the-button-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)

The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is said to have a particular element in table scope when it [has that element in the specific scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) consisting of the following element types:
- [`html`](#411-the-html-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)
- [`table`](#491-the-table-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)
- [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces)

Nothing happens if at any time any of the elements in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) are moved to a new location in, or removed from, the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) tree. In particular, the stack is not changed in this situation. This can cause, amongst other strange effects, content to be appended to nodes that are no longer in the DOM.

> [!note]
> In some cases (namely, when [closing misnested formatting elements](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)), the stack is manipulated in a random-access fashion.

##### 13.2.4.3 The list of active formatting elements

Initially, the list of active formatting elements is empty. It is used to handle mis-nested [formatting element tags](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

The list contains elements in the [formatting](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category, and [markers](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements). The markers are inserted when entering [`applet`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`object`](#487-the-object-element), [`marquee`](#1631-the-marquee-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), [`td`](#499-the-td-element), [`th`](#4910-the-th-element), and [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) elements, and are used to prevent formatting from "leaking" *into* [`applet`](#162-non-conforming-features), [`object`](#487-the-object-element), [`marquee`](#1631-the-marquee-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), [`td`](#499-the-td-element), [`th`](#4910-the-th-element), and [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) elements.

In addition, each element in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) is associated with the token for which it was created, so that further elements can be created for that token if necessary.

When the steps below require the UA to push onto the list of active formatting elements an element element, the UA must perform the following steps:
1. If there are already three elements in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) after the last [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any, or anywhere in the list if there are no [markers](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), that have the same tag name, namespace, and attributes as element, then remove the earliest such element from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements). For these purposes, the attributes must be compared as they were when the elements were created by the parser; two elements have the same attributes if all their parsed attributes can be paired such that the two attributes in each pair have identical names, namespaces, and values (the order of the attributes does not matter).

   > [!note]
   > This is the Noah's Ark clause. But with three per family instead of two.

2. Add element to the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).

When the steps below require the UA to reconstruct the active formatting elements, the UA must perform the following steps:
1. If there are no entries in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then there is nothing to reconstruct; stop this algorithm.
2. If the last (most recently added) entry in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) is a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), or if it is an element that is in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then there is nothing to reconstruct; stop this algorithm.
3. Let entry be the last (most recently added) element in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
4. *Rewind*: If there are no entries before entry in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then jump to the step labeled *create*.
5. Let entry be the entry one earlier than entry in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
6. If entry is neither a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) nor an element that is also in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), go to the step labeled *rewind*.
7. *Advance*: Let entry be the element one later than entry in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
8. *Create*: [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token for which the element entry was created, to obtain new element.
9. Replace the entry for entry in the list with an entry for new element.
10. If the entry for new element in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) is not the last entry in the list, return to the step labeled *advance*.

This has the effect of reopening all the formatting elements that were opened in the current body, cell, or caption (whichever is youngest) that haven't been explicitly closed.

> [!note]
> The way this specification is written, the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) always consists of elements in chronological order with the least recently added element first and the most recently added element last (except for while steps 7 to 10 of the above algorithm are being executed, of course).

When the steps below require the UA to clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker, the UA must perform the following steps:
1. Let entry be the last (most recently added) entry in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
2. Remove entry from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
3. If entry was a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then stop the algorithm at this point. The list has been cleared up to the last [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
4. Go to step 1.

##### 13.2.4.4 The element pointers

Initially, the `head` element pointer and the `form` element pointer are both null.

Once a [`head`](#421-the-head-element) element has been parsed (whether implicitly or explicitly) the [`head` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) gets set to point to this node.

The [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) points to the last [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element that was opened and whose end tag has not yet been seen. It is used to make form controls associate with forms in the face of dramatically bad markup, for historical reasons. It is ignored inside [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) elements.

An [HTML parser](#132-parsing-html-documents) is parsing template contents if there is a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), or the parser's [fragment context element](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element.

##### 13.2.4.5 Other parsing state flags

The root insertion target, which is null or a [`DocumentFragment`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-interface-documentfragment) (initially null).

An [`Element`](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#49-interface-element)-or-null fragment context element, initially null.

A boolean allow declarative shadow roots (initially false).

The scripting mode, which is a [parser scripting mode](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags). It is initially set to [Normal](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) if [scripting was enabled](#8134-enabling-and-disabling-scripting) for the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) with which the parser is associated when the parser was created, and [Disabled](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) otherwise.

A parser scripting mode is one of the following:

Normal

Scripts are processed when inserted, respecting [`async`](#4121-the-script-element) and [`defer`](#4121-the-script-element) attributes and blocking the parser when encountering a [classic script](#8141-scripts).

Disabled

Scripts are disabled, and the [`noscript`](#4122-the-noscript-element) element can represent fallback content.

Inert

Scripts are enabled, however they are marked as [already started](#41211-processing-model), essentially preventing them from executing. This is the default mode of the [HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#134-parsing-html-fragments).

Fragment

Scripts are executed as soon as they are inserted into the document as part of the [HTML fragment parsing algorithm](#134-parsing-html-fragments), ignoring [`async`](#4121-the-script-element) and [`defer`](#4121-the-script-element) attributes. This mode is used by [`createContextualFragment()`](#857-the-createcontextualfragment-method), by [`setHTMLUnsafe()`](#852-html-parsing-methods) when [`runScripts`](#85-dom-parsing-and-serialization-apis) is true, and by [`innerHTML`](#854-the-innerhtml-property), [`outerHTML`](#855-the-outerhtml-property), and [`insertAdjacentHTML()`](#856-the-insertadjacenthtml-method) when a Trusted Types default policy enables script execution.

The frameset-ok flag is set to "ok" when the parser is created. It is set to "not ok" after certain tokens are seen, and back to "ok" when the [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element is inserted implicitly.

#### 13.2.5 Tokenization

Implementations must act as if they used the following state machine to tokenize HTML. The state machine must start in the [data state](#13251-data-state). Most states consume a single character, which may have various side-effects, and either switches the state machine to a new state to [reconsume](#1325-tokenization) the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream), or switches it to a new state to consume the [next character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream), or stays in the same state to consume the next character. Some states have more complicated behavior and can consume several characters before switching to another state. In some cases, the tokenizer state is also changed by the tree construction stage.

When a state says to reconsume a matched character in a specified state, that means to switch to that state, but when it attempts to consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream), provide it with the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) instead.

The exact behavior of certain states depends on the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) and the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Certain states also use a temporary buffer to track progress, and the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state) uses a return state to return to the state it was invoked from.

The output of the tokenization step is a series of zero or more of the following tokens: DOCTYPE, start tag, end tag, comment, character, end-of-file. DOCTYPE tokens have a name, a public identifier, a system identifier, and a *force-quirks flag*. When a DOCTYPE token is created, its name, public identifier, and system identifier must be marked as missing (which is a distinct state from the empty string), and the *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* must be set to *off* (its other state is *on*). Start and end tag tokens have a tag name, a self-closing flag, and a list of attributes, each of which has a name and a value. When a start or end tag token is created, its *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* must be unset (its other state is that it be set), and its attributes list must be empty. Comment and character tokens have data.

When a token is emitted, it must immediately be handled by the [tree construction](#1326-tree-construction) stage. The tree construction stage can affect the state of the tokenization stage, and can insert additional characters into the stream. (For example, the [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) element can result in scripts executing and using the [dynamic markup insertion](#84-dynamic-markup-insertion) APIs to insert characters into the stream being tokenized.)

> [!note]
> Creating a token and emitting it are distinct actions. It is possible for a token to be created but implicitly abandoned (never emitted), e.g. if the file ends unexpectedly while processing the characters that are being parsed into a start tag token.

When a start tag token is emitted with its *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* set, if the flag is not acknowledged when it is processed by the tree construction stage, that is a [non-void-html-element-start-tag-with-trailing-solidus](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

When an end tag token is emitted with attributes, that is an [end-tag-with-attributes](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

When an end tag token is emitted with its *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* set, that is an [end-tag-with-trailing-solidus](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

An appropriate end tag token is an end tag token whose tag name matches the tag name of the last start tag to have been emitted from this tokenizer, if any. If no start tag has been emitted from this tokenizer, then no end tag token is appropriate.

A [character reference](#1314-character-references) is said to be consumed as part of an attribute if the [return state](#1325-tokenization) is either [attribute value (double-quoted) state](#132536-attribute-value-double-quoted-state), [attribute value (single-quoted) state](#132537-attribute-value-single-quoted-state), or [attribute value (unquoted) state](#132538-attribute-value-unquoted-state).

When a state says to flush code points consumed as a character reference, it means that for each [code point](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points) in the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization) (in the order they were added to the buffer), the user agent must append the code point from the buffer to the current attribute's value if the character reference was [consumed as part of an attribute](#1325-tokenization), or emit the code point as a character token otherwise.

To convert the temporary buffer to a comment, create a comment token whose data is the concatenation of "`?`" and the [code points](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points) in the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization), in the order they were added to the buffer.

> [!note]
> This is used when a processing instruction is found to have an invalid target and is instead treated as a bogus comment.

Before each step of the tokenizer, the user agent must first check the [parser pause flag](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model). If it is true, then the tokenizer must abort the processing of any nested invocations of the tokenizer, yielding control back to the caller.

The tokenizer state machine consists of the states defined in the following subsections.

##### 13.2.5.1 Data state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0026 AMPERSAND (&)

Set the [return state](#1325-tokenization) to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Switch to the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state).

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Switch to the [tag open state](#13256-tag-open-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

EOF

Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

##### 13.2.5.2 RCDATA state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0026 AMPERSAND (&)

Set the [return state](#1325-tokenization) to the [RCDATA state](#13252-rcdata-state). Switch to the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state).

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Switch to the [RCDATA less-than sign state](#13259-rcdata-less-than-sign-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token.

EOF

Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

##### 13.2.5.3 RAWTEXT state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Switch to the [RAWTEXT less-than sign state](#132512-rawtext-less-than-sign-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token.

EOF

Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

##### 13.2.5.4 Script data state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Switch to the [script data less-than sign state](#132515-script-data-less-than-sign-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token.

EOF

Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

##### 13.2.5.5 PLAINTEXT state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character token.

EOF

Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Emit the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) as a character token.

##### 13.2.5.6 Tag open state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0021 EXCLAMATION MARK (!)

Switch to the [markup declaration open state](#132542-markup-declaration-open-state).

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

Switch to the [end tag open state](#13257-end-tag-open-state).

[ASCII alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Create a new start tag token, set its tag name to the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [tag name state](#13258-tag-name-state).

U+003F QUESTION MARK (?)

Set the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization) to the empty string. Switch to the [processing instruction open state](#132572-processing-instruction-open-state).

EOF

This is an [eof-before-tag-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token and an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is an [invalid-first-character-of-tag-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [data state](#13251-data-state).

##### 13.2.5.7 End tag open state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

[ASCII alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Create a new end tag token, set its tag name to the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [tag name state](#13258-tag-name-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is a [missing-end-tag-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state).

EOF

This is an [eof-before-tag-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token, a U+002F SOLIDUS character token and an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is an [invalid-first-character-of-tag-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a comment token whose data is the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [bogus comment state](#132541-bogus-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.8 Tag name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state).

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

Switch to the [self-closing start tag state](#132540-self-closing-start-tag-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point) to the current tag token's tag name.

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current tag token's tag name.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current tag token's tag name.

##### 13.2.5.9 RCDATA less-than sign state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

Set the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization) to the empty string. Switch to the [RCDATA end tag open state](#132510-rcdata-end-tag-open-state).

Anything else

Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [RCDATA state](#13252-rcdata-state).

##### 13.2.5.10 RCDATA end tag open state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

[ASCII alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Create a new end tag token, set its tag name to the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [RCDATA end tag name state](#132511-rcdata-end-tag-name-state).

Anything else

Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token and a U+002F SOLIDUS character token. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [RCDATA state](#13252-rcdata-state).

##### 13.2.5.11 RCDATA end tag name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

If the current end tag token is an [appropriate end tag token](#1325-tokenization), then switch to the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state). Otherwise, treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

If the current end tag token is an [appropriate end tag token](#1325-tokenization), then switch to the [self-closing start tag state](#132540-self-closing-start-tag-state). Otherwise, treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

If the current end tag token is an [appropriate end tag token](#1325-tokenization), then switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state) and emit the current tag token. Otherwise, treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point) to the current tag token's tag name. Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization).

[ASCII lower alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current tag token's tag name. Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization).

Anything else

Emit a U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN character token, a U+002F SOLIDUS character token, and a character token for each of the characters in the [temporary buffer](#1325-tokenization) (in the order they were added to the buffer). [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [RCDATA state](#13252-rcdata-state).

Anything else

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

If the current end tag token is an [appropriate end tag token](#1325-tokenization), then switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state) and emit the current tag token. Otherwise, treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point) to the current tag token's tag name. ##### 13.2.5.15 Script data less-than sign state

##### 13.2.5.32 Before attribute name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

EOF

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [after attribute name state](#132534-after-attribute-name-state).

U+003D EQUALS SIGN (=)

This is an [unexpected-equals-sign-before-attribute-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Start a new attribute in the current tag token. Set that attribute's name to the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream), and its value to the empty string. Switch to the [attribute name state](#132533-attribute-name-state).

Anything else

Start a new attribute in the current tag token. Set that attribute name and value to the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [attribute name state](#132533-attribute-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.33 Attribute name state

U+0020 SPACE

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

EOF

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [after attribute name state](#132534-after-attribute-name-state).

U+003D EQUALS SIGN (=)

Switch to the [before attribute value state](#132535-before-attribute-value-state).

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point) to the current attribute's name.

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current attribute's name.

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

This is an [unexpected-character-in-attribute-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current attribute's name.

When the user agent leaves the attribute name state (and before emitting the tag token, if appropriate), the complete attribute's name must be compared to the other attributes on the same token; if there is already an attribute on the token with the exact same name, then this is a [duplicate-attribute](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors) and the new attribute must be removed from the token.

> [!note]
> If an attribute is so removed from a token, it, and the value that gets associated with it, if any, are never subsequently used by the parser, and are therefore effectively discarded. Removing the attribute in this way does not change its status as the "current attribute" for the purposes of the tokenizer, however.

##### 13.2.5.34 After attribute name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

Switch to the [self-closing start tag state](#132540-self-closing-start-tag-state).

U+003D EQUALS SIGN (=)

Switch to the [before attribute value state](#132535-before-attribute-value-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Start a new attribute in the current tag token. Set that attribute name and value to the empty string. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [attribute name state](#132533-attribute-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.35 Before attribute value state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

Switch to the [attribute value (double-quoted) state](#132536-attribute-value-double-quoted-state).

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

Switch to the [attribute value (single-quoted) state](#132537-attribute-value-single-quoted-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is a [missing-attribute-value](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

Anything else

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [attribute value (unquoted) state](#132538-attribute-value-unquoted-state).

##### 13.2.5.36 Attribute value (double-quoted) state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

Switch to the [after attribute value (quoted) state](#132539-after-attribute-value-quoted-state).

U+0026 AMPERSAND (&)

Set the [return state](#1325-tokenization) to the [attribute value (double-quoted) state](#132536-attribute-value-double-quoted-state). Switch to the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current attribute's value.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current attribute's value.

##### 13.2.5.37 Attribute value (single-quoted) state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

Switch to the [after attribute value (quoted) state](#132539-after-attribute-value-quoted-state).

U+0026 AMPERSAND (&)

Set the [return state](#1325-tokenization) to the [attribute value (single-quoted) state](#132537-attribute-value-single-quoted-state). Switch to the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current attribute's value.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current attribute's value.

##### 13.2.5.38 Attribute value (unquoted) state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state).

U+0026 AMPERSAND (&)

Set the [return state](#1325-tokenization) to the [attribute value (unquoted) state](#132538-attribute-value-unquoted-state). Switch to the [character reference state](#132577-character-reference-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current attribute's value.

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

U+003D EQUALS SIGN (=)

U+0060 GRAVE ACCENT (\`)

This is an [unexpected-character-in-unquoted-attribute-value](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Treat it as per the "anything else" entry below.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current attribute's value.

##### 13.2.5.39 After attribute value (quoted) state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state).

U+002F SOLIDUS (/)

Switch to the [self-closing start tag state](#132540-self-closing-start-tag-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is a [missing-whitespace-between-attributes](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.40 Self-closing start tag state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Set the *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* of the current tag token. Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current tag token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is an [unexpected-solidus-in-tag](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [before attribute name state](#132532-before-attribute-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.41 Bogus comment state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current comment token.

EOF

Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the comment token's data.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the comment token's data.

##### 13.2.5.42 Markup declaration open state

If the next few characters are:

Two U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters (-)

Consume those two characters, create a comment token whose data is the empty string, and switch to the [comment start state](#132543-comment-start-state).

[ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for "`DOCTYPE`"

Consume those characters and switch to the [DOCTYPE state](#132553-doctype-state).

"`[CDATA[`"

Consume those characters. If there is an [adjusted current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and it is not an element in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), then switch to the [CDATA section state](#132569-cdata-section-state). Otherwise, this is a [cdata-in-html-content](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a comment token whose data is "`[CDATA[`". Switch to the [bogus comment state](#132541-bogus-comment-state).

Anything else

This is an [incorrectly-opened-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a comment token whose data is the empty string. Switch to the [bogus comment state](#132541-bogus-comment-state) (don't consume anything in the current state).

##### 13.2.5.43 Comment start state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment start dash state](#132544-comment-start-dash-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is an [abrupt-closing-of-empty-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current comment token.

Anything else

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.44 Comment start dash state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment end state](#132551-comment-end-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is an [abrupt-closing-of-empty-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current comment token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) to the comment token's data. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.45 Comment state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the comment token's data. Switch to the [comment less-than sign state](#132546-comment-less-than-sign-state).

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment end dash state](#132550-comment-end-dash-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the comment token's data.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the comment token's data.

##### 13.2.5.46 Comment less-than sign state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0021 EXCLAMATION MARK (!)

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the comment token's data. Switch to the [comment less-than sign bang state](#132547-comment-less-than-sign-bang-state).

U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN (<)

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the comment token's data.

Anything else

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.47 Comment less-than sign bang state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment less-than sign bang dash state](#132548-comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-state).

Anything else

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.48 Comment less-than sign bang dash state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment less-than sign bang dash dash state](#132549-comment-less-than-sign-bang-dash-dash-state).

Anything else

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment end dash state](#132550-comment-end-dash-state).

##### 13.2.5.49 Comment less-than sign bang dash dash state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

EOF

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment end state](#132551-comment-end-state).

Anything else

This is a [nested-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment end state](#132551-comment-end-state).

##### 13.2.5.50 Comment end dash state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Switch to the [comment end state](#132551-comment-end-state).

EOF

This is an [eof-in-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) to the comment token's data. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.51 Comment end state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current comment token.

U+0021 EXCLAMATION MARK (!)

Switch to the [comment end bang state](#132552-comment-end-bang-state).

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Append a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS character (-) to the comment token's data.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append two U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters (-) to the comment token's data. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.52 Comment end bang state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS (-)

Append two U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters (-) and a U+0021 EXCLAMATION MARK character (!) to the comment token's data. Switch to the [comment end dash state](#132550-comment-end-dash-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is an [incorrectly-closed-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current comment token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-comment](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Emit the current comment token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append two U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters (-) and a U+0021 EXCLAMATION MARK character (!) to the comment token's data. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [comment state](#132545-comment-state).

##### 13.2.5.53 DOCTYPE state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [before DOCTYPE name state](#132554-before-doctype-name-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

[Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [before DOCTYPE name state](#132554-before-doctype-name-state).

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set its *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is a [missing-whitespace-before-doctype-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [before DOCTYPE name state](#132554-before-doctype-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.54 Before DOCTYPE name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set the token's name to the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point). Switch to the [DOCTYPE name state](#132555-doctype-name-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set the token's name to a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character. Switch to the [DOCTYPE name state](#132555-doctype-name-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is a [missing-doctype-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set its *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set its *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Create a new DOCTYPE token. Set the token's name to the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream). Switch to the [DOCTYPE name state](#132555-doctype-name-state).

##### 13.2.5.55 DOCTYPE name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [after DOCTYPE name state](#132556-after-doctype-name-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.

[ASCII upper alpha](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points)

Append the lowercase version of the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) (add 0x0020 to the character's code point) to the current DOCTYPE token's name.

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current DOCTYPE token's name.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current DOCTYPE token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current DOCTYPE token's name.

##### 13.2.5.56 After DOCTYPE name state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current DOCTYPE token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

If the six characters starting from the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) are an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for "`PUBLIC`", then consume those characters and switch to the [after DOCTYPE public keyword state](#132557-after-doctype-public-keyword-state).

Otherwise, if the six characters starting from the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) are an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for "`SYSTEM`", then consume those characters and switch to the [after DOCTYPE system keyword state](#132563-after-doctype-system-keyword-state).

Otherwise, this is an [invalid-character-sequence-after-doctype-name](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [bogus DOCTYPE state](#132568-bogus-doctype-state).

##### 13.2.5.57 After DOCTYPE public keyword state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Switch to the [before DOCTYPE public identifier state](#132558-before-doctype-public-identifier-state).

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

This is a [missing-whitespace-after-doctype-public-keyword](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier to the empty string (not missing), then switch to the [DOCTYPE public identifier (double-quoted) state](#132559-doctype-public-identifier-double-quoted-state).

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

This is a [missing-whitespace-after-doctype-public-keyword](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier to the empty string (not missing), then switch to the [DOCTYPE public identifier (single-quoted) state](#132560-doctype-public-identifier-single-quoted-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is a [missing-doctype-public-identifier](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current DOCTYPE token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is a [missing-quote-before-doctype-public-identifier](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [bogus DOCTYPE state](#132568-bogus-doctype-state).

##### 13.2.5.58 Before DOCTYPE public identifier state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION (tab)

U+000A LINE FEED (LF)

U+000C FORM FEED (FF)

U+0020 SPACE

Ignore the character.

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

Set the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier to the empty string (not missing), then switch to the [DOCTYPE public identifier (double-quoted) state](#132559-doctype-public-identifier-double-quoted-state).

U+0027 APOSTROPHE (')

Set the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier to the empty string (not missing), then switch to the [DOCTYPE public identifier (single-quoted) state](#132560-doctype-public-identifier-single-quoted-state).

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is a [missing-doctype-public-identifier](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current DOCTYPE token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

This is a [missing-quote-before-doctype-public-identifier](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. [Reconsume](#1325-tokenization) in the [bogus DOCTYPE state](#132568-bogus-doctype-state).

##### 13.2.5.59 DOCTYPE public identifier (double-quoted) state

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+0022 QUOTATION MARK (")

Switch to the [after DOCTYPE public identifier state](#132561-after-doctype-public-identifier-state).

U+0000 NULL

This is an [unexpected-null-character](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Append a U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER character to the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier.

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

This is an [abrupt-doctype-public-identifier](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.

EOF

This is an [eof-in-doctype](#1322-parse-errors) [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Set the current DOCTYPE token's *[force-quirks flag](#1325-tokenization)* to *on*. Emit the current DOCTYPE token. Emit an end-of-file token.

Anything else

Append the [current input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to the current DOCTYPE token's public identifier.

Consume the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream):

U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN (>)

Switch to the [data state](#13251-data-state). Emit the current DOCTYPE token.
