If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it, or if the second element on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element, or if there is a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then ignore the token. ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments) or there is a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element on the stack)

Otherwise, set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok"; then, for each attribute on the token, check to see if the attribute is already present on the [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element (the second element) on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), and if it is not, add the attribute and its corresponding value to that element.

A start tag whose tag name is "frameset"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) has only one node on it, or if the second element on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element, then ignore the token. ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments) or there is a [`template`](#4123-the-template-element) element on the stack)

If the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is set to "not ok", ignore the token.

Otherwise, run the following steps:
1. Remove the second element on the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from its parent node, if it has one.
2. Pop all the nodes from the bottom of the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), from the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) up to, but not including, the root [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element.
3. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.
4. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in frameset](#1326418-the-in-frameset-insertion-mode)".

An end-of-file token

If the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode) is not empty, then process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in template](#1326416-the-in-template-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Otherwise, follow these steps:
1. If there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, an [`optgroup`](#4109-the-optgroup-element) element, an [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element, a [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, an [`rb`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, an [`rp`](#4512-the-rp-element) element, an [`rt`](#4511-the-rt-element) element, an [`rtc`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, a [`tbody`](#495-the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#497-the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#496-the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. [Stop parsing](#1327-the-end).

An end tag whose tag name is "body"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `body` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, if there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, an [`optgroup`](#4109-the-optgroup-element) element, an [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element, a [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, an [`rb`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, an [`rp`](#4512-the-rp-element) element, an [`rt`](#4511-the-rt-element) element, an [`rtc`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, a [`tbody`](#495-the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#497-the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#496-the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[after body](#1326417-the-after-body-insertion-mode)".

An end tag whose tag name is "html"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `body` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, if there is a node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is not either a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element, a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element, an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, an [`optgroup`](#4109-the-optgroup-element) element, an [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element, a [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, an [`rb`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, an [`rp`](#4512-the-rp-element) element, an [`rt`](#4511-the-rt-element) element, an [`rtc`](#162-non-conforming-features) element, a [`tbody`](#495-the-tbody-element) element, a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) element, a [`tfoot`](#497-the-tfoot-element) element, a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element, a [`thead`](#496-the-thead-element) element, a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element, the [`body`](#431-the-body-element) element, or the [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[after body](#1326417-the-after-body-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "address", "article", "aside", "blockquote", "center", "details", "dialog", "dir", "div", "dl", "fieldset", "figcaption", "figure", "footer", "header", "hgroup", "main", "menu", "nav", "ol", "p", "search", "section", "summary", "ul"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) whose tag name is one of "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", or "h6", then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "pre", "listing"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

If the [next token](#1326-tree-construction) is a U+000A LINE FEED (LF) character token, then ignore that token and move on to the next one. (Newlines at the start of [`pre`](#443-the-pre-element) blocks are ignored as an authoring convenience.)

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is "form"

If the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) is not null, and the parser is not [parsing template contents](#13244-the-element-pointers), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).
2. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, and, if the parser is not [parsing template contents](#13244-the-element-pointers), set the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) to point to the element created.

A start tag whose tag name is "li"

Run these steps:
1. Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".
2. Initialize node to be the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (the bottommost node of the stack).
3. *Loop*: If node is an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, then run these substeps:
   1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`li`](#448-the-li-element) elements.
   2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
   3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element has been popped from the stack.
   4. Jump to the step labeled *done* below.
4. If node is in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category, but is not an [`address`](#4310-the-address-element), [`div`](#4416-the-div-element), or [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, then jump to the step labeled *done* below.
5. Otherwise, set node to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled *loop*.
6. *Done*: If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).
7. Finally, [insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "dd", "dt"

Run these steps:
1. Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".
2. Initialize node to be the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (the bottommost node of the stack).
3. *Loop*: If node is a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element, then run these substeps:
   1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) elements.
   2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
   3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`dd`](#4411-the-dd-element) element has been popped from the stack.
   4. Jump to the step labeled *done* below.
4. If node is a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element, then run these substeps:
   1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) elements.
   2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
   3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`dt`](#4410-the-dt-element) element has been popped from the stack.
   4. Jump to the step labeled *done* below.
5. If node is in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category, but is not an [`address`](#4310-the-address-element), [`div`](#4416-the-div-element), or [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, then jump to the step labeled *done* below.
6. Otherwise, set node to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and return to the step labeled *loop*.
7. *Done*: If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).
8. Finally, [insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "plaintext"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

Switch the tokenizer to the [PLAINTEXT state](#13255-plaintext-state).

> [!note]
> Once a start tag with the tag name "plaintext" has been seen, all remaining tokens will be character tokens (and a final end-of-file token) because there is no way to switch the tokenizer out of the [PLAINTEXT state](#13255-plaintext-state). However, as the tree builder remains in its existing insertion mode, it might [reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) while processing those character tokens. This means that the parser can insert other elements into the [`plaintext`](#162-non-conforming-features) element.

A start tag whose tag name is "button"
1. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `button` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then run these substeps:
   1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
   2. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
   3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`button`](#4106-the-button-element) element has been popped from the stack.
2. [Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.
3. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.
4. Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "address", "article", "aside", "blockquote", "button", "center", "details", "dialog", "dir", "div", "dl", "fieldset", "figcaption", "figure", "footer", "header", "hgroup", "listing", "main", "menu", "nav", "ol", "pre", "search", "section", "select", "summary", "ul"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is "form"

If the parser is not [parsing template contents](#13244-the-element-pointers):
1. Let node be the element that the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) is set to, or null if it is not set to an element.
2. Set the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) to null.
3. If node is null or if the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have node in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); return and ignore the token.
4. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
5. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not node, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
6. Remove node from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

Otherwise:
1. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `form` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); return and ignore the token.
2. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
3. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
4. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is "p"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); [insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for a "p" start tag token with no attributes.

[Close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is "li"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an `li` element in list item scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`li`](#448-the-li-element) elements.
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [`li`](#448-the-li-element) element has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "dd", "dt"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [HTML elements](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token.
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) and whose tag name is one of "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", or "h6", then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) whose tag name is one of "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", or "h6" has been popped from the stack.

An end tag whose tag name is "sarcasm"

Take a deep breath, then act as described in the "any other end tag" entry below.

A start tag whose tag name is "a"

If the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) contains an [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element between the end of the list and the last [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) on the list (or the start of the list if there is no [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) on the list), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); run the [adoption agency algorithm](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode) for the token, then remove that element from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) and the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) if the [adoption agency algorithm](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode) didn't already remove it (it might not have if the element is not [in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements)).

> [!example]
> In the non-conforming stream `<a href="a">a<table><a href="b">b</table>x`, the first [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element would be closed upon seeing the second one, and the "x" character would be inside a link to "b", not to "a". This is despite the fact that the outer [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element is not in table scope (meaning that a regular `</a>` end tag at the start of the table wouldn't close the outer [`a`](#451-the-a-element) element). The result is that the two [`a`](#451-the-a-element) elements are indirectly nested inside each other — non-conforming markup will often result in non-conforming DOMs when parsed.

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. [Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "b", "big", "code", "em", "font", "i", "s", "small", "strike", "strong", "tt", "u"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. [Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element.

A start tag whose tag name is "nobr"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `nobr` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); run the [adoption agency algorithm](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode) for the token, then once again [reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. [Push onto the list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that element.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "a", "b", "big", "code", "em", "font", "i", "nobr", "s", "small", "strike", "strong", "tt", "u"

Run the [adoption agency algorithm](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "applet", "marquee", "object"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

Insert a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

An end tag token whose tag name is one of: "applet", "marquee", "object"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, run these steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.
4. [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).

A start tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) is *not* set to [quirks mode](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#45-interface-document), and the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".

An end tag whose tag name is "br"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Drop the attributes from the token, and act as described in the next entry; i.e. act as if this was a "br" start tag token with no attributes, rather than the end tag token that it actually is.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "area", "br", "embed", "img", "keygen", "wbr"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is "input"

If the parser's [fragment context element](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is a [`select`](#4107-the-select-element) element ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments)):
1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. Ignore the token.
3. Return.

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `select` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements):
1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#4107-the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

If the token does not have an attribute with the name "type", or if it does, but that attribute's value is not an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for "`hidden`", then set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "param", "source", "track"

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

A start tag whose tag name is "hr"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `select` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements):
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has an `option` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) or [has an `optgroup` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is "image"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Change the token's tag name to "img" and reprocess it. (Don't ask.)

A start tag whose tag name is "textarea"

Run these steps:
1. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.
2. If the [next token](#1326-tree-construction) is a U+000A LINE FEED (LF) character token, then ignore that token and move on to the next one. (Newlines at the start of [`textarea`](#41011-the-textarea-element) elements are ignored as an authoring convenience.)
3. Switch the tokenizer to the [RCDATA state](#13252-rcdata-state).
4. Set the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the current [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).
5. Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".
6. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[text](#132648-the-text-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is "xmp"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `p` element in button scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [close a `p` element](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#13262-parsing-elements-that-contain-only-text).

A start tag whose tag name is "iframe"

Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#13262-parsing-elements-that-contain-only-text).

A start tag whose tag name is "noembed"

A start tag whose tag name is "noscript", if [scripting mode](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is not [Disabled](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags)

Follow the [generic raw text element parsing algorithm](#13262-parsing-elements-that-contain-only-text).

A start tag whose tag name is "select"

If the parser's [fragment context element](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is a [`select`](#4107-the-select-element) element ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments)):
1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. Ignore the token.

Otherwise, if the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `select` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements):
1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. Ignore the token.
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`select`](#4107-the-select-element) element has been popped from the stack.

Otherwise:
1. [Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.
2. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.
3. Set the [frameset-ok flag](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) to "not ok".

A start tag whose tag name is "option"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `select` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements):
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags) except for [`optgroup`](#4109-the-optgroup-element) elements.
2. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has an `option` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

Otherwise:
1. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is an [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element, then pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "optgroup"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `select` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements):
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has an `option` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) or [has an `optgroup` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

Otherwise, if the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is an [`option`](#41010-the-option-element) element, then pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "rb", "rtc"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `ruby` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags). If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not now a [`ruby`](#4510-the-ruby-element) element, this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "rp", "rt"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `ruby` element in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then [generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`rtc`](#162-non-conforming-features) elements. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not now a [`rtc`](#162-non-conforming-features) element or a [`ruby`](#4510-the-ruby-element) element, this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "math"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Adjust MathML attributes](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. (This fixes the case of MathML attributes that are not all lowercase.)

[Adjust foreign attributes](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. (This fixes the use of namespaced attributes, in particular XLink.)

[Insert a foreign element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, with [MathML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces) and false.

If the token has its *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* set, pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and [acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization).

A start tag whose tag name is "svg"

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Adjust SVG attributes](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. (This fixes the case of SVG attributes that are not all lowercase.)

[Adjust foreign attributes](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. (This fixes the use of namespaced attributes, in particular XLink in SVG.)

[Insert a foreign element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, with [SVG namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces) and false.

If the token has its *[self-closing flag](#1325-tokenization)* set, pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and [acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "frame", "head", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

Any other start tag

[Reconstruct the active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), if any.

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.

> [!note]
> This element will be an [ordinary](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) element. With one exception: if [scripting mode](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags) is [Disabled](#13245-other-parsing-state-flags), it can also be a [`noscript`](#4122-the-noscript-element) element.

Any other end tag

Run these steps:
1. Initialize node to be the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (the bottommost node of the stack).
2. *Loop*: If node is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token:
   1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [HTML elements](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token.
   2. If node is not the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
   3. Pop all the nodes from the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) up to node, including node, then stop these steps.
3. Otherwise, if node is in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token, and return.
4. Set node to the previous entry in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).
5. Return to the step labeled *loop*.

When the steps above say the user agent is to close a `p` element, it means that the user agent must run the following steps:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags), except for [`p`](#441-the-p-element) elements.
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`p`](#441-the-p-element) element has been popped from the stack.

The adoption agency algorithm, which takes as its only argument a token token for which the algorithm is being run, consists of the following steps:
1. Let subject be token's tag name.
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) whose tag name is subject, and the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and return.
3. Let outerLoopCounter be 0.
4. While true:
   1. If outerLoopCounter is greater than or equal to 8, then return.
   2. Increment outerLoopCounter by 1.
   3. Let formattingElement be the last element in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) that:
      - is between the end of the list and the last [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) in the list, if any, or the start of the list otherwise, and
      - has the tag name subject.

      If there is no such element, then act as described in the "any other end tag" entry above and return.

   4. If formattingElement is not in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); remove the element from the list, and return.
   5. If formattingElement is in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), but the element is not [in scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); return.
   6. If formattingElement is not the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors). (But do not return.)
   7. Let furthestBlock be the topmost node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is lower in the stack than formattingElement, and is an element in the [special](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) category. There might not be one.
   8. If there is no furthestBlock, then the UA must first pop all the nodes from the bottom of the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), from the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) up to and including formattingElement, then remove formattingElement from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), and finally return.
   9. Let commonAncestor be the element immediately above formattingElement in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).
   10. Let a bookmark note the position of formattingElement in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) relative to the elements on either side of it in the list.
   11. Let node and lastNode be furthestBlock.
   12. Let innerLoopCounter be 0.
   13. While true:
       1. Increment innerLoopCounter by 1.
       2. Let node be the element immediately above node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), or if node is no longer in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (e.g. because it got removed by this algorithm), the element that was immediately above node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) before node was removed.
       3. If node is formattingElement, then [break](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
       4. If innerLoopCounter is greater than 3 and node is in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then remove node from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
       5. If node is not in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), then remove node from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) and [continue](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#39-iteration).
       6. [Create an element for the token](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for which the element node was created, in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), with commonAncestor as the intended parent; replace the entry for node in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) with an entry for the new element, replace the entry for node in the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) with an entry for the new element, and let node be the new element.
       7. If lastNode is furthestBlock, then move the aforementioned bookmark to be immediately after the new node in the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
       8. [Append](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) lastNode to node.
       9. Set lastNode to node.
   14. Let (target, refNode) be the [adjusted insertion location](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) given (commonAncestor, null).
   15. If lastNode's [parent](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees) is non-null, then [remove](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) lastNode.
   16. If all of the following are true:
       - lastNode's [parent](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees) is null;
       - lastNode is not a [host-including inclusive ancestor](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-interface-documentfragment) of target;
       - target is not a [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) node, or it does not have an element child; and
       - refNode is null or its [parent](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#11-trees) is target,

       then:
       1. [Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): [ensure pre-insert validity](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) given lastNode, target, refNode, and « » does not throw.
       2. [Insert](dom-spec-whatwg-org.md#423-mutation-algorithms) lastNode into target before refNode.

   17. [Create an element for the token](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for which formattingElement was created, in the [HTML namespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#8-namespaces), with furthestBlock as the intended parent.
   18. Take all of the child nodes of furthestBlock and append them to the element created in the last step.
   19. Append that new element to furthestBlock.
   20. Remove formattingElement from the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements), and insert the new element into the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the position of the aforementioned bookmark.
   21. Remove formattingElement from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), and insert the new element into the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) immediately below the position of furthestBlock in that stack.

> [!note]
> This algorithm's name, the "adoption agency algorithm", comes from the way it causes elements to change parents, and is in contrast with [other possible algorithms](https://ln.hixie.ch/?start=1037910467&count=1) for dealing with misnested content.

###### 13.2.6.4.8 The "text" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[text](#132648-the-text-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token

[Insert the token's character](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

> [!note]
> This can never be a U+0000 NULL character; the tokenizer converts those to U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER characters.

An end-of-file token

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is a [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) element, then set its [already started](#41211-processing-model) to true.

Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "script"

If the [active speculative HTML parser](#1328-speculative-html-parsing) is null and the [JavaScript execution context stack](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack) is empty, then [perform a microtask checkpoint](#8173-processing-model).

Let script be the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (which will be a [`script`](#4121-the-script-element) element).

Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Let the old insertion point have the same value as the current [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream). Let the [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) be just before the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream).

Increment the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) by one.

If the [active speculative HTML parser](#1328-speculative-html-parsing) is null, then [prepare the script element](#41211-processing-model) script. This might cause some script to execute, which might cause [new characters to be inserted into the tokenizer](#843-documentwrite), and might cause the tokenizer to output more tokens, resulting in a [reentrant invocation of the parser](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model).

Decrement the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) by one. If the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) is zero, then set the [parser pause flag](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) to false.

Let the [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) have the value of the old insertion point. (In other words, restore the [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) to its previous value. This value might be the "undefined" value.)

At this stage, if the [pending parsing-blocking script](#41211-processing-model) is not null:

If the [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) is not zero:

Set the [parser pause flag](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) to true, and abort the processing of any nested invocations of the tokenizer, yielding control back to the caller. (Tokenization will resume when the caller returns to the "outer" tree construction stage.)

> [!note]
> The tree construction stage of this particular parser is [being called reentrantly](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model), say from a call to [`document.write()`](#843-documentwrite).

Otherwise:

While the [pending parsing-blocking script](#41211-processing-model) is not null:
1. Let the script be the [pending parsing-blocking script](#41211-processing-model).
2. Set the [pending parsing-blocking script](#41211-processing-model) to null.
3. [Start the speculative HTML parser](#1328-speculative-html-parsing) for this instance of the HTML parser.
4. Block the [tokenizer](#1325-tokenization) for this instance of the [HTML parser](#132-parsing-html-documents), such that the [event loop](#8171-definitions) will not run [tasks](#8171-definitions) that invoke the [tokenizer](#1325-tokenization).
5. If the parser's [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [has a style sheet that is blocking scripts](#427-interactions-of-styling-and-scripting) or the script's [ready to be parser-executed](#41211-processing-model) is false: [spin the event loop](#8173-processing-model) until the parser's [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) [has no style sheet that is blocking scripts](#427-interactions-of-styling-and-scripting) and the script's [ready to be parser-executed](#41211-processing-model) becomes true.
6. If this [parser has been aborted](#1327-the-end) in the meantime, return.

   > [!note]
   > This could happen if, e.g., while the [spin the event loop](#8173-processing-model) algorithm is running, the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object) gets [destroyed](#7510-destroying-documents), or the [`document.open()`](#841-opening-the-input-stream) method gets invoked on the [`Document`](#311-the-document-object).

7. [Stop the speculative HTML parser](#1328-speculative-html-parsing) for this instance of the HTML parser.
8. Unblock the [tokenizer](#1325-tokenization) for this instance of the [HTML parser](#132-parsing-html-documents), such that [tasks](#8171-definitions) that invoke the [tokenizer](#1325-tokenization) can again be run.
9. Let the [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) be just before the [next input character](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream).
10. Increment the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) by one (it should be zero before this step, so this sets it to one).
11. [Execute the script element](#41211-processing-model) the script.
12. Decrement the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) by one. If the parser's [script nesting level](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) is zero (which it always should be at this point), then set the [parser pause flag](#1321-overview-of-the-parsing-model) to false.
13. Let the [insertion point](#13235-preprocessing-the-input-stream) be undefined again.

Any other end tag

Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

###### 13.2.6.4.9 The "in table" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token, if the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is [`table`](#491-the-table-element), [`tbody`](#495-the-tbody-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), [`tfoot`](#497-the-tfoot-element), [`thead`](#496-the-thead-element), or [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element

Let the pending table character tokens be an empty list of tokens.

Set the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the current [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table text](#1326410-the-in-table-text-insertion-mode)" and reprocess the token.

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

A processing instruction token

[Insert a processing instruction](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "caption"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode). (See below.)

Insert a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in caption](#1326411-the-in-caption-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is "colgroup"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#1326412-the-in-column-group-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for a "colgroup" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#1326412-the-in-column-group-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the current token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th", "tr"

[Clear the stack back to a table context](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for a "tbody" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the current token.

A start tag whose tag name is "table"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `table` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. Pop elements from this stack until a [`table`](#491-the-table-element) element has been popped from the stack.
2. [Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#13241-the-insertion-mode).
3. Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `table` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. Pop elements from this stack until a [`table`](#491-the-table-element) element has been popped from the stack.
2. [Reset the insertion mode appropriately](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "style", "script", "template"

An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in head](#132644-the-in-head-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "input"

If the token does not have an attribute with the name "type", or if it does, but that attribute's value is not an [ASCII case-insensitive](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#47-strings) match for "`hidden`", then act as described in the "anything else" entry below.

Otherwise:
1. [Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
2. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token.
3. Pop that [`input`](#4105-the-input-element) element off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).
4. [Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

A start tag whose tag name is "form"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

If the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) is not null, and the parser is not [parsing template contents](#13244-the-element-pointers), then ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, and, if the parser is not [parsing template contents](#13244-the-element-pointers), set the [`form` element pointer](#13244-the-element-pointers) to point to the element created.
2. Pop that [`form`](#4103-the-form-element) element off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

An end-of-file token

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Anything else

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Enable [foster parenting](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes), process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), and then disable [foster parenting](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

When the steps above require the UA to clear the stack back to a table context, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`table`](#491-the-table-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), or [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

> [!note]
> This is the same list of elements as used in the *[has an element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements)* steps.

> [!note]
> The [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) being an [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments).

###### 13.2.6.4.10 The "in table text" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table text](#1326410-the-in-table-text-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is U+0000 NULL

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

Any other character token

Append the character token to the [pending table character tokens](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode) list.

Anything else

If any of the tokens in the [pending table character tokens](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode) list are character tokens that are not [ASCII whitespace](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#46-code-points), then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors): reprocess the character tokens in the [pending table character tokens](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode) list using the rules given in the "anything else" entry in the "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)" insertion mode.

Otherwise, [insert the characters](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) given by the [pending table character tokens](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode) list.

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to the [original insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) and reprocess the token.

###### 13.2.6.4.11 The "in caption" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in caption](#1326411-the-in-caption-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

An end tag whose tag name is "caption"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `caption` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments))

Otherwise:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. Now, if the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from this stack until a [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) element has been popped from the stack.
4. [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
5. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `caption` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token. ([fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments))

Otherwise:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. Now, if the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from this stack until a [`caption`](#492-the-caption-element) element has been popped from the stack.
4. [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
5. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".
6. Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "col", "colgroup", "html", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

###### 13.2.6.4.12 The "in column group" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in column group](#1326412-the-in-column-group-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token that is one of U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, U+000A LINE FEED (LF), U+000C FORM FEED (FF), U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR), or U+0020 SPACE

[Insert the character](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

A comment token

[Insert a comment](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

A processing instruction token

[Insert a processing instruction](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes).

A DOCTYPE token

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "html"

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token. Immediately pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) off the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Acknowledge the token's *self-closing flag*](#1325-tokenization), if it is set.

An end tag whose tag name is "colgroup"

If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`colgroup`](#493-the-colgroup-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".

An end tag whose tag name is "col"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "template"

An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in head](#132644-the-in-head-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

An end-of-file token

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Anything else

If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`colgroup`](#493-the-colgroup-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the token.

###### 13.2.6.4.13 The "in table body" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A start tag whose tag name is "tr"

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in row](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "th", "td"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors).

[Clear the stack back to a table body context](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for a "tr" start tag token with no attributes, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in row](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode)".

Reprocess the current token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token, this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Clear the stack back to a table body context](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode). (See below.)
2. Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tbody`, `thead`, or `tfoot` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Clear the stack back to a table body context](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode). (See below.)
2. Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)".
3. Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "td", "th", "tr"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

When the steps above require the UA to clear the stack back to a table body context, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`tbody`](#495-the-tbody-element), [`tfoot`](#497-the-tfoot-element), [`thead`](#496-the-thead-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), or [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

> [!note]
> The [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) being an [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments).

###### 13.2.6.4.14 The "in row" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in row](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "th", "td"

[Clear the stack back to a table row context](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode). (See below.)

[Insert an HTML element](#13261-creating-and-inserting-nodes) for the token, then switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in cell](#1326415-the-in-cell-insertion-mode)".

Insert a [marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements) at the end of the [list of active formatting elements](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).

An end tag whose tag name is "tr"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Clear the stack back to a table row context](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode). (See below.)
2. Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (which will be a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr"

An end tag whose tag name is "table"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Clear the stack back to a table row context](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode). (See below.)
2. Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (which will be a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)".
3. Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token, this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have a `tr` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements), ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Clear the stack back to a table row context](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode). (See below.)
2. Pop the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) (which will be a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element) element) from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements). Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)".
3. Reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html", "td", "th"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

When the steps above require the UA to clear the stack back to a table row context, it means that the UA must, while the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not a [`tr`](#498-the-tr-element), [`template`](#4123-the-template-element), or [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element, pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

> [!note]
> The [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) being an [`html`](#411-the-html-element) element after this process is a [fragment case](#134-parsing-html-fragments).

###### 13.2.6.4.15 The "in cell" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in cell](#1326415-the-in-cell-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. Now, if the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as the token has been popped from the stack.
4. [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
5. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in row](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode)".

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "col", "colgroup", "tbody", "td", "tfoot", "th", "thead", "tr"

[Assert](infra-spec-whatwg-org.md#310-assertions): the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) [has a `td` or `th` element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements).

[Close the cell](#1326415-the-in-cell-insertion-mode) (see below) and reprocess the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "body", "caption", "col", "colgroup", "html"

[Parse error](#1322-parse-errors). Ignore the token.

An end tag whose tag name is one of: "table", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead", "tr"

If the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) does not [have an element in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) that is an [HTML element](#213-xml-compatibility) with the same tag name as that of the token, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors); ignore the token.

Otherwise, [close the cell](#1326415-the-in-cell-insertion-mode) (see below) and reprocess the token.

Anything else

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Where the steps above say to close the cell, they mean to run the following algorithm:
1. [Generate implied end tags](#13263-closing-elements-that-have-implied-end-tags).
2. If the [current node](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) is not now a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) element or a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element, then this is a [parse error](#1322-parse-errors).
3. Pop elements from the [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) until a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) element or a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element has been popped from the stack.
4. [Clear the list of active formatting elements up to the last marker](#13243-the-list-of-active-formatting-elements).
5. Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in row](#1326414-the-in-row-insertion-mode)".

> [!note]
> The [stack of open elements](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) cannot have both a [`td`](#499-the-td-element) and a [`th`](#4910-the-th-element) element [in table scope](#13242-the-stack-of-open-elements) at the same time, nor can it have neither when the [close the cell](#1326415-the-in-cell-insertion-mode) algorithm is invoked.

###### 13.2.6.4.16 The "in template" insertion mode

When the user agent is to apply the rules for the "[in template](#1326416-the-in-template-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode), the user agent must handle the token as follows:

A character token

A comment token

A processing instruction token

A DOCTYPE token

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in body](#132647-the-in-body-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "link", "meta", "noframes", "script", "style", "template", "title"

An end tag whose tag name is "template"

Process the token [using the rules for](#13241-the-insertion-mode) the "[in head](#132644-the-in-head-insertion-mode)" [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "caption", "colgroup", "tbody", "tfoot", "thead"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Push "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table](#132649-the-in-table-insertion-mode)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "col"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Push "[in column group](#1326412-the-in-column-group-insertion-mode)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in column group](#1326412-the-in-column-group-insertion-mode)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is "tr"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Push "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)" onto the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode) so that it is the new [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode).

Switch the [insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) to "[in table body](#1326413-the-in-table-body-insertion-mode)", and reprocess the token.

A start tag whose tag name is one of: "td", "th"

Pop the [current template insertion mode](#13241-the-insertion-mode) off the [stack of template insertion modes](#13241-the-insertion-mode).
